items.title: Making Duplicate Reimbursement Unrepresentable: A Verified Ethereum E-Invoice System for Humans and AI Agents
items.summary: Electronic invoices are replacing paper invoices worldwide, but today's centralized architectures leave three problems unsolved on the consumption side: an invoice can be submitted for reimbursement repeatedly, authenticity is difficult for recipients to verify, and data is siloed at a central authority that forms both a performance bottleneck and a single point of failure. This paper presents the design, formal analysis, and implementation of a complete blockchain-based electronic invoice system on Ethereum. We formalize the invoice lifecycle as a guarded labeled transition system and prove, under standard cryptographic and consensus assumptions, that the system guarantees: (i) reimbursement uniqueness--an invoice is reimbursed at most once, even across mutually distrusting organizations; (ii) face integrity--any verified invoice matches the recorded one unless keccak256 second-preimage resistance is broken; and (iii) authorization soundness for every lifecycle operation. The core invariants are machine-checked using Solidity SMTChecker, proving inductive validity across all reachable transaction sequences. The architecture models each invoice as a non-fungible, non-tradable token whose state transitions through five guarded subsystems, employing a lock-based protocol that makes duplicate reimbursement unrepresentable rather than merely detectable. We implement the design as a Solidity 0.8 contract with a four-role web application and evaluate it on a private Ethereum network: issuing costs 646,773 gas, full reimbursement costs under 135,000 gas, all operations run in O(1) time, and a single node sustains 137 issuances/s. Finally, the verified contract serves as a safety envelope for LLM-based reimbursement agents, provably rejecting unsafe actions (duplicate, over-limit, or forged-receipt claims) even when the agent's internal policy fails. All code and benchmarks are open-source.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对电子发票在消费/报销侧长期存在的三个痛点——同一张发票可被重复提交报销、收票方难以验证真伪、数据集中托管在中心化机构从而形成性能瓶颈与单点故障——提出并完整实现了一套基于以太坊的电子发票系统。方法上，作者首先将发票生命周期形式化为一个带守卫（guarded）的标签迁移系统（labeled transition system），并在标准密码学假设与共识假设下证明了三条安全性质：(i) 报销唯一性，即一张发票至多被报销一次，即使参与方之间互不信任；(ii) 面额完整性，即任何通过验证的发票在 keccak256 抗第二原像性未被攻破的前提下与链上记录一致；(iii) 每个生命周期操作的授权健全性。核心不变量使用 Solidity SMTChecker 进行机器化验证，证明其在所有可达交易序列上归纳成立。架构上，每张发票被建模为一个不可互换、不可转让的 NFT 型代币，其状态在五个带守卫的子系统中迁移，并采用基于锁的协议，使“重复报销”在结构上不可表达（unrepresentable），而不仅仅是被检测出来。实现层面，作者用 Solidity 0.8 编写合约，并配套四角色的 Web 应用，在私有以太坊网络上进行评估：开票消耗 646,773 gas，完整报销低于 135,000 gas，所有操作均为 O(1) 时间复杂度，单节点吞吐可达 137 次开票/秒。此外，该经过验证的合约还被用作 LLM 报销智能体的安全外壳（safety envelope）：即使智能体内部的策略失效，合约也能可证明地拒绝不安全动作（重复、超额、伪造票据的报销请求）。所有代码与基准测试均已开源。该工作适合区块链安全、智能合约形式化验证、金融风控以及 LLM 智能体安全护栏方向的研究者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“重复报销不可发生”从检测问题转变为可证明的结构性不可表达问题，并用机器化验证的不变量约束链上状态迁移；同时展示了以经过验证的合约为 LLM 智能体充当安全外壳的思路，对自动化财务流程与智能体护栏设计具有直接借鉴意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到链上票据/凭证生命周期管理、DAO 与跨组织费用报销、供应链单据核销等场景；其“以形式化验证合约约束 LLM 智能体”的模式也可用于其他高风险自动化决策（支付、审批、配额发放）的安全边界设计。
detection_signals_zh: 同一发票哈希/ID 在报销子系统中被二次提交，触发锁状态冲突或交易 revert
LLM 报销智能体提交的请求被链上守卫拒绝（duplicate、over-limit、forged-receipt 类 revert 事件）
异常高频的开票或报销调用模式，或单一地址在短时间内反复尝试跨组织报销同一票据
链上事件日志中出现与预期生命周期状态机不一致的状态迁移尝试
defense_advice_zh: 在报销流程中引入基于不可转让凭证代币与锁协议的链上状态机，使重复报销在状态层面不可表达，而非仅依赖事后对账检测
对关键业务不变量使用 SMTChecker 等工具做机器化验证，确保所有可达交易序列均满足唯一性、完整性与授权健全性
将 LLM 智能体的输出限制在经过验证的合约方法调用之内，用链上守卫作为最终安全外壳，容忍智能体内部策略失效
对报销与开票操作设置 gas 成本与频率监控，结合 revert 事件告警识别异常或攻击性调用
在多组织互不信任的场景下，采用链上共享账本替代单一中心化机构，降低单点故障与性能瓶颈风险

items.title: ToolFence: Fine-Grained Authorization for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents
items.summary: Tool-using LLM agents remain vulnerable to indirect prompt injection because trusted instructions and untrusted observations share one context, allowing malicious content to steer consequential input-filtering defenses. Multi-path consensus defenses still leave a high attack success rate because they examine content or aggregated outputs rather than authorizing effects, especially for the within-tool attack, which preserves the intended tool but manipulates its arguments. Data-Flow Control such as CaMeL provides stronger guarantees, but incurs substantial time latency that limits practical deployment. We introduce ToolFence, which compiles a typed authorization blueprint before execution, enforces it through a deterministic monitor, and when the blueprint is incomplete asks a judge to grant new capabilities rather than adjudicate each concrete call. ToolFence provides two key advantages. First, its fine-grained provenance-aware authorization enables the system to distinguish user-authorized values from untrusted observations, effectively addressing the within-tool attack. Second, its deterministic fast path and capability-level runtime grants substantially reduce the frequency of expensive judge calls, improving runtime efficiency. On AgentDojo with Qwen3-max, ToolFence reduces overall ASR to near zero with only a 3.80 percentage-point clean-utility drop and practical runtime overhead.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注工具调用型 LLM Agent 面临的一个根因性问题：在单一上下文窗口中，来自用户的「可信指令」与来自外部环境的「不可信观测」（网页、邮件、工具返回内容等）混杂在一起，因此间接提示注入可以借观测内容劫持 Agent 的推理，甚至反过来操纵那些本用于过滤输入的安全防御。作者指出，现有多路径共识类防御仍保持较高的攻击成功率，其根本原因是它们在检查「内容」或「聚合后的输出」，而不是对「效果」进行授权；尤其是「工具内攻击」（within-tool attack）——攻击者不改变 Agent 选用的工具，只篡改该工具调用的参数，就能绕过内容层面的检测。数据流控制方案（如 CaMeL）虽然提供了更强的安全保证，但会带来显著的时间延迟，难以实际部署。为此作者提出 ToolFence：在执行前先编译出一份带类型的授权蓝图（typed authorization blueprint），由确定性监控器（deterministic monitor）在运行时强制执行；当蓝图覆盖不完整时，不让判定器逐次裁决每一个具体调用，而是请求授予新的「能力」。ToolFence 具备两点优势：其一，细粒度、来源感知（provenance-aware）的授权使系统能够区分用户授权的值与不可信的观测值，从而有效应对工具内攻击；其二，确定性快路径与能力级运行时授权大幅减少了昂贵判定器的调用频率，提升了运行效率。在 AgentDojo 基准、Qwen3-max 模型上，ToolFence 将整体攻击成功率（ASR）压至接近零，干净任务效用仅下降 3.80 个百分点，运行时开销处于可接受范围。适合 LLM Agent 安全、提示注入防御、数据流控制与授权机制方向的研究者与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把 LLM Agent 的提示注入防御从「内容过滤」推进到「执行前授权 + 运行时强制」，直接针对参数篡改式的工具内攻击，并用能力级授权把安全判定开销降到可落地水平，为 Agent 安全架构提供了可借鉴的设计范式。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到所有调用外部工具/API 的 LLM Agent 场景，如企业内 RAG 助手、邮件与日程代理、运维自动化 Agent、浏览器代理等；其「来源标记 + 类型化授权蓝图 + 确定性监控」思路也适合嵌入现有 Agent 框架的权限层与审计层。
detection_signals_zh: 工具调用参数中混入了源自不可信观测（网页、邮件、文档、工具返回值）的值，却未经过用户显式授权路径
同一会话内出现与原始任务目标无关的新工具或新参数组合，尤其是参数值被外部内容「镜像」写入
运行时出现频繁的能力授予（capability grant）请求或判定器（judge）调用，可能表明授权蓝图覆盖不足或存在诱导行为
Agent 的工具调用在语义上保持正确的工具名但参数被细微改写（工具内攻击特征）
defense_advice_zh: 在工具执行前引入类型化授权蓝图：先声明本次任务允许调用的能力与参数取值来源，再交由确定性监控器强制执行，避免依赖模型自身的判断
对所有进入上下文的字符串做来源标记（provenance tagging），严格区分「用户授权值」与「不可信观测值」，禁止不可信值直接流入敏感参数
把安全判定粒度从「每次具体调用」上移到「能力授予」，用确定性快路径处理已授权调用，仅在蓝图不完整时触发昂贵判定，以兼顾安全与延迟
对参数级改写类攻击做专项测试（工具名不变、仅参数被篡改），不要只用内容过滤或输出聚合共识作为唯一防线
在引入该方案时，同时度量攻击成功率（ASR）与干净任务效用（clean utility）及运行时延迟，确认安全收益不以可用性大幅下降为代价

items.title: SKILLLITE: Evidence-Guided Malicious Skill Auditing with Compact LLMs
items.summary: As LLM-based agents perform increasingly complex tasks, Agent Skills have emerged as a flexible mechanism for extending their capabilities. An Agent Skill packages task-specific instructions with executable components and auxiliary resources to provide specialized functionalities. However, the growing adoption of third-party Skills introduces a new supply-chain attack surface. Malicious Skills can embed harmful behaviors that abuse agent privileges and compromise the agent execution environment or accessible resources. Although recent LLM-based malicious Skill auditing approaches have achieved promising performance, they often rely on capable commercial LLMs. How to achieve effective auditing with compact, locally deployable LLMs in security-sensitive and resource-constrained settings remains largely unexplored. Our investigation reveals that compact LLMs struggle to identify malicious behaviors hidden in complex Skill packages. This difficulty arises from both the implicit nature of such behaviors and the limited reasoning capacity of compact LLMs. To address these challenges, we propose SKILLLITE, an evidence-guided agentic framework for malicious Skill detection. SKILLLITE effectively extracts security-relevant behaviors and infers the intended functionality from complex Skill packages. It then employs a compact LLM to assess the maliciousness of the Skill based on the observed behaviors and their functional context. Experiments show that SKILLLITE improves malicious Skill detection across different compact LLM backbones and outperforms existing representative auditing baselines. Its effectiveness generalizes to behaviorally confirmed in-the-wild malicious Skills. Meanwhile, SKILLLITE maintains a low inference latency, supporting its practical deployment.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究的是 LLM 智能体生态中的「技能（Agent Skill）」供应链安全问题。随着基于大模型的智能体承担越来越复杂的任务，Agent Skill 成为一种灵活的能力扩展机制：它把面向特定任务的指令、可执行组件以及辅助资源打包在一起，为智能体提供专门功能。然而第三方 Skill 的广泛采用引入了一条新的供应链攻击面——恶意 Skill 可以把有害行为隐藏在看似正常的技能包中，滥用智能体被授予的权限，进而破坏智能体的执行环境或可访问的资源。已有的基于 LLM 的恶意 Skill 审计方案虽然效果不错，但普遍依赖能力强大的商用大模型；在安全敏感、资源受限的实际环境中，如何用紧凑的、可本地部署的小模型完成有效审计，此前基本没人系统研究过。作者通过调研发现，紧凑 LLM 很难识别隐藏在复杂 Skill 包中的恶意行为，原因有两个：一是这类恶意行为往往是隐式的、不直接暴露在显式指令里；二是小模型的推理能力有限，容易在冗长复杂的技能描述与多文件结构中被干扰。为此作者提出 SKILLLITE，一个「证据引导（evidence-guided）」的智能体式检测框架：它先从复杂的 Skill 包中抽取与安全相关的行为证据，并推断该技能的预期功能语义，再由紧凑 LLM 结合「观察到的行为」与「功能上下文」来判断该技能是否具有恶意性，从而把「判断」与「信息收集」解耦，降低对模型自身推理深度的依赖。实验表明，SKILLLITE 在多种紧凑 LLM 主干上都能提升恶意 Skill 检测效果，优于现有代表性审计基线；其有效性还能泛化到经行为确认的、真实在野的恶意 Skill 样本上；同时推理延迟保持在较低水平，具备实际部署可行性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能体技能市场正在形成新的第三方软件供应链，恶意技能可直接滥用智能体权限。该工作说明无需商用大模型、用本地紧凑模型即可做上线前审计，对受限环境下的智能体安全落地很有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到智能体平台/插件市场的第三方技能上架审核、企业内部自研或外购 Skill 的准入评估，以及资源受限或数据不可出域的本地化安全检测流水线；也适用于 MCP 类工具/插件包的可疑行为筛查场景。
detection_signals_zh: 技能包声明的功能与其实际包含的可执行组件、脚本行为不一致
技能请求或使用超出其功能所需权限（文件、网络、凭据、进程执行）
指令文本中夹带隐式意图、条件触发式描述或与任务无关的额外动作
辅助资源（脚本、配置、模板）中出现与技能语义无关的内容
技能在安装或首次调用阶段产生异常的外部通信或环境探测
defense_advice_zh: 在第三方 Skill 上线前引入基于本地紧凑 LLM 的行为抽取 + 功能上下文比对的审计环节
对技能包实施最小权限授予，按声明的功能语义限定可访问的文件、网络与凭据范围
保留技能调用的完整审计日志（文件读写、网络连接、子进程），便于事后溯源与行为确认
建立技能包清单与来源管控，优先使用可信来源并对更新版本重新审计
把人工复核集中在框架标记的高可疑技能上，以降低审计成本
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: CoSec: Benchmarking Agent Security in Communities
items.summary: LLM agents operate in persistent collaborative environments involving multiple users, communities, memories, files, and tools. Community boundaries may remain fixed or evolve with changes in membership, roles, composition, and relationships. Agents must complete legitimate tasks and prevent unauthorized disclosure of protected information. Existing evaluations do not fully examine these risks in agent systems. We introduce \textbf{CoSec}, an executable benchmark for evaluating privacy and authorization enforcement in LLM agent systems operating within and across communities. CoSec contains 208 canonical scenarios spanning fixed and evolving boundaries, protected information belonging to the agent owner or other participants, and attacks through dialogue, environmental content, persistent memory, and composed workflows. CoSec executes complete agent systems with persistent sessions, memory, files and tools. It verifies information flows against the active authorization state using execution traces and artifacts. Across harness and model configurations, agents frequently complete benign tasks but violate privacy and authorization boundaries. Privacy behavior varies across harnesses, attack surfaces, and community states, revealing how memory, files, tools, and workflows can carry protected information beyond its authorized scope. These findings show that task utility does not imply privacy or authorization compliance and that authorization in community settings remains an unresolved security challenge for persistent LLM agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注的是 LLM agent 在持久化协作环境中运行时所面临的隐私与授权风险。这类环境通常包含多个用户、社区（community）、长期记忆、共享文件以及各类工具，而社区边界并非静态：成员变更、角色调整、成员构成变化和参与者关系演化都会让原本的授权范围发生改变。Agent 因此承担双重目标——既要完成用户交付的合法任务，又必须防止受保护信息被未授权披露。作者指出，已有评测并未充分覆盖这类风险，因为它们多聚焦单轮对话或单用户、无持久状态的环境，无法刻画记忆、文件、工具和多步工作流带来的信息流动。为此，论文提出 CoSec，一个可执行（executable）的基准，用于在社区内部与跨社区场景下评估 LLM agent 系统的隐私保护与授权执行能力。CoSec 包含 208 个规范化场景，覆盖固定边界与演化边界两类社区状态，覆盖属于 agent 拥有者本人及属于其他参与者的受保护信息，并覆盖经由对话、环境内容、持久记忆和组合工作流四类攻击面发起的越权尝试。与静态问答式评测不同，CoSec 会真实执行完整 agent 系统，保留持久会话、记忆、文件和工具调用，并通过执行轨迹（execution traces）与执行产物（artifacts）对照当前活跃的授权状态，逐条验证信息流是否越界。跨多种 harness 与模型配置的实验显示：agent 通常能够顺利完成良性任务，但会频繁违反隐私与授权边界，说明任务效用与合规性并不相关。隐私行为还会随 harness 实现、攻击面类型和社区状态（固定或演化）显著变化，表明记忆、文件、工具与组合工作流都可能成为把受保护信息带出授权范围的载体。论文结论是，任务成功率不能作为安全性的代理指标，社区环境下的授权仍是持久化 LLM agent 尚未解决的安全难题。该工作适合关注 agent 安全、多租户隐私、授权建模与评测方法的研究者和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 企业级 agent 正从单轮助手走向带记忆、文件与工具的多用户长期协作体，传统单用户评测会系统性高估其安全性。CoSec 把「任务效用 ≠ 合规」变成可度量结论，并给出可复用的执行轨迹级授权验证思路，可直接迁移到内部红队与多租户 agent 上线前评估。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面覆盖企业 Copilot / 办公助手、多租户 SaaS agent、社区与团队级 RAG 与长期记忆系统、MCP 等工具链的授权设计，以及 agent 平台的会话隔离与审计能力建设；其场景建模方法也可用于内部隐私合规测试集构建。
detection_signals_zh: 执行轨迹中出现超出当前授权状态的受保护信息读取或回显（跨会话、跨用户、跨社区）
持久记忆写入/检索时携带了本不应进入该记忆范围的其他参与者数据
工具调用或文件访问的参数、返回值中夹带受保护字段
组合工作流中前置步骤合法、后续步骤将数据传递给无权限的会话或角色
社区成员/角色变更后，旧授权状态仍被继续使用（授权状态未及时刷新）
环境内容（文档、网页、他人留言）诱导 agent 把受保护信息转发到低权限上下文
defense_advice_zh: 把授权状态（主体、角色、社区成员关系、有效期）作为一等对象，在每次记忆读写、文件访问和工具调用前重新校验，而非依赖会话初始化时的快照
对记忆与文件按数据归属者打标签，实施基于标签的访问控制与跨社区传播阻断
对工具输出与工作流中间结果做统一的信息流审计，避免合法前置步骤被用作越权跳板
在平台侧持续记录并保留执行轨迹与产物，用于事后越权取证与回归测试
将「任务成功率」与「隐私/授权合规率」拆分为两个独立 KPI，禁止用前者替代后者
上线前用多用户、演化边界（成员/角色变更）场景做红队测试，覆盖固定与动态两类社区状态
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并纳入内部 agent 平台的隐私与授权评估流程

items.title: AutoMark: Enabling Autoresearch to Discover Better LLM Watermarks
items.summary: With LLM watermarking being deployed commercially and now required by regulations, improving its reliability and effectiveness has become crucial. Yet, recent progress in the field of LLM watermarking has increasingly been driven by improving details of existing methods, an effort fundamentally limited by the pace of human researchers. In this work, we enable for the first time the autonomous discovery of new distortion-free state-of-the-art watermarking schemes. To enable this, we (i) establish strict criteria to ensure that watermarks are reliable (e.g., they do not have an unexpectedly high false positive rate), (ii) propose rigorous statistical tests to automatically evaluate whether a watermarking scheme satisfies our criteria, and (iii) design an evaluation suite to rank watermarks along three key dimensions: detectability, quality, and robustness. By running our framework with 3 frontier models (GPT-6 Astra, Opus 5, Gemini-3.8 Flash), we discover over 50 different watermarking schemes, including several that outperform prior works along all key dimensions. We complement this by a manual study of the discovered schemes, distilling the key ideas into smaller components, and individually studying the impact of each component across dimensions (detectability, quality, robustness) to better understand how the proposed schemes operate. Importantly, we find that the agents, on top of improving existing ideas, also discover fundamentally new ideas (e.g., aligning watermark scores with random per-request direction). Overall, our work establishes the first steps of fully autonomous watermarking research, enabling the discovery of more reliable and effective watermarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/eth-sri/automark, and a blogpost to visualize our results at https://www.sri.inf.ethz.ch/blog/automark.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文《AutoMark: Enabling Autoresearch to Discover Better LLM Watermarks》研究如何让自动化研究代理（autoresearch agents）自主发现新的、更优的大语言模型（LLM）文本水印方案。背景是：LLM 水印已在商业场景中部署，并被监管要求强制使用，但该领域的进展长期依赖人类研究者逐个改进已有方法的细节，迭代速度受限于人力。作者提出 AutoMark 框架，首次实现「无失真（distortion-free）且达到当前最优水平」的水印方案的自动发现。框架由三部分构成：(i) 一套严格的水印可靠性判据，确保新方案不会出现异常高的误报率等可靠性问题；(ii) 严格的统计检验方法，用于自动判定某个水印方案是否满足上述判据；(iii) 一个评估套件，从可检测性（detectability）、生成质量（quality）、鲁棒性（robustness）三个关键维度对水印方案进行排序打分。作者用 3 个前沿模型（GPT-6 Astra、Opus 5、Gemini-3.8 Flash）运行该框架，共发现 50 多种不同的水印方案，其中若干方案在全部关键维度上都超越了此前的工作。除自动搜索外，作者还对发现的方案做了人工分析，把其中的关键思想拆解为更小的组件，并逐个研究每个组件在可检测性、质量和鲁棒性维度上的影响，以理解这些方案为何有效。值得注意的是，代理不仅能改进已有思路，还发现了原理上全新的想法，例如让水印评分与「每次请求随机生成的方向」对齐。该工作为完全自主的水印研究奠定了基础，代码与可视化博客均已公开。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 水印是 LLM 内容溯源与监管合规的核心技术，其误报率直接影响误判与法律风险。该工作表明自动化代理可发现更可靠、更强的水印方案，同时其「自动评估+严格统计检验」范式对蓝队评估自家水印的可靠性具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到三类场景：一是 LLM 服务商在选择/评估水印方案时，借用其可检测性-质量-鲁棒性三维评估与统计检验流程；二是内容溯源与 AI 生成文本鉴别团队，用于理解更强水印带来的检测与反检测格局变化；三是自动化研究（autoresearch）方法本身可迁移到其他安全机制（如越狱防护、指纹、隐写）的自动化搜索与评估。
detection_signals_zh: 生成文本中 token 分布存在与检测密钥相关的统计偏置（水印可检测性的本质信号）
自动化代理在短时间内批量提交大量候选水印方案并伴随大规模统计评估请求（研究/扫描类行为特征）
defense_advice_zh: 在采用任何新水印方案前，按论文提出的思路先验证其误报率上界，避免高误报导致误判正常用户内容
把可检测性、生成质量、鲁棒性作为联合指标评估，避免为提升鲁棒性而牺牲文本质量或误报率
对水印检测结果设置人工复核与申诉通道，水印判定不应作为内容溯源的唯一证据
关注自动化搜索出的水印方案是否公开，评估其被逆向或规避后对现有检测能力的冲击
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Deep Learning Latency Attacks and Defenses: A Cross-Domain Survey of Availability Threats
items.summary: Adversarial machine learning has focused mainly on integrity, but availability is an increasingly consequential complement. Latency attacks (also energy-latency attacks) increase inference-time work, energy, or response time, causing deadline misses, throughput collapse, or resource exhaustion in vehicle controllers, interactive services, or battery-powered sensors, sometimes while preserving the nominal prediction. This survey unifies a fragmented literature spanning perception pipelines (including physical attacks on autonomous-driving detection and tracking), input-adaptive neural inference (sponge examples, dynamic networks), and autoregressive and agentic systems (output-length, verbose-image, and reasoning denial-of-service attacks on LLMs, VLMs, mixture-of-experts models, and tool-using agents). We organize attacks by exploited computational bottleneck rather than formulation, separating what makes a computation expensive from how the attacker triggers it; the delivery channel (input, prompt or retrieved content, message, poisoning, or weight tampering) is an orthogonal attribute. Many attacks share one mechanism, intermediate-work amplification, motivating a work-budget defense abstraction; we distinguish caps on the work entering an expensive stage from caps on the results leaving it. We further analyze when a model-level cost increase becomes a system-level availability failure, which depends on critical-path share, slack, existing ceilings, accumulation, resource sharing, and fallback policy, not on the amplification factor alone. We also provide a threat-model taxonomy, consolidated quantitative comparisons, a defense review by control mechanism, and open challenges such as standardized evaluation, physical realizability, and whole-system availability. Companion website: https://github.com/guzonghua/awesome-latency-attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该综述论文系统梳理了深度学习领域中长期被忽视的「可用性」威胁——延迟攻击（latency attack，亦称能耗-延迟攻击）。作者指出，对抗机器学习研究以往几乎集中在完整性（误分类、后门等），而可用性攻击通过在推理阶段额外增加计算量、能耗或响应时间，造成截止时间错过、吞吐量崩塌或资源耗尽，且在很多情况下模型的最终预测结果仍然保持正常，因而极难被常规准确率监控发现。受影响场景包括车载控制器、交互式在线服务以及电池供电的传感器节点。

论文把分散在三条技术脉络上的文献统一起来：其一是感知流水线，包括针对自动驾驶检测与跟踪的物理世界攻击；其二是输入自适应神经推理，如 sponge examples 与动态网络/早退网络；其三是自回归与智能体系统，包括针对大语言模型、视觉语言模型、混合专家模型以及可调用工具的智能体的输出长度型、冗长图像型与推理拒绝服务型攻击。

在组织方式上，作者刻意不按攻击的数学形式分类，而是按被利用的计算瓶颈分类，从而把「是什么让计算变贵」与「攻击者如何触发它」这两件事区分开来；同时将投递通道（输入、提示词或检索内容、通信消息、数据投毒、权重篡改）作为正交属性单独刻画。作者观察到大量攻击共享同一底层机制——中间工作量放大（intermediate-work amplification），据此提出「工作预算（work-budget）」这一防御抽象，并明确区分两类控制：限制进入昂贵阶段的计算量，与限制从昂贵阶段流出的结果量。

论文进一步分析模型层面的成本上升何时会演化为系统层面的可用性失败，指出这取决于关键路径占比、系统松弛度、既有资源上限、负载累积效应、资源共享方式以及回退策略，而不能仅由放大倍数推断。主要贡献包括：威胁模型分类法、汇总后的定量对比、按控制机制组织的防御综述，以及标准化评测、物理可实现性与全系统可用性等开放问题。配套资源站点已公开。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 蓝队长期只监测准确率与完整性，延迟/能耗型攻击可在预测正确的前提下击穿 SLO。该综述提供了统一的威胁建模视角与工作预算防御抽象，可直接用于 LLM 服务、Agent 工具链与车载/边缘推理的可用性防护设计。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于大模型推理服务与 API 网关（输出长度、推理链长度、MoE 路由放大）、Agent/工具调用链、自动驾驶感知流水线、边缘与电池供电传感器；可迁移到限流、配额、超时预算、降级回退等容量与 SRE 控制面设计。
detection_signals_zh: 相同或近似输入的推理时延、能耗、GPU/CPU 占用显著偏离基线，但输出内容质量无明显变化
单请求生成 token 数、推理链步数或思维链长度异常膨胀，尾延迟 P95/P99 抬升
混合专家模型中单请求激活的专家数量或路由分支数异常增多
Agent 工具调用轮次、重试次数或对话轮数异常增长并触发循环
检索内容或提示词中出现刻意引导冗长计算、重复展开的构造
批处理吞吐量骤降、排队长度上升、请求截止时间（deadline）错过率升高
单车载/边缘设备的能耗曲线与该任务历史能耗分布显著背离
defense_advice_zh: 实施工作预算（work-budget）控制：既限制进入昂贵阶段的工作量（如 token/专家/分支预算），也限制离开该阶段的结果量（如输出长度上限、截断与压缩）
为推理请求设置硬性超时、最大生成长度、最大工具调用轮次与最大推理步数，并配置超限后的确定性降级策略
评估关键路径占比与系统松弛度，确认模型级成本放大是否会传导为端到端可用性失败；对共享资源做租户级配额与隔离
对不可信输入通道（用户提示、检索内容、外部消息、上游数据）做统一校验与来源标记，防止通过投递通道触发计算放大
对感知与自动驾驶流水线增加物理世界扰动的鲁棒性测试与推理时延监控，将时延/能耗纳入上线验收指标
把时延与能耗纳入模型与服务的既有关注指标（与准确率并列），建立异常放大检测与告警规则
准备容量规划与回退策略（排队、降级模型、缓存、异步化），避免单点请求拖垮整体吞吐

items.title: Distillation Defenses Easily Break After Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Distillation attacks copy the reasoning capabilities of closed-source large language models, allowing bad actors to replicate state-of-the-art performance at low cost. Attackers systematically collect a large volume of frontier model reasoning traces and then train (i.e., "distill") their own models on these traces. Existing defenses against distillation attacks are typically evaluated immediately after distillation, implicitly assuming attackers do not train their models any further. In this paper, we argue that a more realistic threat model includes further training with reinforcement learning after distillation. A misspecified threat model can give a false sense of security -- some defenses that seem effective after distillation can be broken after subsequent reinforcement learning. Practically, reinforcement learning lowers the bar for a distillation attack to be effective. We show that simple attacks can steal reasoning capabilities from existing closed-source language models using data easily obtainable from current APIs, yielding reasoning improvements equivalent to more sophisticated attacks that extract the full hidden traces. Results indicate that any distillation defense that leaks sufficient information to reconstruct approximate reasoning traces is likely ineffective. We conclude by discussing broader implications and batch-level distillation defenses which could be more effective.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了针对大语言模型蒸馏攻击的防御措施在攻击者后续进行强化学习训练时失效的问题。蒸馏攻击指攻击者系统性地收集闭源前沿模型的推理轨迹，并以此训练自己的模型，从而以低成本复制其推理能力。现有防御通常只在蒸馏完成后立即评估，隐含假设攻击者不会进一步训练。本文指出更现实的威胁模型应包含蒸馏后的强化学习微调。作者论证，威胁模型设定不当会带来虚假安全感：一些在蒸馏后看似有效的防御，在后续RL训练后可能被突破。实践上，RL降低了蒸馏攻击生效的门槛。他们展示，简单攻击即可利用当前API容易获取的数据从现有闭源语言模型中窃取推理能力，其推理提升效果等同于那些提取完整隐藏轨迹的更复杂攻击。结果表明，任何泄漏足以重建近似推理轨迹信息的蒸馏防御很可能无效。最后讨论了更广泛的影响以及可能更有效的批量级蒸馏防御。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示现有蒸馏防御评估的盲区：忽略攻击者后续RL训练会导致虚假安全感。安全团队在评估模型窃取与知识蒸馏风险时，应将持续训练/微调纳入威胁模型，并优先考虑批量级防御与输出信息最小化，避免仅依赖蒸馏后单点评估。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面：闭源模型提供商的API策略、模型水印与输出过滤、蒸馏防御评估流程。可迁移至模型提取、知识蒸馏防护、LLM供应链安全等场景。
detection_signals_zh: 异常高频的API推理请求，尤其是针对复杂推理任务
输出内容与已知闭源模型高度相似
模型在后续RL训练后推理能力突然提升且风格接近特定模型
defense_advice_zh: 在威胁模型中包含蒸馏后的强化学习阶段
采用批量级蒸馏防御，而非仅单样本输出过滤
限制API返回完整推理链
对输出进行水印或扰动，增加重建近似推理轨迹的难度
持续监测模型输出分布与API使用模式
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Before Acting, Change the State: Prospective State Intervention for Web Agents under Deceptive Interfaces
items.summary: LLM-based Web agents can autonomously complete user tasks, yet deceptive interfaces can steer them toward outcomes that conflict with users' interests. Existing defenses primarily intervene on agent behavior through blocking, guidance, or replanning. We identify a distinct failure mode: a task-valid action can still realize an unauthorized consequence because of the current Web state. This motivates treating task-relevant Web state itself as a runtime control target. We introduce Veer, an agent-side runtime defense that leaves task planning to the base agent and intervenes on Web state when a proposed action would produce an unauthorized consequence. Before modifying the live environment, Veer constructs a prospective intervention trajectory toward a safe task-relevant state and executes it with runtime grounding and verification. Across TrickyArena and WebDecept, Veer achieves the highest safe task completion in all three evaluation settings, exceeding the next-best defense by 15.9 and 25.0 percentage points on TrickyArena-Single and TrickyArena-Multi, respectively, while reducing dark-pattern success on WebDecept to 0.3%. These gains persist across dark-pattern types and all 12 agent, model, and benchmark configurations. Ablations show that active state intervention provides the largest gain, while prospective rollout and temporal evidence contribute additional improvements. These results establish task-relevant Web state as an effective runtime control target for protecting Web agents from deceptive outcomes.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文关注 LLM 驱动的 Web 智能体（Web Agent）在真实网页环境中执行用户任务时的安全性问题。作者指出，现有的防御手段主要集中在「行为层」——即对智能体即将执行的动作进行拦截、引导或重新规划，但这类方法忽略了一种独立的失效模式：某个动作在任务语义上完全合法（task-valid），却可能因为当前网页所处的状态而触发用户未授权的后果。例如点击一个看似常规的按钮，在特定页面状态下会导致下单、授权或数据外泄等不可逆结果。因此论文提出把「与任务相关的网页状态」本身当作运行时控制目标，而非只控制动作序列。

为此作者设计了 Veer：一种部署在智能体一侧的运行时防御机制。Veer 将任务规划完全交给底层智能体，不干预其正常决策流程；只有当智能体提出的某个动作会产生未授权后果时，才进行干预。干预方式不是直接封锁动作，而是在真正修改线上环境之前，先构造一条「前瞻性干预轨迹」（prospective intervention trajectory），把环境引导到一个安全的、与任务相关的状态，再在该目标状态下执行动作；整个过程依赖运行时接地（runtime grounding）与验证，确保状态变更真实生效且符合预期。

实验方面，作者在两个基准（TrickyArena 与 WebDecept）上进行评估。Veer 在全部三种评测设定下取得最高的「安全任务完成率」，在 TrickyArena-Single 和 TrickyArena-Multi 上分别比次优防御方案高出 15.9 和 25.0 个百分点；在 WebDecept 上把暗黑模式（dark pattern）攻击的成功率压低到 0.3%。这些收益在不同类型的暗黑模式以及全部 12 种智能体、模型与基准组合配置下均保持一致。消融实验表明，「主动状态干预」贡献了最大增益，前瞻性推演（prospective rollout）与时序证据（temporal evidence）带来额外提升。论文由此论证：与任务相关的网页状态是一种有效的运行时控制目标，可用于保护 Web 智能体免受诱导性界面带来的非预期后果。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把 Web 智能体防御的着力点从「拦动作」转向「改状态」，覆盖了合法动作触发越权后果这一常见盲区。对部署浏览器自动化/Agent 的企业而言，这是可直接借鉴的运行时防护思路与评测基准。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于浏览器自动化智能体、RPA、电商/金融/政务类网页流程自动化等场景，尤其是存在不可逆操作（下单、支付、授权、提交表单）的环节；也可迁移到智能体安全评测基准与护栏产品的设计。
detection_signals_zh: 智能体动作在任务语义上合法，但其引发的页面状态变化与用户授权范围不一致（如进入结算、授权、确认提交页面）
页面出现诱导性元素或暗黑模式（伪装按钮、预勾选、倒计时施压、视觉混淆）后紧接着出现高风险动作调用
智能体在同一会话中先执行状态改变类操作（切换账号、改地址、改数量）再立即执行提交/支付类动作
动作执行前后 DOM 关键状态（购物车、权限、表单默认值）发生非用户意图的偏移
defense_advice_zh: 在智能体运行时引入动作前置检查：不仅校验动作合法性，还要校验该动作在当前页面状态下会产生什么后果
对不可逆动作实施状态前置约束（将环境引导至安全状态后再执行），并保留运行时接地与执行结果验证
对暗黑模式 UI 元素建立识别与标记机制，在智能体决策链路中做证据提示
引入时序证据：结合会话历史判断状态变化是否由智能体自身或用户授权引起
在受控沙箱/影子环境中对高风险流程先做前瞻性推演，再放行到真实环境
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：阅读原文与 TrickyArena/WebDecept 基准细节，评估把「前瞻性状态干预」纳入内部 Agent 护栏与红队评测流程的可行性。

items.title: Controlled Decoding Attacks on Black-Box LLMs
items.summary: Manipulating next-token probabilities during generation can bypass the safety alignment of large language models. Existing approaches, however, rely on access to model weights or numerical token probabilities and therefore do not apply to interfaces that return only sampled text. Reconstructing probabilities from sampled outputs offers a possible alternative, but finite sampling produces sparse and noisy estimates, while repeating this process at every generation step incurs substantial query costs. Our empirical observations suggest that large distributional changes along successful jailbreak trajectories are concentrated at a small subset of positions, motivating selective control. We introduce \method{}, a framework for jailbreaking through text-only continuation interfaces that permit repeated sampling and assistant-prefix continuation. Sample-Based Distribution Reconstruction combines sampled outputs with a prior over unobserved actions to obtain a usable control signal. Risk-Gated Residual Control uses the evolving response prefix to decide when to reconstruct and modify the distribution, concentrating sampling costs at selected positions. Speculative Multi-Token Execution further amortizes target calls by verifying and accepting draft prefixes that require no intervention. Across four target endpoints and three benchmarks, \method{} achieves the highest mean score most comparisons against baselines.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注大模型安全对齐在解码阶段的脆弱性: 操纵生成过程中的下一个 token 概率分布可以绕过对齐约束。但已有方法普遍依赖模型权重或数值化的 token 概率(logprobs), 因此对只返回采样文本的黑盒接口完全无效。作者尝试从采样输出反向重建概率分布, 然而有限次采样得到的估计既稀疏又噪声大, 而若在每一个生成步都重复采样, 查询开销又高到不可接受。论文的经验观察指出, 在成功越狱的轨迹上, 分布层面的显著变化只集中在少数位置上, 因此无需全程控制, 只需在关键位置介入即可, 这构成了全文的核心动机——选择性控制。基于此, 作者提出一个面向纯文本续写接口的越狱研究框架, 适用于允许重复采样并提供 assistant 前缀续写能力的端点, 由三个组件构成: 其一是基于采样的分布重建, 将采样结果与关于未观测动作的先验相结合, 得到可用的控制信号, 以缓解采样稀疏与噪声问题; 其二是风险门控的残差控制, 利用不断演化的回复前缀估计当前步的风险, 决定何时执行分布重建与修改, 从而把昂贵的采样预算集中到少数被选中的位置; 其三是投机式多 token 执行, 通过校验并接受无需干预的草稿前缀来摊销对目标端点的调用次数, 进一步降低总体查询成本。实验覆盖四个目标端点与三个基准, 与多个基线对比, 该框架在多数比较中取得最高平均分。论文属于攻击面研究, 用以揭示黑盒部署形态下的对齐风险, 适合红队与对齐研究者、LLM 安全评测与防护工程团队, 以及对外提供模型 API 的平台风控方阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它说明仅隐藏权重与 logprobs、只暴露文本采样接口并不足以形成防护: 攻击面可从数值概率转移到采样行为本身。防守方需要把重复采样频率、关键位置查询突增、前缀续写等行为纳入滥用检测与成本限流。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有提供纯文本生成或 assistant 前缀续写的模型服务, 尤其是开放重复采样与高并发调用的商业化 API。可迁移到自动化越狱评测、对齐鲁棒性基准测试, 以及黑盒条件下的对抗性生成分布评估场景。
detection_signals_zh: 同一会话或同一提示在短时间内被高频重复采样, 且采样温度、top-p 等参数被反复试探
请求集中在回复的少数几个位置进行续写或重采样, 而非正常的整段续写
使用 assistant 前缀预填充并要求模型从中途继续生成的异常调用模式
会话中出现大量语义近似但前缀不同的续写请求, 疑似在估计输出分布
单个账户的 token 消耗与查询次数显著偏离正常交互基线
defense_advice_zh: 对重复采样与前缀续写接口实施速率限制与查询预算配额, 按账户与会话维度统计异常用量
在风控侧对高频重采样、局部续写等行为建立行为指纹并告警, 而非仅依赖输入内容过滤
评估在返回文本前对输出分布做轻微扰动或截断的代价与收益, 降低采样可重建分布的可用性
将黑盒采样型越狱纳入常规红队与对齐评测流程, 定期测量自身端点在纯文本接口下的绕过率
为敏感能力接口保留服务端可控的中途拒绝与二次审核能力, 避免仅依赖单次前置对齐
对安全关键场景优先使用具备更强推理期防护的部署形态, 并对齐监控前缀演化中的风险信号

items.title: FinRT: Distilling Adaptive Red-Teaming Strategies into Reusable Adversarial Generators in Consumer Finance
items.summary: In regulated industries like consumer finance, seemingly harmless user queries can exploit large language model vulnerabilities, triggering safety failures and pushing responses dangerously close to policy limits. Existing automated red-teaming methods trade off attack effectiveness against generation cost, while treating coverage, severity, and diversity as incidental rather than joint objectives. We introduce FinRT, a structured framework that builds reusable adversarial prompt generators from adaptive red-teaming strategies. Across the six victim models in consumer finance, FinRT substantially outperforms adaptive search baselines while amortizing target-facing attack generation into a reusable generator. FinRT nearly doubles the attack success rate over the adaptive baseline Rainbow Teaming (32.9% vs. 17.2%), increases maximum adversarial severity by 33%, and preserves comparable intra-policy-domain semantic diversity to iterative search methods. Our method achieves high cross-model transferability while exhibiting distinct victim-family specialization patterns.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于受监管行业（尤其是消费金融）中大语言模型的安全失效问题：一些表面上完全无害的用户提问，可能触发模型的安全漏洞，使回答在合规政策边界上逼近甚至越界，带来监管与声誉风险。作者指出，现有自动化红队方法普遍在“攻击有效性”与“生成成本”之间做取舍——基于迭代自适应搜索的方法虽然有效，但每次攻击都需要针对目标模型反复查询、成本高昂；而一次性生成的提示模板又往往效果有限。同时，这些方法把覆盖度、严重度和多样性当作顺带产物，而非联合优化的目标。为此，论文提出 FinRT 框架，其核心思路是把自适应红队搜索过程中学到的策略“蒸馏”为可复用的对抗提示生成器：先在受害模型上执行自适应搜索以发现有效的攻击策略，再将这些策略固化成生成器，使面向目标的攻击生成成本被摊销，之后无需再对目标模型做高开销的迭代搜索即可批量产出对抗提示。作者在消费金融场景下的六个受害模型上做了评测：FinRT 将攻击成功率从自适应基线 Rainbow Teaming 的 17.2% 提升至 32.9%，接近翻倍；最大对抗严重度提升约 33%；同时在单一政策域内的语义多样性上，与迭代搜索类方法保持相当水平。此外，FinRT 生成的策略表现出较高的跨模型迁移能力，并呈现出针对不同受害模型家族的专化模式。该工作同时给出了可复用的红队生成范式与一组可比较的评测指标（攻击成功率、严重度、多样性、迁移性），对模型安全评估与合规加固具有参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把红队攻击从“每次都要对目标模型反复搜索”变成“一次蒸馏、反复复用”，显著降低了攻击生成成本并提升成功率，意味着防守方面对的对抗提示生产会更快、更规模化。同时给出了消费金融合规边界下的量化评测口径，便于内部 LLM 安全基线对比。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于消费金融、保险、医疗、法务等强监管领域的 LLM 安全评测与合规红线校验；可迁移为模型上线前的对抗回归测试集、供应商模型横向对比基准，以及针对不同模型家族的分族加固与监控策略。
detection_signals_zh: 同一会话或短时间内出现大量语义相近但措辞持续变体的金融问询，呈现模板化改写特征
提问逐步逼近合规政策边界（如诱导给出确定性投资建议、规避适当性约束）的渐进式试探序列
跨多个不同厂商/家族模型对同类策略进行批量探测的行为模式
对模型输出中'接近但不越过'政策红线的回答进行反复微调重试的交互特征
defense_advice_zh: 将可复用对抗生成器纳入上线前与模型迭代后的自动化回归评测，持续跟踪攻击成功率与严重度变化
建立分模型家族的差异化防护与评测，不要假设单一模型的加固策略可覆盖全部部署模型
对跨模型迁移性高的策略类型优先加固，因其更可能被低成本复制到其他模型
在推理侧对渐进式边界试探与大规模模板化改写请求做限流、聚类与人工复核
把'接近政策边界'的输出单独打标并纳入合规审计样本，而非仅关注明确越界案例
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并评估纳入内部 LLM 安全评测与合规回归流程

items.title: Trajectory-Level Security Debt in LLM Coding Agents
items.summary: LLM coding agents can traverse hundreds of intermediate code states before submitting a solution. Evaluating only the final artifact leaves the evolution of security findings unmeasured. We introduce the Security Debt Line Integral (SDLI), which accumulates static-analysis risk when an agent reaches a new best test pass ratio. We instantiate it with four static application security testing (SAST) tools and study artifacts from 830 passing SWE-bench runs, 712 ProgramBench final workspaces, and 13 public MirrorCode trajectories. The two large populations use the final-state special case of SDLI. Two-tool Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) class agreement occurs in 3.9% of SWE-bench runs and 26.2% of the 80 ProgramBench runs passing at least 90% of official tests. These are scanner findings, not validated vulnerability rates. Excluding three advisory-heavy classes reduces the latter rate to 6.2%. Same-task runs differ in their measured scores, while one reconstructed ProgramBench run exposes persistent findings from its first implementation write. A repair case study reduces the scanner signal while preserving tested behavior, but also reveals sensitivity to equivalent API rewrites. SDLI offers a way to study progress and security findings together. Its value for steering agents and confirming exploitable vulnerabilities remains to be established.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注LLM编码智能体（coding agent）在解决任务过程中产生的安全债务问题。作者指出，编码智能体在提交最终方案前会经过数百个中间代码状态，而现有评测通常只看最终产物，导致安全发现（security findings）随轨迹演化的过程完全未被度量。为此，论文提出“安全债务线积分”（Security Debt Line Integral, SDLI），其核心思想是：当智能体在测试通过比例上达到新的最佳值时，累积其静态分析风险，从而把“功能进展”与“安全债”放在同一坐标下观测。作者用四个静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具实例化SDLI，并分析了三类数据：830次通过的SWE-bench运行、712个ProgramBench最终工作区、13条公开MirrorCode轨迹；后两类大规模数据使用SDLI的终态特例。实验显示，两种工具在CWE类别上的一致性在SWE-bench运行中仅3.9%，在至少通过90%官方测试的80次ProgramBench运行中为26.2%；剔除三个以“建议/告警”为主的类别后，后者降至6.2%。作者特别强调这些是扫描器发现，而非经过验证的漏洞率。同一任务的不同运行之间测量分数存在差异，一个重建的ProgramBench运行还暴露出首次实现写入即引入且持续存在的发现。修复案例研究表明可降低扫描器信号并保持测试行为，但也揭示了对等价API重写的敏感性。SDLI为同时研究任务进展与安全发现提供了方法，但其用于引导智能体和确认可利用漏洞的价值仍有待建立。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能体生成的代码安全不能只看最终提交；中间状态的安全债务会持续累积。该工作给出可量化的轨迹级指标，提醒安全团队将SAST前移到每一步测试通过的时刻，并谨慎解读多工具扫描结果。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到CI/CD中的编码智能体评测、IDE内Agent安全门禁、SWE-bench类基准的安全度量；对采用多SAST工具扫描AI生成代码的团队有直接参考价值。
detection_signals_zh: 同一任务多次运行的SAST告警数量或严重度差异显著
测试通过率创新高时伴随新的CWE类别告警出现
首次实现写入引入的缺陷在后续轨迹中持续存在
不同SAST工具对同一代码给出矛盾的CWE类别判定
defense_advice_zh: 在编码智能体流水线中对中间代码状态做SAST，而非仅扫描最终产物
引入SDLI类轨迹级指标并纳入CI门禁，监控安全债务随测试进展的累积
使用多工具交叉验证，但对CWE类别一致率低保持警惕，避免单工具结论
对等价API重写与修复案例做回归扫描，防止扫描信号变化被误读为安全改善
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进 / 纳入内部评估

items.title: JevVibe: Efficient Classification-Guided Secure Code Generation
items.summary: Large language models can generate functionally correct code that still contains security weaknesses, motivating repair pipelines that first diagnose a weakness type before deciding how to fix it. The Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) provides a standardized vocabulary for such diagnoses, but asking an autoregressive language model to generate a CWE label and extracting it from the response raises questions about output validity, speed, and cost, as well as accuracy. We evaluate Jev, a decision model that instead selects directly from a declared set of candidates and returns a probability for each, against six open-weight autoregressive models and a frontier proprietary model, GPT-5.6-Sol, on a controlled 50-way CWE classification task over 1,916 CyberSecEval benchmark examples. Jev outperforms all six open-weight baselines on every classification and ranking metric, while its comparison with GPT-5.6-Sol depends on the metric: GPT-5.6-Sol achieves higher Top-1 accuracy and Macro-F1, whereas Jev achieves higher Top-3 and Top-5 accuracy and a nearly identical MRR, at $6.27\times$ lower median API latency and $55.9\times$ lower estimated API cost. We further build JevVibe, a diagnosis-guided repair agent that uses predicted CWE labels to repair code generated by Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct. With Jev providing the diagnosis, the agent increases the detector-measured security pass rate from 63.5% before repair to 70.7%, compared with 66.1% for LLM-guided repair. These results show that JevVibe is effective at improving the security of generated code, with Jev providing reliable and efficient CWE classification.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注大语言模型代码生成中的安全弱点问题：模型可以产出功能正确、但隐含安全缺陷的代码，因此业界倾向于采用「先诊断弱点类型、再决定修复方式」的两阶段修复流水线。Common Weakness Enumeration（CWE）为这类诊断提供了标准化词汇表，但让自回归语言模型直接生成 CWE 标签、再从自然语言响应中把标签抽取出来，会同时带来输出合法性、推理速度、调用成本与分类准确率四方面的不确定性。作者为此评估了 Jev——一个决策式（判别式）模型：它不从零生成标签文本，而是在预先声明的候选集合中直接做选择，并为每个候选返回一个概率分布。实验在受控的 50 类 CWE 分类任务上展开，测试集为 1,916 条 CyberSecEval 基准样本，对照对象包括六个开源权重自回归模型以及一个前沿专有模型 GPT-5.6-Sol。结果显示：Jev 在所有分类与排序指标上均优于六个开源基线；与 GPT-5.6-Sol 的比较则依指标而异——GPT-5.6-Sol 的 Top-1 准确率与 Macro-F1 更高，而 Jev 的 Top-3、Top-5 准确率更高、MRR 几乎持平，同时其中位 API 延迟低 6.27 倍、估算 API 成本低 55.9 倍。在此基础上，作者构建了 JevVibe：一个由诊断结果引导的修复代理（agent），使用 Jev 预测出的 CWE 标签去修复 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 生成的代码。当诊断由 Jev 提供时，代理把检测器测得的安全通过率从修复前的 63.5% 提升到 70.7%；作为对比，由 LLM 引导的修复仅达到 66.1%。论文由此论证 JevVibe 能有效提升生成代码的安全性，而 Jev 提供了可靠且高效的 CWE 分类能力。适合从事 AI 代码安全、LLM 应用安全与安全编码自动化研究的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 把 LLM 编码助手引入生产流水线的团队，普遍卡在「弱点诊断」这一环：既要标签准确，又要能承受大规模调用的成本与延迟。该工作给出了判别式 CWE 分类器在成本与延迟上大幅优于前沿模型的量化证据，并提供了一个可复现的修复闭环基线（安全通过率 63.5%→70.7%），对设计 AI 代码安全门禁与自动修复流程具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至 AI 代码生成的安全门禁、CI/CD 中的自动修复代理、SAST 告警的弱点归类与优先级排序、以及代码审查助手的诊断模块。尤其适合需要在成本敏感或高并发场景下批量做 CWE 归类的团队。
defense_advice_zh: 在代码生成流水线中采用「诊断—修复」两阶段设计：先用专用分类模型确定弱点类型，再驱动修复策略，而非让单一模型端到端自由生成。
对修复后的代码使用独立的第三方安全检测器复测，避免以生成模型自我评估作为唯一验收依据。
将安全通过率（修复前 / 修复后）纳入内部基线指标，按模型版本与提示策略持续回归对比。
在引入外部 API 做弱点诊断时，核算延迟与单次调用成本，评估判别式本地小模型作为替代的可行性。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：阅读原文以确认 Jev 的候选集构建方式、50 类 CWE 的选取范围与检测器口径；可在内部代码生成评估中复现「诊断引导修复」对照实验。

items.title: JEV as a Judge for Agent Trace Security: An Empirical Comparison with Generative LLM Judges
items.summary: Security evaluation of tool-using agents requires judging actions in context, yet generative judges add latency, explanation overhead, and output-validation failures. We study whether JEV, a typed decision model, offers a useful alternative for retrospective trace classification. We evaluate JEV and four generative judges on four benchmark collections totaling 5,219 trajectories, using a common risk rubric and behavior-level labels. JEV attains a benchmark-averaged positive-class F1 of 77.8, compared with 74.1 for the strongest generative configuration, GLM-5.2, with valid-result coverage of 95.5\% and 94.4\%, respectively. Performance varies across datasets, with JEV leading on ATBench500 and MCPHunt and GLM leading on R-Judge and TraceSafe. Across the four benchmarks, JEV's median successful-call latency is 0.99 seconds; estimated token cost averages \$0.000195 per valid judgment. These results support JEV as an economical screening signal, with trade-offs in precision and recall.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文研究的是「工具型智能体（tool-using agent）行为轨迹的安全判定」这一评测环节本身的可选方案问题。背景是：对会调用外部工具的智能体做安全评估，必须结合上下文判断每一步动作是否构成风险；当前主流做法是让生成式大模型充当裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge），但这类裁判存在明显工程代价——推理延迟高、需要额外生成解释（解释开销）、以及输出格式不合法导致校验失败的比率偏高，从而影响自动化流水线的稳定性。作者提出并实证检验一个替代思路：JEV，一个带类型约束的判定模型（typed decision model），把它用于回溯式的轨迹分类（retrospective trace classification），即对已经记录下来的智能体行为轨迹做事后风险判定。

方法上，作者在同一套风险评分细则（common risk rubric）和同一套行为级标签下，把 JEV 与四个生成式裁判进行横向对比，评测集为四个基准集合、合计 5,219 条轨迹。核心指标包括正类 F1、有效结果覆盖率（valid-result coverage，即输出可被解析并采信的比例）、成功调用的延迟中位数，以及估算的 token 成本。

主要结果：JEV 的基准平均正类 F1 为 77.8，最强生成式配置 GLM-5.2 为 74.1；有效结果覆盖率分别为 95.5% 与 94.4%。性能在不同数据集间存在明显差异——JEV 在 ATBench500 与 MCPHunt 上领先，GLM 在 R-Judge 与 TraceSafe 上领先，说明不存在单一通吃的裁判方案。工程开销方面，JEV 成功调用的延迟中位数为 0.99 秒，单次有效判定的估算 token 成本平均约 0.000195 美元。作者的结论是：JEV 可作为低成本、低延迟的经济型筛查信号（screening signal），但在精确率与召回率上仍需与生成式裁判权衡取舍。

贡献层面：一是给出了一个跨四个基准、5,219 条轨迹的统一对照实验，把「判定器选择」从经验直觉推进到可量化的成本-效果比较；二是显式引入有效结果覆盖率、延迟中位数与单次判定成本作为与 F1 并列的工程指标；三是明确了数据集依赖的适用边界，指出轻量判定器与生成式判定器更适合组合使用而非相互替代。适合从事智能体安全评测、SOC 自动化流水线设计、以及 LLM-as-a-Judge 可靠性研究的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能体安全审计的瓶颈正从「有没有检测器」转向「判定环节够不够快、够不够便宜、输出能不能被流水线稳定采信」。本文用 5,219 条轨迹的对照数据说明：带类型约束的轻量判定器在 F1 上可略优于大模型裁判，同时延迟约 1 秒、单次成本约 0.0002 美元，为高频轨迹筛查提供了可落地的工程选项；同时明确指出其优势具有数据集依赖性，避免安全团队盲目替换现有判定链路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至智能体行为溯源与事后审计、MCP/工具调用日志的批量风险分级、CI/CD 中的智能体回归安全门禁、以及安全运营中的告警初筛环节；也可用于评估现有 LLM-as-a-Judge 流水线的成本与输出有效性瓶颈。
detection_signals_zh: 判定器输出无法解析/校验失败的比例升高（本文报告有效结果覆盖率约 94.4%-95.5%，即存在约 5% 的不可采信输出）
判定延迟中位数异常抬升，导致轨迹审计队列积压
同一轨迹在不同判定器（轻量判定器 vs 生成式裁判）之间给出不一致结论，形成分歧告警
在特定数据集/业务场景上召回率系统性偏低（本文发现领先优势随数据集反转）
defense_advice_zh: 不要把单一判定器作为最终裁断，建议采用两级结构：轻量判定器做高通量初筛，生成式裁判对高风险或分歧样本复核
在选型时同时记录 F1、有效结果覆盖率、延迟中位数与单次判定成本，而非只看准确率类指标
针对自有业务轨迹先做小规模影子评测，验证判定器在本域数据上的领先/落后方向是否与公开基准一致
为判定器输出设置解析失败与超时的降级路径，避免无效输出静默丢弃造成漏判

items.why_it_matters: 智能体安全审计的瓶颈正从「有没有检测器」转向「判定环节够不够快、够不够便宜、输出能不能被流水线稳定采信」。本文用 5,219 条轨迹的对照数据说明：带类型约束的轻量判定器在 F1 上可略优于大模型裁判，同时延迟约 1 秒、单次成本约 0.0002 美元，为高频轨迹筛查提供了可落地的工程选项；同时明确指出其优势具有数据集依赖性，避免安全团队盲目替换现有判定链路。

items.title: AuxMark: Defending Against Unauthorized Agent Distillation via Auxiliary Behavioral Watermarking
items.summary: Large language model agents can acquire complex capabilities through multi-step interaction and tool use, but their trajectories can also be illegally collected to dis- till student agents. However, existing watermarking methods either do not fit the structured and interactive nature of agent environments or lack reliable effective- ness across tasks and model architectures. We introduce AuxMark, a behavioral watermarking framework for tracing unauthorized agent distillation. AuxMark dynamically inserts safe, non-essential auxiliary action into teacher trajectories, and stores the associated contexts as private evidence cards. To audit a suspicious student model, AuxMark constructs paired real and fake probes from these cards and applies a card-level sign test. This black-box protocol supports both model- level detection and trace-level attribution. Across three agent benchmarks, two teacher agents, and four student architectures, AuxMark detects all 24 distilled models with zero false positives on 48 clean models. It also preserves task utility and remains effective against data flooding, paraphrasing, truncation, and adaptive cleaning attacks. Our code will be released at this URL.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文关注大语言模型智能体（LLM Agent）面临的非法蒸馏（模型窃取）问题：Agent 通过多步交互与工具调用获得复杂能力，但其完整交互轨迹（trajectory）可能被第三方收集，用来训练能力相近的“学生 Agent”，从而绕过授权与收费。作者指出，现有水印方案存在两类缺陷：一是为单轮文本生成设计，无法适配 Agent 场景中结构化、多轮、带工具调用的交互形态；二是跨任务与跨学生模型架构时有效性不稳定，容易被任务迁移或架构差异削弱。

为此，作者提出 AuxMark——一种面向 Agent 蒸馏溯源的行为水印框架。其核心思路是不在文本层面嵌入隐蔽模式，而是在教师 Agent 的交互轨迹中动态插入安全且“非必要”的辅助动作（auxiliary action，即对完成任务并非必须、但不影响任务正确性的行为），并将这些动作对应的上下文保存为私有的“证据卡”（evidence cards）。当需要审计一个可疑的学生模型时，AuxMark 依据证据卡构造成对的真实探针与伪造探针（paired real/fake probes），通过卡片级符号检验（card-level sign test）判断该模型是否对这些水印行为表现出统计上显著的一致性偏好。整个过程是黑盒协议，无需访问模型权重或训练数据，并同时支持两个粒度：模型级检测（该模型是否为蒸馏产物）与轨迹级归因（具体哪些轨迹被用于蒸馏）。

实验方面，作者在三个 Agent 基准、两个教师 Agent 和四种学生架构上进行了评估：AuxMark 成功检测出全部 24 个蒸馏模型，并在 48 个干净模型上实现零误报；同时保持原始任务效用，且在数据洪泛（data flooding）、改写、截断以及自适应清洗（adaptive cleaning）等对抗性规避手段下仍然有效。作者表示代码将后续公开。该工作把“水印/溯源”从文本生成层面扩展到 Agent 行为层面，属于面向模型知识产权保护的防御性研究，适合模型提供方、MaaS 平台、合规与安全审计团队以及 Agent 安全研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Agent 轨迹被非法采集用于蒸馏，是模型提供方与 MaaS 平台现实存在的知识产权与授权合规风险。AuxMark 提供了黑盒、无需权重访问的检测与归因手段，使防御方能够发现并取证未授权的模型蒸馏行为。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于 LLM/Agent 服务的授权审计、模型窃取取证与许可合规验证；也可迁移到工具调用型 Agent 的供应链溯源、第三方 API 转售检测以及模型版权纠纷中的技术证据构建。
detection_signals_zh: 教师 Agent 轨迹中出现对完成任务非必需、但语义安全的辅助动作，可能是水印触发行为
可疑学生模型对成对真实/伪造探针表现出统计上显著的单侧偏好（card-level sign test 显著）
学生模型在某些特定交互模式下与教师行为高度一致，而在其他任务上通用能力并不匹配
第三方模型在数据洪泛、改写或截断清洗后仍保留与特定水印上下文的关联响应
defense_advice_zh: 在对外提供 Agent API/轨迹数据时，评估引入行为级水印以支撑后续溯源与取证
建立模型级与轨迹级的审计流程，对可疑下游模型执行黑盒配对探针检测并留存证据卡
监控对 Agent 轨迹的异常批量抓取、转售或二次训练迹象，将其纳入供应链风险管理
在设计水印时确保辅助动作安全且不影响任务效用，并针对改写、截断、数据洪泛与自适应清洗做鲁棒性验证

items.title: How to Tame a Multi-Headed Hydra? Adaptive Multi-Category Safety Steering for Large Language Models
items.summary: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly widespread, preventing unsafe responses to harmful prompts is essential for their safe deployment. Activation steering offers an approach to improving LLM safety by modifying internal activations during inference without updating model parameters. However, a single prompt can involve multiple harm categories, and steering toward safety in one category may leave harmful content from another unaddressed. Despite advances in adaptive steering, existing methods do not explicitly coordinate steering direction and strength when multiple harm categories co-occur within a single prompt. To address this problem, we propose CAM-Steer, a Category-Adaptive Multi-category Safety Steering framework. Specifically, it estimates the risk associated with each harm category by comparing the current hidden state with safe and unsafe prototypes. The estimated risks are then used to combine the safety directions for different harm categories into a single steering direction and to determine the strength of the intervention. Finally, it rotates the hidden state along the composed steering direction, with the rotation angle determined by the estimated risks, while preserving the hidden-state norm. Experiments across three LLM backbones and seven harm categories show that CAM-Steer outperforms the evaluated baselines in average defense success rate, including when categories co-occur. Further analyses support its component designs and informative risk scores, with negligible inference overhead.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注大语言模型（LLM）部署中的安全对齐问题：当用户输入包含有害意图时，模型可能给出不安全回答。作者指出，现有的激活引导（activation steering）方法虽然在推理阶段通过修改模型内部隐状态来提升安全性、且无需更新参数，但存在一个被忽视的痛点——单条提示词往往同时涉及多个危害类别（如暴力、仇恨、隐私、违法指导等），而只针对某一类别做安全引导，可能使其他类别的有害内容依然漏出。已有的自适应引导方案也没有显式地在多危害类别共现时协调引导方向与引导强度。为此，作者提出 CAM-Steer，一个类别自适应的多类别安全引导框架。其核心思路是：首先将当前隐状态与预先构造的“安全原型”和“不安全原型”做比较，据此估计每个危害类别上的风险分数；然后利用这些风险分数，把多个类别的安全方向加权合成为一个统一的引导方向，同时用风险大小决定干预强度；最后沿合成方向对隐状态做旋转，旋转角度由估计风险决定，并保持隐状态范数不变，以避免破坏模型原有的表征尺度与通用能力。实验覆盖三种 LLM 主干模型与七个危害类别，结果显示 CAM-Steer 在平均防御成功率上优于所评估的基线，且在类别共现场景下同样有效。消融与进一步分析验证了各组件设计的必要性以及风险分数本身携带的有效信息，同时该方法的推理开销可忽略。该工作适合研究 LLM 安全对齐、推理期干预与红队评测的研究者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多数安全引导研究只面向单一危害类别，而真实提示常多类危害交织；该工作给出无需重训、推理期即可按类别自适应协调方向与强度的方案，对 LLM 护栏与对齐工程有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 LLM 推理服务的安全护栏层、越狱/有害内容防御、多标签内容审核策略编排，以及需要在保持模型通用能力前提下做细粒度安全干预的场景。
detection_signals_zh: 对同一提示词的多类别风险分数同时升高（多标签共现）而非单一类别触发
模型隐状态在安全/不安全原型之间的投影距离异常，可作为内部风险探针指标
在施加引导前后，同一提示的拒答率与类别覆盖度出现差异，可暴露单类别引导的漏防
defense_advice_zh: 在护栏设计中采用多类别并行评估，避免只针对单一危害标签做干预
为每类危害构建安全/不安全原型并维护可在线查询的风险分数，作为可观测指标接入监控
在保范数等约束下调优引导强度，并回归测试模型通用能力，防止过度干预导致性能退化
将类别共现样本纳入红队与评测集，单独报告共现场景下的防御成功率
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Confidence-Guided Protocol IR for LLM-Aided Security Protocol Modeling
items.summary: Large language models offer a promising interface for translating natural-language protocol descriptions into formal security models, but their outputs remain difficult to trust without expert validation. In this paper, we present a human-in-the-loop framework for generating Tamarin-verifiable formal models of security protocols. Our key observation is that the main correctness bottleneck is the semantic accuracy rather than the syntactic validity of the intermediate protocol representation. To address this problem, we introduce a protocol intermediate representation (IR) that serves as a human-auditable semantic checkpoint between natural-language parsing and formal model generation. The IR explicitly captures protocol participants, message flows, value provenance, cryptographic operations, proof targets, and compromise assumptions. We further design an interactive interface that highlights uncertain fields and guides users to inspect the most critical semantic decisions based on model confidence before model generation. Rather than replacing formal-methods experts, our approach uses LLMs to produce auditable semantic drafts while leveraging verification tools to check the resulting formal models. Code and verification artifacts are available at https://github.com/laplace1002/TamarinAgent.git.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文研究如何让大语言模型（LLM）可靠地参与安全协议的形式化建模。背景是：安全协议（如认证与密钥交换协议）的安全性通常需要借助 Tamarin 这类形式化验证工具来证明，而把自然语言写的协议描述（RFC、规范文档）翻译成可验证的形式化模型，长期依赖形式化方法专家手工完成，成本高、门槛高。LLM 看起来是天然的翻译接口，但其输出在没有专家校验的情况下难以信任。

作者的核心观察是：真正的正确性瓶颈不在中间协议表示的语法是否合法，而在于语义是否准确——即模型是否错误理解了参与者、消息流向、密钥来源、加密假设或攻击者能力。基于这一判断，论文提出一个人机协同（human-in-the-loop）框架，用于生成可被 Tamarin 验证的安全协议形式化模型。

方法上，作者设计了一种协议中间表示（Protocol IR），作为自然语言解析与形式模型生成之间的“可人工审计的语义检查点”。该 IR 显式刻画六个关键维度：协议参与者、消息流、取值来源与溯源（value provenance）、密码学操作、证明目标（proof targets）以及妥协假设（compromise assumptions，例如长期密钥泄露、会话密钥泄露等攻击者能力设定）。在此基础上，作者进一步设计交互式界面，依据模型自身的置信度（confidence）突出显示不确定字段，引导用户优先检查对最终安全性结论影响最大的语义决策，之后才进入形式模型生成与验证阶段。

论文的定位不是取代形式化方法专家，而是让 LLM 产出可审计的语义草稿，再由 Tamarin 等验证工具对生成的形式模型进行机器检查，形成“LLM 起草 + 人工审计 + 工具验证”的闭环。作者公开了代码与验证工件（GitHub 仓库 TamarinAgent）。摘要未给出具体实验数据、评测基准或定量结果，因此实际提升幅度与局限性需查阅全文确认。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 生成的形式化安全模型若语义错误，会给出虚假的安全结论，直接误导协议设计与合规评估。该工作把审计点前移到可读的协议 IR，并以置信度排序人工复核优先级，为“AI 辅助形式化验证”提供了可落地的可信化流程。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到安全协议/RFC 的形式化验证、TLS/认证协议类标准的建模审计、以及任何 LLM 生成结构化规格的场景（配置基线、访问控制策略、密码学协议实现核对）。对使用 Tamarin/ProVerif 的团队有直接参考价值。
defense_advice_zh: 在引入 LLM 辅助生成协议形式化模型时，设置人工语义审计检查点，不要直接采信 LLM 输出的验证结论。
重点复核 IR 中的参与者身份、取值来源（provenance）与妥协假设三项，这些语义偏差最容易导致虚假的“验证通过”。
把置信度排序作为复核优先级依据，而非安全保证；低置信度字段必须人工确认。
将生成的形式模型纳入版本管理与同行评审，保留 IR 草稿与验证工件以备追溯。
对 LLM 生成结果始终用独立验证工具交叉校验，避免单点信任。

items.title: CyberPersistBench: Evaluating LLM-Based Cyber Attackers on Installation and Persistence
items.summary: While LLM-based attackers exhibit growing proficiency in vulnerability exploitation, most existing cybersecurity benchmarks suffer from single-stage truncation, prematurely terminating evaluation upon initial access. In practice, initial footholds are exceptionally fragile across operational disruptions such as service restarts and host reboots. Whether LLM-based attackers can establish and maintain durable footholds beyond initial compromise remains a central blind spot in cybersecurity evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce CyberPersistBench, the first benchmark dedicated to post-compromise installation and persistence. Decoupled from upfront exploitation, CyberPersistBench frames persistence as an adversarial survival task in which agents use native host mechanisms to maintain footholds across staged system disruptions. Deterministic checks support a six-level scoring method (L1--L6) spanning installation and persistence. The benchmark comprises 203 core tasks across seven categories, augmented by multi-host and active defense extensions. Empirical evaluations across five frontier agents show that autonomous persistence remains limited (27.6%--44.8%) and drops further on defense-enabled tasks (5.5%--13.3%); nonetheless, these results reveal an emerging cyberattack risk, underscoring the necessity of benchmarking post-compromise persistence. CyberPersistBench thus establishes a foundational benchmark for post-compromise installation and persistence, delineating the operational boundaries of autonomous cyber agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文关注 LLM 驱动攻击者在大模型安全评测中的一个明显盲区：持久化能力。现有主流网络安全基准大多采用「单阶段」设计，一旦完成初始访问（initial access）即终止评测，因此在服务重启、主机重启等运维扰动下是否还能保住据点，从未被系统评估。作者指出，真实环境中初始立足点极其脆弱，单纯验证「能否打进去」并不能刻画自主攻击智能体的实际威胁水平，真正决定危害的是「能否留下来」。为填补这一空白，论文提出 CyberPersistBench——据作者所述是首个专门针对「失陷后安装与持久化（post-compromise installation and persistence）」的基准。其设计将持久化与前置漏洞利用解耦，把持久化建模为一种对抗性生存任务：被测智能体需借助目标主机原生机制，在分阶段、逐步升级的系统扰动（如服务重启、主机重启等）中维持据点存活。评测采用确定性检查（deterministic checks）支撑 L1 至 L6 的六级评分体系，覆盖从安装到长期持久化的完整链条，使评分不依赖主观判断、可复现、可横向比较。数据集包含七大类共 203 个核心任务，并额外提供多主机扩展与主动防御（active defense）扩展，用于考察智能体在更复杂环境与蓝队干预下的表现。实证部分评测了五个前沿自主智能体：其自主持久化成功率仅为 27.6%–44.8%，而在开启防御的任务上进一步下降到 5.5%–13.3%。作者认为这一结果既说明当前自主持久化能力仍受限，也揭示了正在显现的网络攻击风险，凸显对失陷后持久化能力进行标准化评测的必要性。论文的贡献在于：提出首个面向失陷后阶段的分级基准、给出可确定性验证的评分方法、构建大规模多类别任务集，并首次以量化方式刻画了自主网络智能体在持久化维度上的能力边界。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 以往评测只看「能否突破」，忽略「能否长期驻留」，会系统性高估攻击门槛、低估智能体威胁。该基准把持久化、多主机与主动防御纳入量化评分，为红蓝对抗评估与自动化防御验证提供了可复现的度量口径，值得安全团队作为能力评估参照。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至三类场景：一是内部 LLM 攻击智能体的能力红线测评与准入；二是蓝队防御有效性验证（在防御开启条件下对比智能体存活率）；三是 SOC 持久化检测覆盖度自评，用分级任务反推检测盲区。多主机扩展对横向移动相关监控亦有参考价值。
detection_signals_zh: 主机持久化面异常：自启动项、计划任务、服务注册、账户与凭据配置的非预期变更

主动防御任务中智能体对防御机制的试探与规避行为所留下的告警序列

在评测与演练中加入重启/服务中断扰动，验证检测规则能否跨越重启持续生效

items.title: INTCC: A Framework for Interactive Confidential Computing
items.summary: Confidential computing leverages Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of data in use. However, TEEs rely on remote attestation to guarantee the integrity of their initial memory state. This model is fundamentally at odds with interactive development workflows. In scenarios like LLM fine-tuning and exploratory data analysis, data processors need human-in-the-loop capabilities, including dynamic code injection, intermediate state inspection, and hyperparameter tuning, all of which inherently violate the static, one-time integrity guarantees of traditional remote attestation. To reconcile this tension, we propose the interactive confidential computing paradigm, a system architecture enabling untrusted data processors to execute dynamic, non-deterministic operations within TEEs without compromising data confidentiality. Driven by the insight that inherently unmeasurable human interaction must be excluded from the Trusted Computing Base (TCB), we logically partition the TEE into an interactive controller and a verifiable runtime. To realize this paradigm, we present INTCC, a framework featuring three key mechanisms: (1) a proxy-based dispatch system to preserve the native development experience; (2) a fine-grained information flow control mechanism based on a security lattice to prevent data leakage; and (3) a privacy-preserving verifiable execution mechanism to guarantee the runtime compliance of dynamic workflows. We implement INTCC on AMD SEV-SNP using Confidential Containers and evaluate it across diverse real-world workloads. Our experiments demonstrate that INTCC effectively balances security and interactivity, incurring a practical overhead of less than 5% for LLM fine-tuning and under 17% for data analysis relative to baseline execution.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文针对机密计算（Confidential Computing）在交互式开发流程中的结构性矛盾提出了新的系统范式。传统上，机密计算依赖 AMD SEV-SNP、Intel TDX 等可信执行环境（TEE）来保护"使用中数据"的机密性与完整性，而 TEE 的完整性保障建立在远程证明（Remote Attestation）之上：只有在启动时对初始内存状态做一次性、静态的度量，才能向数据提供方证明运行环境可信。问题在于，这一"静态、一次性"的信任模型与真实的数据处理工作流严重冲突。论文指出，在 LLM 微调、探索性数据分析等场景中，数据使用方需要人在回路（human-in-the-loop）能力，包括动态注入代码、检查中间状态、调整超参数等。这些操作本质上是动态且非确定性的，一旦允许就会破坏远程证明所承诺的"代码与数据在证明后不再变化"这一前提，导致数据提供方无法继续信任该环境。

为解决这一张力，作者提出"交互式机密计算（interactive confidential computing）"范式：在不牺牲数据机密性的前提下，允许不可信的数据使用方在 TEE 内执行动态、非确定性的操作。其核心洞察是——本质上不可度量的人类交互必须被排除在可信计算基（TCB）之外，因此应将 TEE 逻辑上拆分为"交互控制器"与"可验证运行时"两部分，前者承载不可信的人类决策，后者保持可被验证与度量的确定性。

在此基础上，作者实现了 INTCC 框架，包含三项关键机制：（1）基于代理（proxy）的分发系统，使开发者在保持原生开发体验的同时完成调度；（2）基于安全格（security lattice）的细粒度信息流控制机制，用于防止数据经由动态代码路径泄漏；（3）隐私保护的可验证执行机制，用以保证动态工作流的运行时合规性。作者基于 AMD SEV-SNP 与 Confidential Containers 完成实现，并在多种真实负载上评估。实验表明，INTCC 在安全性与交互性之间取得平衡，相对于基线执行，LLM 微调场景的额外开销低于 5%，数据分析场景低于 17%。

该工作适合关注机密计算、TEE 应用落地、云上数据协作与隐私增强计算的研究者与安全工程师阅读，为"如何在可验证环境中安全开放交互式能力"提供了架构级参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 企业正把机密计算用于跨机构数据协作与模型微调，但一次性远程证明无法覆盖交互式开发。INTCC 给出了可落地的架构思路：把人类交互移出 TCB、用信息流控制约束动态代码，为 TEE 场景下的数据泄漏防护与合规验证提供了可借鉴的设计模式。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至机密容器中的 LLM 微调、多方数据分析、隐私敏感行业的云上开发环境；对使用 AMD SEV-SNP / Confidential Containers 的团队，其代理分发与安全格信息流控制设计可直接作为内部方案评估参考。
detection_signals_zh: TEE 工作负载出现远程证明成功后仍发生运行时内存布局变化或动态代码加载的告警
机密容器内出现非预期的高频交互式调试/状态读取接口调用
信息流控制策略触发的跨安全级别数据访问被拒绝或被降级的审计事件
可疑的代理转发进程在宿主机与机密容器之间建立异常通道
defense_advice_zh: 评估现有 TEE 部署是否混用了交互式开发与生产数据，避免不可信交互被纳入 TCB
在机密容器方案中引入信息流控制与运行时合规校验，而非仅依赖启动时远程证明
对 LLM 微调等跨信任域场景，明确数据使用方的动态操作白名单与审计留痕要求
关注 AMD SEV-SNP 与 Confidential Containers 生态的安全配置基线，定期复核 attestation 策略

items.title: LLM-Assisted Automatic Security Proofs for Cryptographic Protocols: How Far Are We?
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for assisting software and security analysis tasks, yet their effectiveness in cryptographic symbolic protocol verification remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we conduct the first systematic evaluation of the capability of state-of-the-art LLMs in cryptographic symbolic protocol verification. To quantify this capability, we propose \textsc{CRoST} (Coverage Rate of Solve Tree), a proof-based metric derived from the verifier's proof skeleton that measures the similarity between generated lemmas and reference lemmas. We then establish the rationale of \textsc{CRoST} through both theoretical analysis and empirical validation. The evaluation results show that state-of-the-art models achieve 38.82\% coverage on average, with 14.4\% of generated lemmas exceeding 80\% coverage, indicating that LLMs can already generate useful lemmas to a certain extent. However, they still exhibit non-trivial failure modes on complex multi-phase protocols, show diminishing returns under naive scaling, and incur substantial verification overhead. These findings clarify the practical potential and limitations of LLMs for protocol verification and motivate future work on complex real-world protocols.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本文针对一个此前缺乏系统认识的问题展开研究：大语言模型（LLM）在密码协议的符号化验证（symbolic protocol verification）中究竟能起到多大作用。作者指出，LLM 已在软件工程与安全分析任务中表现出较强潜力，但其在密码协议形式化验证这一高度专业化、对正确性要求极严的领域中的实际能力尚不明确，因此开展了（据作者所述）首次系统性评估。

核心方法上，论文提出了一种基于证明的度量指标 CRoST（Coverage Rate of Solve Tree，求解树覆盖率）。该指标从验证器生成的证明骨架（proof skeleton）出发，衡量 LLM 自动生成的引理（lemma）与人工参考引理之间的相似程度，从而把“LLM 辅助验证的效果”量化为可比较的覆盖率数值。作者通过理论分析与实证验证两条路径论证了 CRoST 这一指标的合理性，使其不只是经验性的打分，而具备一定的解释依据。

实验结果显示：当前最先进的模型在协议验证任务上平均仅达到 38.82% 的覆盖率，但其中有 14.4% 的生成引理覆盖率超过 80%，说明 LLM 已经能够在一定程度上产出对验证真正有用的引理，并非完全无效。与此同时，论文揭示了三类明显的失败模式：一是面对复杂的多阶段协议时表现不佳；二是在朴素地扩大模型规模或采样规模时收益递减，暗示单纯 scaling 难以解决问题；三是产生可观的验证开销，即 LLM 生成的候选引理需要形式化验证器反复求解，代价高昂。

论文的贡献可归纳为：给出首个系统性的 LLM 协议验证能力评估、提出并验证 CRoST 度量、量化当前能力上限与失败模式，并据此为面向真实复杂协议的后续研究指明方向（如更好的引理筛选、搜索策略与开销控制）。该工作适合形式化方法与协议安全研究者、以及尝试把 LLM 引入验证工具链的工程团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 很多团队正考虑用 LLM 辅助 Tamarin/ProVerif 这类形式化验证。本文给出量化结论：平均覆盖率不足四成，复杂多阶段协议是短板，且验证开销大——说明当前应把 LLM 定位为引理候选生成器而非验证替代品。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到协议设计评审、安全芯片/物联网协议的形式化验证流程，以及任何以引理生成为瓶颈的验证工具链；也提示在评估 LLM 安全能力时需纳入覆盖率与验证开销两类成本指标。
detection_signals_zh: LLM 生成引理在多阶段协议上 CRoST 覆盖率显著低于单阶段协议
候选引理数量增加但验证通过率提升有限（scaling 收益递减）
形式化验证器求解时间随 LLM 生成引理数量线性或更快增长
defense_advice_zh: 将 LLM 生成的引理一律视为待人工复核的候选，不作为验证通过的依据
在引入 LLM 辅助前先建立人工引理的覆盖率与耗时基线，便于对比净收益
对多阶段、真实世界协议保持人工主导，LLM 仅用于探索性提示
为验证环节预留算力预算并设置求解超时，避免生成引理导致资源耗尽
记录模型/提示/采样配置与对应 CRoST 结果，形成可复现的内部评测集
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：关注其 CRoST 度量与失败模式结论，评估能否纳入内部形式化验证辅助流程的试点

items.title: Planarian: Managing Agent State with Statepoints
items.summary: LLM agents solve complex tasks by iteratively changing files, invoking local tools, and interacting with remote services, which modifies state across their local environment and remote services. Today, agents and users must manage these changes explicitly, whether reverting exploratory actions or recovering from erroneous ones. Doing so safely requires coordinated actions, yet current agent harnesses lack unified abstractions and mechanisms for managing local and remote state consistently and efficiently. We describe Planarian, an agent runtime with state management that enables agents and users to recover from erroneous actions and explore alternative executions over consistent local and remote environment state. Planarian introduces the abstraction of agent statepoints, which are consistent, restorable point-in-time versions of the environment state. Planarian exposes three state-management primitives to agents and users: (i) snapshot creates a new statepoint spanning local and remote state without requiring external services to support checkpoints: it relies on efficient incremental process and file system snapshotting to capture local sandboxed state, and transparently records compensating actions to undo remote state changes; (ii) rollback restores the environment to a previous statepoint by reverting to a prior local checkpoint and replaying compensating actions for remote state changes; and (iii) fork creates multiple isolated branches from a statepoint, enabling the agent to explore alternatives in parallel. We show that Planarian enables agents to undo mistakes and explore alternatives in parallel, improving task quality by up to 15x, and allows users to recover from erroneous actions with only 3% overhead.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对 LLM 智能体在执行复杂任务时不断修改文件、调用本地工具并与远程服务交互，从而在本地环境与远程服务两侧产生大量状态变更的问题。当前智能体框架缺少统一抽象，用户与智能体只能显式管理这些变更，无论是回退探索性操作还是从错误动作中恢复，都难以保证本地与远程状态的一致性与效率。为此，作者提出 Planarian：一个带状态管理能力的智能体运行时，核心抽象是 agent statepoint（智能体状态点），即环境状态在某一时刻的一致、可恢复版本。Planarian 向智能体与用户暴露三种原语：snapshot 在不需要外部服务支持检查点的前提下，跨越本地与远程状态创建新状态点——通过高效的增量进程与文件系统快照捕获本地沙箱状态，并以透明方式记录补偿动作以撤销远程状态变更；rollback 通过回退到先前的本地检查点并重放针对远程状态变更的补偿动作，把环境恢复到早先的状态点；fork 则从某一状态点派生出多个相互隔离的分支，使智能体能够并行探索不同执行路径。实验表明，Planarian 能让智能体撤销错误并并行探索备选方案，将任务质量提升最多 15 倍，同时用户从错误动作中恢复只需约 3% 的额外开销。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能体自主操作会跨本地与远程系统产生副作用，缺乏可靠回滚会放大风险。Planarian 的状态点、回滚与分叉机制为智能体事故恢复、沙箱化探索与审计提供了可借鉴的基础设施，对安全工程与平台防护有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于编码智能体、自动化运维/CI 流水线、调用外部 API 的 Agent 平台等场景；其补偿动作记录与本地快照思路可迁移到需要跨边界一致性回滚的安全沙箱与审计系统。
detection_signals_zh: 智能体运行时中 snapshot/rollback/fork 原语的调用审计日志及异常频率
补偿动作记录的远程 API 调用与回滚重放序列
沙箱内增量进程/文件系统快照的创建与恢复事件
同一任务短时间内多次 fork 分支并行执行导致外部服务调用激增
defense_advice_zh: 将状态点创建、回滚与分叉操作纳入审计与告警，确保全过程可追溯
对远程补偿动作做幂等性与权限校验，防止回滚过程造成新的越权或数据破坏
在沙箱中限制快照/回滚可访问的路径与凭据范围，防止快照泄露敏感状态
对频繁回滚或异常分叉行为设置速率限制并纳入智能体行为基线

items.title: Beyond Semantic Narrowing: Robust and Efficient LLM Watermarking with Hamming Neighborhoods
items.summary: Semantic watermarking improves robustness against watermark removal attacks by embedding detectable signals into sentence-level representations. However, existing watermarking methods typically impose watermark-specific semantic preferences on generated sentences without explicitly accounting for the highly non-uniform and context-dependent semantic preference of LLM generation. When these two preferences are poorly aligned, many natural continuations become incompatible with the watermark, causing semantic narrowing: reduced semantic freedom, increased resampling cost, and potential degradation on tasks with strict semantic requirements. To alleviate this problem, we propose HammingMark, which uses the semantic hash of the preceding sentence as a dynamic center and accepts candidates whose hashes fall within its Hamming neighborhood. Defining watermark validity over a Hamming neighborhood in compact hash space retains a larger fraction of naturally likely semantic continuations. The coarse many-to-one hash mapping further allows diverse semantic realizations to remain watermark-valid. Experiments on C4 and BookSum show that HammingMark achieves strong robustness, high detectability, and near-unwatermarked generation quality, requiring only 2.2 sampled candidates per accepted sentence,a 72.8% reduction compared with the most sampling-efficient existing method. On more complex tasks with strict semantic constraints, HammingMark achieves the highest detection rates with the highest or tied-highest ROUGE-L scores, demonstrating its effectiveness in balancing watermark detectability and generation quality under constrained generation settings.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文关注大语言模型生成内容的溯源与标识问题。语义水印通过在句子级语义表示中嵌入可检测信号，相比词元级水印更能抵抗改写、翻译等水印去除攻击，因此成为 AI 内容溯源的重要方向。但作者指出，现有语义水印方法存在一个被忽视的结构性缺陷：它们把一套「水印专属的语义偏好」强加给生成过程，却没有显式建模 LLM 本身高度非均匀、依赖上下文的语义偏好分布。当这两种偏好对齐不佳时，大量本来自然的续写候选会被判定为「不含水印」而遭到拒绝，作者称之为「语义收窄」（semantic narrowing）。其后果包括：生成时的语义自由度下降，被迫反复重采样导致推理成本上升，以及在摘要、结构化输出等对语义约束严格的任务上出现质量退化，形成可检测性与生成质量之间的两难。

为缓解该问题，论文提出 HammingMark。其核心思路是把前一句的语义哈希作为动态中心，只要求候选句的语义哈希落在该中心的汉明邻域内即视为携带有效水印，而不是强制候选匹配某个固定的水印语义模式。由于水印有效性定义在紧凑哈希空间的邻域上，而非单点映射上，因此能保留更大比例的自然高概率语义续写；同时粗粒度的多对一哈希映射允许多种不同的语义实现在同一邻域内同时保持水印有效，从而显著扩大了可用语义空间。

实验在 C4 与 BookSum 数据集上进行。结果表明 HammingMark 同时具备较强的抗去除鲁棒性、较高的水印检出率和接近无水印基线的生成质量。效率方面，每接受一个句子平均只需采样约 2.2 个候选，相比此前采样效率最高的方法减少约 72.8% 的采样量。在语义约束更严格的复杂任务上，该方法取得了最高检出率，并保持最高或并列最高的 ROUGE-L，说明它在受限生成条件下能更好地平衡水印可检测性与生成质量。该工作适合研究 LLM 水印、AI 内容溯源与模型输出治理的研究者和工程团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 水印是 AI 内容溯源与滥用法证的关键技术，但长期受制于「可检测性与生成质量此消彼长」。该工作从语义分布对齐角度缓解语义收窄，并大幅降低重采样开销，使水印在生产级推理服务中更可落地，也为水印鲁棒性评估提供了新基线。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至 LLM API 服务商的内容标记与溯源、生成文本的深度伪造鉴别与取证、开源模型滥用归因、以及需要严格语义保真的摘要/结构化生成场景；同时会影响既有语义水印方案的效率与质量评测口径。
detection_signals_zh: 对可疑文本做句子级语义哈希统计，检查哈希值在紧凑空间中是否呈非随机聚集或邻域一致分布
检查跨句语义哈希中心与后续句子哈希之间的汉明距离是否稳定落在小邻域内
在改写、翻译、同义替换等扰动后，观察上述语义哈希邻域统计量是否仍具区分度，可作为水印残留证据
结合生成接口侧的采样与重采样次数、延迟等运行指标做辅助异常观察（需与业务基线对比）
defense_advice_zh: 在引入语义水印前，用自有业务语料复现「语义收窄」现象，评估其对摘要、抽取式问答等严格语义任务的退化程度
将水印检测结果纳入人工复核流程，避免仅凭单一统计量判定内容来源，防止误判正常文本
对水印方案做对抗鲁棒性回归测试（改写、翻译、同义替换、跨模型改写），持续跟踪检出率与生成质量指标
在推理服务监控中记录采样开销与延迟变化，防止水印引入的重采样放大推理成本或形成侧信道特征
关注语义哈希与水印密钥的管理，避免哈希中心或密钥泄露削弱溯源效力

items.title: Why Backdooring Neural Networks is so Easy?
items.summary: Securing modern AI systems against backdoor attacks remains an open challenge and requires fundamentally principled estimates of the adversary's budget -- the poison fraction $π$ and trigger strength $α$ needed to construct successful yet stealthy attacks. Motivated by recent empirical evidence that poisoning large language models can require a nearly constant number of malicious samples even as clean datasets grow, we derive an exact closed-form analysis of a quadratic neuron trained on a poisoned Gaussian mixture. We show, perhaps counterintuitively, that the same feature-learning dynamics that make neural networks powerful can also make them more vulnerable to backdoors. Specifically, with clean accuracy preserved to first order, $O(π)$, we demonstrate that lazy learning imposes the inverse-square-root scaling $α\propto π^{-1/2}$ for a successful attack, while feature learning induces a quadratic detector whose loss margin scales as $O(α^4)$, improving the attack budget to $α\propto π^{-1/4}$. Consequently, nonlinear feature learning substantially reduces the trigger strength required at small poison fractions, thereby in a sense making feature learners more backdoor vulnerable. These results provide a theoretical mechanism consistent with large-scale empirical observations and demonstrate that security audits based on linear heuristics can systematically underestimate backdoor vulnerability in the widely adopted feature-learning regimes.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究的是神经网络后门攻击中的一个基础理论问题: 攻击者到底需要多大的预算才能构造既成功又隐蔽的后门。作者把攻击者预算拆解为两个量: 训练数据中的投毒比例 π 与触发器强度 α。研究动机来自近期的实证观察: 对大语言模型投毒时, 即使干净数据集规模不断增长, 所需的恶意样本数量却近似保持恒定, 这与经典数据投毒理论给出的直觉不符, 也说明现有对后门成本的理解并不完整。为此, 作者设计了一个可精确求解的最小模型: 在一个投毒的高斯混合分布上训练一个二次神经元, 并给出闭式解形式的攻击成功条件分析。结论颇具反直觉性: 正是让神经网络具备强大能力的特征学习动力学, 同时让它更容易被植入后门。具体而言, 在干净任务准确率仅以一阶 O(π) 的代价被保持的前提下, 处于惰性学习(lazy learning, 近似核方法)区制时, 成功攻击要求触发器强度满足逆平方根缩放 α ∝ π^{-1/2}; 而一旦模型进入特征学习(feature learning)区制, 会形成一个二次型检测器, 其损失间隔(loss margin)量级为 O(α^4), 从而把攻击预算改善为 α ∝ π^{-1/4}。这意味着在很小的投毒比例下, 非线性特征学习显著降低了所需的触发器强度, 使特征学习型模型在某种意义上比惰性模型更易受后门影响。作者进一步指出, 该理论机制与大规模语言模型投毒实验的观测结果一致, 并给出了一个重要推论: 基于线性启发式(如线性探针、线性可分性假设)的安全审计方法, 会系统性地低估当前主流特征学习范式的后门脆弱性。论文属于纯理论/机制解释类工作, 未涉及具体攻击实现细节, 适合 AI 安全研究者、后门攻防与模型审计方向的安全工程师阅读, 用于校准投毒风险评估与检测灵敏度。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它解释了为何低投毒比例下后门仍可行, 并证明线性启发式审计会系统性低估风险。对负责训练数据供应链与模型准入评估的团队, 这是重新校准投毒阈值与检测灵敏度的理论依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响训练数据投毒的风险量化、第三方模型/数据集供应链审计、后门检测阈值设定, 以及模型准入评测中'低投毒比例可忽略'这一常见假设的有效性。
detection_signals_zh: 低投毒比例(极小 π)场景下仍出现稳定的目标类误判, 与'投毒量太小可忽略'的线性假设相矛盾
模型对特定触发模式表现出异常高的置信度或异常的损失间隔, 提示存在二次型可检测特征
特征层表征空间中投毒样本与干净样本形成可分的聚集结构, 而输入层线性统计量无明显异常
defense_advice_zh: 不要仅依赖线性探针或输入层线性统计量评估后门风险, 应结合表征层与神经元级检测手段
在低投毒比例场景下按 α 与 π 的非线性缩放关系重新校准检测灵敏度与告警阈值, 避免阈值设定过松
对第三方模型与数据集实施数据溯源、来源审查与投毒比例估计, 并对高风险来源做端到端复测
将模型是否处于特征学习区制纳入审计考量, 特征学习能力越强越需要强化后门防护与评测
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Nodemailer: Quoted local-part can produce malformed envelope recipient through RFC 5322 comment parsing
items.summary:
## Summary

Nodemailer's address parser can produce an unexpected recipient address when an RFC 5322 comment follows the domain of an address whose local-part is a quoted string.

For example:

```text
"user"@example.com(x)evil.com
```

is parsed as:

```text
{
  address: "user@example.com evil.com",
  name: ""
}
```

The resulting address therefore contains additional attacker-controlled domain text separated by a literal space.

The parsed `.address` value is subsequently propagated into the SMTP envelope:

```text
src/addressparser/index.ts
        ↓
recipient.address
        ↓
src/mime-node/index.ts
        ↓
envelope.to
```

The envelope construction uses the parsed address without another strict address validation step.

This appears to be a variant of the RFC 5322 comment parsing issue addressed by GHSA-cc9r-2j5m-2m83, but it follows a different parser path when the local-part is quoted.

## Reproduction

Input:

```text
"user"@example.com(x)evil.com
```

Observed parser output:

```text
address: "user@example.com evil.com"
name: ""
```

A second example:

```text
"a"@b.com(c)d.com(e)f.com
```

produces:

```text
address: "a@b.com d.com f.com"
name: ""
```

For comparison, the corresponding unquoted form:

```text
user@example.com(x)evil.com
```

takes a different code path and is handled by the existing protection differently.

## Technical Details

The issue is caused by different parsing behavior for quoted and unquoted local-parts.

The quoted-local-part variant allows the comment-separated trailing domain atoms to remain in the resulting `.address` value.

That value is then used when constructing the message envelope:

```text
envelope.to = recipients.map(to => to.address as string)
```

No additional strict recipient validation is performed at this boundary.

## Security Impact

The confirmed impact is that attacker-controlled comment content can result in a malformed/ambiguous recipient address being accepted by the parser and propagated into `envelope.to`.

The reporter did **not confirm successful delivery to an unintended recipient through a real SMTP server using this exact quoted-local-part variant**.

The remaining question is how real SMTP servers and other Nodemailer transports handle an envelope recipient containing a value such as:

```text
user@example.com evil.com
```

An end-to-end SMTP test is required to determine whether this parser behavior results in an exploitable delivery or recipient-validation bypass.

## Relationship to GHSA-cc9r-2j5m-2m83

This report is intended as a potential variant/follow-up to GHSA-cc9r-2j5m-2m83.

The existing advisory addresses RFC 5322 comment handling in email domains. This report identifies a separate parser path involving quoted local-parts that can preserve additional domain-like content in the normalized address.

Please evaluate whether this behavior is already covered by the existing fix or represents a remaining parser variant.

## Suggested Fix

The parser should consistently reject or correctly terminate addresses containing trailing domain atoms after RFC 5322 comments, regardless of whether the local-part is quoted.

In particular:

```text
"user"@example.com(x)evil.com
```

should not result in:

```text
user@example.com evil.com
```

The envelope-generation layer should also avoid assuming that a parser-produced address is safe for SMTP delivery without appropriate validation.

## Verification Status

Confirmed:

* Parser accepts the quoted-local-part variant.
* Parser produces an address containing additional attacker-controlled text.
* The resulting address is propagated into `envelope.to`.

Not confirmed by reporter:

* Successful delivery through a real SMTP server.
* Delivery to an unintended recipient.
* Exploitability against a specific downstream SMTP implementation.

items.title: Nodemailer: Quadratic backtracking in the addressparser free-text fallback allows remote denial of service
items.summary:
### Summary

When `addressparser` finds no address by its strict reading, it falls back to pulling one out of the free text with `/\s*\b[^@\s]+@[^\s]+\b\s*/`. That pattern backtracks quadratically: `[^@\s]+` is retried from every offset and rescans the run to the next `@` each time. A single header value holding a long whitespace-free run with no usable `@` blocks the Node.js event loop for tens of seconds.

It is cheaper to exploit than GHSA-prgh-xp8r-p3m5: 273KB is enough for ~43s, where the comment-joined shape needed ~1.5MB for ~10s.

### Details

The fallback in `src/addressparser/index.ts` ran the pattern as a search. `[^@\s]+` crosses neither whitespace nor `@`, so from each start offset it scans forward to the next `@` or to the end of the run and then fails, and the engine simply advances one character and repeats. Three shapes make every offset fail:

- the run holds no `@` at all
- the only `@` has nothing after it
- the only `@` has nothing before it

A fourth reaches it with a valid address present but placed past a long run, so the long run is walked before the match is found.

### PoC

```js
const addressparser = require('nodemailer/lib/addressparser');
const s = Date.now();
addressparser(' >' + '>[x][x]'.repeat(40000)); // 273KB
console.log(Date.now() - s, 'ms'); // ~43000 ms, blocking
```

Measured on 10.0.5:

| Value | Parse time |
| --- | --- |
| `'[x]'.repeat(40000)` (117KB) | 9.0 s |
| `'[x]'.repeat(40000) + '@'` (117KB) | 8.9 s |
| `'@' + '[x]'.repeat(40000)` (117KB) | 8.8 s |
| `' >' + '>[x][x]'.repeat(40000)` (273KB) | 42.9 s |

### Impact

Algorithmic-complexity denial of service. Node is single threaded, so the block stalls the whole process. Reachable without authentication anywhere inbound header values are handed to this parser, mailparser being the notable case, and reachable from application input wherever a user-supplied string is used as a message address, since `mime-node` parses `to`, `from` and `cc` when composing.

### Patch

The search is replaced by a single linear pass that finds the one offset the pattern can match at, which is then applied there with a sticky regex. Match results are unchanged, verified against the previous implementation over 3.4 million random strings comparing both the match offset and the matched text, plus 800k full-parse comparisons.

Found while validating the report in GHSA-prgh-xp8r-p3m5, not reported externally.

items.title: adm-zip: Unhandled error event in async DEFLATE decompression crashes Node.js process (DoS)
items.summary:
## Summary

Denial of Service in `adm-zip`'s async decompression API allows an unauthenticated attacker to crash the entire Node.js host process by supplying a single malformed ZIP file.

## Details

**Affected package**: adm-zip
**Affected versions**: at least 0.6.0 (current latest); likely all versions containing the current `inflateAsync` implementation in `methods/inflater.js`
**Patched version**: 0.6.1

### Root Cause

`methods/inflater.js:12-32` (`inflateAsync`) creates a `zlib.createInflateRaw(option)` stream and feeds it attacker-controlled compressed bytes via `tmp.end(inbuf)`, but never registers an `"error"` listener on the stream:

```js
inflateAsync: function (/*Function*/ callback) {
    var tmp = zlib.createInflateRaw(option),
        parts = [],
        total = 0;
    tmp.on("data", function (data) { parts.push(data); total += data.length; });
    tmp.on("end", function () { /* build buf, callback(buf) */ });
    tmp.end(inbuf);   // no tmp.on("error", ...) registered anywhere
}
```

Per Node.js `EventEmitter`/stream semantics, an `"error"` event emitted with zero listeners is rethrown as an **uncaught exception on a later tick**, originating from the zlib C++ binding. This cannot be caught by a `try/catch` wrapped around the calling code, because the throw happens asynchronously, outside the synchronous call stack the `try/catch` covers.

This code path is reached from every public async API that decompresses entry data: `readFileAsync`, `readAsTextAsync`, `extractAllToAsync`, and `ZipEntry.getDataAsync` (`zipEntry.js:51`, `:97-120`, `:309-315`; `adm-zip.js:157-164`, `:192-210`, `:893`).

This library recently patched **CVE-2026-39244** (GHSA-xcpc-8h2w-3j85), an unbounded `Buffer.alloc()` on the *synchronous* decompression path. That fix added a `maxOutputLength` option to `zlib.inflateRawSync`/`zlib.createInflateRaw`, and the sync path's resulting throw is naturally catchable. The async path shares the same `maxOutputLength` option (`methods/inflater.js:5`) but has no error-handling on the stream at all, so it was not covered by that fix and remains exploitable via either of two independent triggers:

1. A DEFLATE entry with corrupted/malformed compressed bytes (`Z_DATA_ERROR`) — no special crafting needed.
2. Compressed data whose inflated size exceeds the declared central-directory size, which now trips the `maxOutputLength` guard — but on the stream this surfaces via the unhandled `"error"` event rather than a catchable throw.

### Attack Vector

items.title: adm-zip: Decompression-bomb protection (fix for CVE-2026-39244) can be bypassed by declaring uncompressed size as 0
items.summary:
**Affected package:** adm-zip (npm)
**Affected version:** 0.6.0

## Summary

The fix shipped for CVE-2026-39244 (`methods/inflater.js`) caps zlib's decompression output via `maxOutputLength: expectedLength`, where `expectedLength` is read directly from the ZIP entry's attacker-controlled "uncompressed size" header field (`CENLEN`/`LOCLEN`). This cap is only applied when `expectedLength > 0`:

```js
const option = version >= 15 && expectedLength > 0 ? { maxOutputLength: expectedLength } : {};
return zlib.inflateRawSync(inbuf, option);
```

If an attacker sets the declared uncompressed-size field to exactly **0**, this condition is false, `option` becomes `{}`, and no output cap is passed to zlib at all. Node then falls back to zlib's own internal default limit (several GB), so a small, highly-compressible payload can still be decompressed to a very large size in memory -- the same class of resource-exhaustion issue the original CVE addressed, just triggered differently.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Build a ZIP archive containing one DEFLATE-compressed entry whose real content is highly redundant (e.g. several MB of a repeated byte, achieving close to the ~1032:1 theoretical raw-DEFLATE compression ratio).
2. Patch the entry's declared uncompressed-size fields (both the local file header copy and the central directory copy, 4-byte little-endian values) to `0`. The compressed bytes and CRC32 are left untouched -- CRC validation still passes because CRC is computed over the real decompressed output, not the declared size.
3. Load the archive with `new AdmZip(buffer)` and call `.getEntries()[0].getData()` (or `readFile`/`readAsText`/`extractAllTo`/etc. -- all share the same code path).
4. Observe: decompression succeeds and returns the full-size buffer with no size restriction applied, whereas the same real data with an honest (but undersized) declared value correctly throws `Cannot create a Buffer larger than N bytes`.

## Proof of Concept

Attached script demonstrates a controlled A/B comparison using the identical real payload in both cases -- only the declared-size header field differs:

- **Control** (declared size = 1024 bytes, deliberately smaller than the true 4MB output): correctly throws, proving the cap mechanism works when `expectedLength > 0`.
- **Bypass** (declared size = 0, identical real payload): succeeds and returns the full 4,194,304-byte buffer with zero restriction.

Verified reproducible across 3 independent runs.

## Impact

Any application that calls adm-zip's read/extract methods on an untrusted ZIP file (upload handlers, CI artifact extraction, email attachment scanning, etc.) can be made to allocate an amount of memory bounded only by zlib's own internal default rather than any limit the application or adm-zip intends -- a small (tens-of-MB) upload can trigger multi-GB memory consumption, risking process crash/OOM.

## Suggested Fix

Apply `maxOutputLength` unconditionally (e.g. defaulting to a sane absolute ceiling, or always passing the declared size regardless of whether it's 0), and/or add an independent compression-ratio check that doesn't rely solely on the attacker-supplied size field.
