items.title: Beyond Scalar Probes: Exploiting Vector-Valued Outputs in ReLU Networks For Signature Extraction
items.summary: We revisit cryptanalytic extraction of ReLU networks from a geometric and algebraic perspective. Rather than restricting attention to a single output component, we study the full vector-valued behavior across adjacent linear regions. This leads to a rank-one characterization of Jacobian differences that recovers the usual row-signature information while also revealing complementary column-side information. Our experiments show how this additional structure can be used in ex- traction and improves numerical estimation under different numerical- precision regimes (float64, float32 and float16). We extend the analysis beyond the high-precision and output-rounding settings commonly con- sidered in the literature towards the low-precision settings encountered in many practical settings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文重新审视了针对 ReLU 前馈神经网络的"密码分析式"模型提取问题，即把神经网络权重与偏置的恢复类比为对密码算法的密钥恢复，从几何与代数两个视角对这一问题给出新的刻画。论文指出，以往工作大多把注意力集中在网络的单个输出分量上（例如沿某一输出维度做标量探测），从而只能恢复所谓的"行签名"（row-signature）信息。作者转而研究相邻线性区域（ReLU 激活模式切换所形成的多面体分段线性区域）上完整的向量值输出行为，由此得到一个关键结论：相邻区域之间 Jacobian（局部线性映射矩阵）的差分具有秩一（rank-one）结构。这一秩一刻画不仅能够在统一框架内重新导出传统的行侧签名信息，还额外暴露出此前被忽略的"列侧"互补信息，即矩阵差分的方向向量与尺度因子在行、列两个方向上都携带可被利用的结构。基于该刻画，作者设计了相应的提取流程，并在不同数值精度条件下（float64、float32、float16）进行了实验评估。实验表明，向量值输出所引入的额外结构可以提升提取的效果，并在数值估计的稳健性上带来改善，尤其是在低精度算术下仍能维持可用性。论文的一个显著贡献是把分析范围从文献中常见的高精度、输出经过舍入（output-rounding）的理想化设定，推进到实际部署中更常见的低精度场景（如半精度浮点推理、量化/近似计算环境），说明即便是输出精度受限的情形，攻击者（或评估者）仍可能从向量化输出中挖掘出额外的权重信息。整体上，这是一篇融合密码分析、分段线性几何与机器学习安全的交叉研究，适合模型窃取/模型提取方向的研究者、负责模型知识产权保护的工程与安全团队，以及对神经网络权重保密性评估感兴趣的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 模型权重是核心资产，该工作说明仅限制单输出分量或提高输出精度并不足以阻断权重泄露；向量值输出与低精度部署场景（float16 / 量化推理）同样可能成为信息泄露面，对模型保密性评估与 API 防护有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面向外部提供推理服务的 MLaaS / 模型 API、边缘与端侧低精度（float16、量化）推理部署，以及以权重保密为前提的模型知识产权保护与合规评估场景。
detection_signals_zh: 对同一模型 API 的高频、高密度查询，尤其是围绕决策边界或激活模式切换点的密集探测
查询输入呈现系统性构造特征（近邻样本成对出现、沿特定方向小步长移动）
对模型输出精度/数值格式的异常探测行为，或在低精度接口上重复索取同一输入的多个输出分量
单一账号或 IP 在短时间内触发大量非常规分布输入，显著偏离正常业务流量模式
defense_advice_zh: 对模型推理接口实施查询限流、配额与异常行为检测，识别近邻成对探测模式
评估是否有必要对输出做降维、加噪、舍入或只返回 Top-k / 类别标签，减少可被利用的向量值信息

items.title: Implementing Data Diodes Using Commodity Hardware and Open Source Software
items.summary: One-way network devices, known as data diodes, are used to defend against sophisticated cyberattacks. Partly due to their high cost, data diodes are mostly deployed in nuclear power plants and within the government for handling classified information. Although commercially available data diodes are expensive, a data diode's hardware can assembled from commodity fiber-optic network equipment. However, specialized software is needed to send data through a data diode reliably: the receiving program cannot request retransmission of dropped packets, so packet loss must be minimized and mitigated. First, we developed a minimal program to measure packet loss. We found that most packet loss was caused by the receiving program processing incoming packets too slowly, and that packet loss often occurs in clusters. Also, we discovered ways to minimize packet loss on Linux and macOS without using superuser privileges. Next, we tested three existing open source programs for one-way data transfers: netcat, UDPcast, and lidi. Although these programs were unreliable in their default configurations, we identified reliable configurations for UDPcast and lidi. Finally, we incorporated our findings into pydiode, our cross-platform program for reliable one-way data transfers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究如何使用商用硬件和开源软件构建单向网络设备（数据二极管），以低成本实现原本昂贵的高保障单向数据传输方案。数据二极管用于防御高级网络攻击，目前主要部署在核电站和政府涉密信息处理场景，主要原因之一是其商业产品价格高昂。论文指出，虽然硬件层面可用商用光纤网络设备组装，但软件层面需要特殊设计才能可靠传输：接收端程序无法请求重传丢失的数据包，因此必须最小化并缓解丢包问题。作者首先开发了一个最小化程序来测量丢包情况，发现大部分丢包由接收程序处理入站数据包过慢导致，且丢包往往呈簇状出现；随后发现可在 Linux 和 macOS 上无需超级用户权限即可最小化丢包的方法。接着，他们测试了三种现有开源单向数据传输程序：netcat、UDPcast 和 lidi。虽然这些程序在默认配置下不可靠，但作者为 UDPcast 和 lidi 找到了可靠配置。最后，作者将研究结果整合到 pydiode 中——这是一个跨平台的可靠单向数据传输程序。核心贡献包括：揭示单向传输中丢包的成因与簇状特征、提出无需特权的最小化丢包方法、评估现有开源工具并给出可靠配置、以及实现并验证 pydiode 工具，为低成本构建数据二极管提供了可复用的工程路径。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 数据二极管是隔离网络间高保障单向传输的关键技术。本文证明低成本商用硬件加开源软件即可实现可靠单向传输，对工控、政府、核设施等强隔离场景具有重要参考价值，可降低部署门槛。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到工控网络单向数据采集、跨域数据交换、日志单向上传等场景，帮助预算有限的组织以低成本构建近似数据二极管的隔离传输方案；同时提醒防御方关注单向 UDP 通道被滥用于隐蔽外传的风险。
detection_signals_zh: 网络中持续出现大量单向 UDP 流且无反向控制通道，可能是数据二极管链路或被利用作单向外传通道的迹象
单向接收端出现簇状聚集的丢包模式，可能指示接收程序处理速率不足或系统负载瓶颈
defense_advice_zh: 部署单向传输链路前进行丢包测量与容量评估，避免接收端处理过慢造成静默数据丢失
评估以 UDPcast、lidi、pydiode 等开源工具替代商业数据二极管时，需在目标平台验证其可靠配置并加入完整性校验
对单向数据流实施持续监控与序列号/校验机制，因接收端无法请求重传，静默丢包可能造成不可见的数据缺失
关注单向 UDP 通信的异常使用，防范攻击者借用类似机制绕过双向检测进行隐蔽数据外传

items.title: Quantum Leakage Resilience of Shamir Secret Sharing
items.summary: We initiate the study of quantum leakage resilience of unmodified Shamir secret sharing over prime fields. A well-studied leakage model for Shamir's secret sharing classically is single-bit local leakage from each share. We consider its quantum analogue where, for each party, a local leakage channel takes as input the party's share and outputs a leaked qubit. Without preshared entanglement, we show that the distinguishing advantage is $2^{-Ω(n)}$ when the threshold rate $t/n=τ$ exceeds $τ_\star\approx0.73339$ by a fixed positive margin. More generally, we allow disjoint entangled blocks of any fixed maximum size where there is no entanglement between different blocks or with the adversary, and each block emits at most a fixed number of qubits. Security holds when the threshold rate is high enough (sufficiently close to one). We then allow a specified set of devices to share entanglement with the adversary. We show that security holds even when a linear number of devices ($αn$ for small $α>0$) share entanglement with each other and with the adversary for a large enough threshold rate. As a complementary negative result, we also show that even classical single-bit leakage makes Shamir scheme insecure if we allow arbitrarily large entanglement between the leakage devices. A GHZ state shared by exactly $t$ leakage devices makes even classical one-bit leakage insecure, without any entanglement with the adversary. In this attack, each participating device emits only one classical bit, and their joint parity distinguishes any chosen pair of secrets with a constant advantage. Thus, for fixed threshold rates above $τ_\star$, the maximum number of devices that may share arbitrary entanglement with one another and with the adversary while preserving security is linear in $n$ up to constant factors, although the optimal support fraction remains open.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本论文首次系统研究素域上「未经修改」的 Shamir 秘密共享方案在量子泄漏模型下的安全性（即量子泄漏韧性）。经典文献中一个被广泛研究的泄漏模型是：每一方泄露其持有份额的一个本地比特（single-bit local leakage）。作者把该模型量子化：对每一方，本地泄漏信道以该方的份额为输入，输出一个「泄漏量子比特」（leaked qubit），允许泄漏过程中出现量子叠加与纠缠效应。

论文的主要正面结果分层次给出。第一，在泄漏设备之间、以及与敌手之间都没有预共享纠缠的情况下，作者证明只要阈值率 t/n=τ 超过 τ*≈0.73339 并留出一个固定正裕度，敌手区分任意两个秘密的优势被压到 2^{-Ω(n)}，即随份额数量 n 指数衰减。第二，结果被推广到更一般的泄漏结构：设备可被划分为互不相交的纠缠块，每块规模有固定上界，块与块之间、块与敌手之间均无纠缠，每块最多发出固定数量的量子比特；此时只要阈值率足够高（充分接近 1），安全性依然成立。第三，作者进一步允许一部分被指定的设备与敌手共享纠缠，并证明即使有线性数量（αn，α 为足够小的正常数）的设备彼此之间以及与敌手共享纠缠，在阈值率足够高时方案仍保持安全。

作为互补的负面结果，论文给出了尖锐的下界：一旦允许泄漏设备之间存在任意大的纠缠，连经典的单个比特泄漏都会使 Shamir 方案不再安全。具体地，若恰好 t 个泄漏设备共享一个 GHZ 态，且完全不需要与敌手纠缠，仅每个参与设备输出一个经典比特，这些比特的联合奇偶性就能以常数优势区分任意选定的一对秘密，从而破坏保密性。

综合正反两方面结果可得结论：对于 τ* 以上的固定阈值率，能与彼此及敌手任意共享纠缠而仍不破坏安全的设备数量最多只能与 n 成线性关系（仅差常数因子）；而最优的「可支持比例」（optimal support fraction）究竟落在何处，仍是公开问题。该工作把经典泄漏韧性的阈值现象拓展到量子设置，并为阈值密码学、门限签名与分布式密钥管理在量子敌手模型下的参数选择提供了理论边界。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Shamir 秘密共享是阈值签名、MPC、分布式密钥托管的核心原语。该工作表明在量子泄漏模型下，只有当阈值率高于约 0.73339（或接近 1，视纠缠假设而定）时才具备可证明安全性，且设备间纠缠会显著削弱保障，直接关系到长期密钥保护的参数选型。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到阈值密码系统与 MPC 的泄漏威胁建模：为门限签名、分布式密钥管理、长期数据保护方案的阈值率与份额部署拓扑设计提供安全性边界参考，并提示需评估参与设备间是否存在量子纠缠通道。
defense_advice_zh: 审视为长期安全设计的 Shamir 类共享/门限方案，避免采用接近或低于 0.73339 的阈值率，必要时提高到接近 1。
在威胁建模中显式考虑股东设备之间及与外部对手之间可能存在量子纠缠的假设，限制设备共享量子态或相干信道的能力。
对高价值密钥的分布式保管，优先采用能抵抗本地泄漏的信源模型（如随机化份额、泄漏容忍的秘密共享变体）。
将该论文的阈值结论纳入内部密码学评估基线，跟踪最优支持比例开放问题的后续进展。

items.title: When One Leak Pays Forever: Context Binding and the Price of Deterring Collusion
items.summary: A coalition that deviates once can profit many times when what it sells keeps working. In a threshold-encrypted mempool, a leading defense against maximal extractable value (MEV), a quorum of the decryption committee that sells its decryption capability to a front-runner exposes every later block that the capability still decrypts. We ask how large a penalty, such as slashable stake, deters this kind of collusion. In our repeated game, a single leak by any coalition in a monotone family of authorized coalitions (for example, any $k$ of the $n$ committee members) unlocks a set of future rounds, costs a one-time penalty, and ends the coalition's participation. We show that every dynamic deviation reduces to choosing a leak time, so deterrence holds if and only if each coalition's penalty covers the largest discounted value that a single leak reaches. Without discounting, over $T$ rounds of unit value full reuse needs a penalty of $T$ while binding each leak to its own round needs $1$, so no penalty that is constant in the horizon deters unbounded reuse; a reuse window of $w$ rounds costs at most $w$ times the largest per-round value. The cheapest profile of per-party stakes that deters every coalition solves a covering linear program. For blockchain design, per-epoch keys cut the required stake from the value of a key's lifetime to the value of one epoch; we calibrate the gap on Ethereum front-running data and place Ferveo and Shutter in the model. The analysis extends to sealed-bid auctions, multi-authority voting, and federated learning under a shared key.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究阈值加密内存池（threshold-encrypted mempool，当前对抗 MEV 抢跑的主要防御手段之一）中解密委员会的合谋威慑问题。核心洞察是：一次泄露往往能反复获利——当解密委员会中达到法定人数（例如 n 名成员中的任意 k 名）将自己的解密能力出售给抢跑者后，该能力在其有效期内仍能解密的每一个后续区块都会被暴露，购买方只付一次代价却持续获益。作者把这一场景建模为重复博弈：单调联盟族中的任一合法联盟只要发生一次泄露，就会解锁一组未来轮次，同时支付一次性罚金并丧失后续参与资格。主要理论结论是：任何动态偏离策略都可归约为“选择泄露时刻”，因此威慑成立当且仅当每个联盟的罚金不低于单次泄露所能触及的最大折现收益。在无折现、T 轮单位收益、密钥可全程复用的情形下所需罚金为 T；若把每次泄露绑定到其发生的那一轮（即 context binding），所需罚金仅为 1——这表明任何与时间跨度无关的常数罚金都无法阻止无限复用；若复用窗口为 w 轮，代价最多为最大单轮收益的 w 倍。作者进一步证明：威慑全部联盟所需的最廉价“按参与方质押”方案等价于求解一个覆盖线性规划。在区块链设计层面，采用按 epoch 轮换的密钥可把所需质押从“密钥整个生命周期的价值”降到“单个 epoch 的价值”；作者用以太坊抢跑数据校准这一差距，并将 Ferveo 与 Shutter 两个阈值解密方案纳入模型比较。该分析框架还可推广到密封投标拍卖、多机构投票以及共享密钥下的联邦学习等场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“阈值加密能防 MEV”这一密码学直觉补上了经济激励的缺口：防御是否成立取决于罚没质押规模与密钥复用窗口，而非仅取决于门限参数。安全团队可用其结论审视共享密钥系统的参数配置是否真的阻止合谋。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于区块链 MEV 防护（阈值加密内存池）、密封投标拍卖、多机构门限投票、共享密钥的联邦学习等所有“一次泄露、多次复用”的共享密钥系统；影响罚没质押规模的设定、密钥轮换周期（per-epoch key）的设计，以及 Ferveo、Shutter 类方案的部署参数评估。
defense_advice_zh: 在阈值解密委员会中引入按 epoch 轮换的密钥，把单把密钥的可复用窗口压缩到最小，从而降低所需罚没质押上限。
依据该博弈模型计算罚没（slashing）下限，确保每个可能联盟的罚金覆盖单次泄露的最大折现收益，避免出现“常数罚金对无限复用”的失效情形。
将按参与方质押的最优配置作为覆盖线性规划问题求解，用最小总质押实现全联盟威慑，降低安全预算。
在设计评审中把“解密能力可否被转让/复用”作为独立风险项，与门限参数（k-of-n）分开评估。
对已部署的 Ferveo、Shutter 等阈值解密实现，核查其密钥生命周期策略与罚没规则是否落入论文指出的失效区间。

items.title: Calibrating One-Round Membership Inference with Neighbors
items.summary: The state-of-the-art Membership Inference (MI) methods calibrate their signal separately for each example using reference models, auxiliary models trained to exclude the target. This paradigm scales poorly to modern large models, however, whose training is too expensive to replicate. This has motivated one-round settings, where only a single trained model is available; but without reference models the per-example calibration that drives the strongest attacks can no longer be estimated, leaving the membership signal weak. We ask whether neighbors of the target point can recover this calibration without training any additional model. Our key observation is that reference models serve only to reveal how an example behaves under models not trained on it, and that querying the target model on nearby samples yields the same information. We propose two complementary ways to obtain such neighbors, and show that querying them against an early training checkpoint further sharpens the signal. We evaluate across three image classification datasets and three training setups, showing that neighbors yield strong membership signals and competitive attack performance at no additional training cost.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究成员推断攻击(Membership Inference, MI)在“单轮(one-round)”设定下的信号校准问题。当前最先进的 MI 方法依赖参考模型(在排除目标样本的数据上训练的辅助模型)对每个样本单独进行逐样本校准,从而得到很强的成员信号。然而这一范式对现代大模型难以扩展:复现一次训练成本过高,几乎不可能为同一目标训练出多个参考模型。于是在实际场景中往往只剩单个已训练模型可用,即 one-round 设定;但缺少参考模型后,驱动最强攻击的逐样本校准无法估计,成员信号显著变弱,攻击性能下降。作者提出核心问题:能否在不训练任何额外模型的前提下,利用目标数据点自身的“邻居”来恢复这种校准?其关键观察是,参考模型的作用本质上只是揭示“某个样本在未见过它的模型上会呈现怎样的行为”;而在目标模型上查询与该样本邻近的样本,可以提供同等的信息——邻居样本本身大概率未被训练集包含,因此其行为可充当局部基线。基于此,作者提出两种互补的邻居构造方式(即如何获得与目标点语义/特征接近的邻近样本),并进一步发现:将这些邻居查询结果与训练早期的检查点(early training checkpoint)进行对比,可以进一步锐化成员信号。实验在三个图像分类数据集和三种训练配置下展开,结果显示邻居校准能够产生强成员信号并取得有竞争力的攻击性能,且不带来任何额外训练开销。该工作为缺少参考模型的大模型隐私审计提供了低成本、可操作的替代校准思路,也对隐私保护评估与防御设计提出了新的威胁模型考量。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把成员推断攻击的门槛降到“只需一个已发布模型 + 邻近样本查询”,不再依赖昂贵的参考模型训练。这意味着大模型发布后无法再以“复现成本高”为由回避隐私风险,隐私审计与合规评估必须纳入单轮威胁模型。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到图像/多模态与大语言模型的成员推断与隐私审计、训练数据溯源、以及差分隐私和机器遗忘(unlearning)效果的评估基准;也影响模型发布方的隐私风险评估流程与 API 查询策略设计。
detection_signals_zh: 同一模型 API 在短时间内收到大量语义/特征高度相似的输入(疑似邻居采样),而非自然分布流量
围绕少量目标样本的成簇查询模式:对目标点及其邻近变体反复探测输出分数
对模型输出概率/置信度或 logits 的异常密集读取,可能被用于构造逐样本基线
对早期训练检查点或中间版本模型的访问与对比查询行为(若这类版本对外可达)
defense_advice_zh: 对高相似度批量查询做速率限制与聚类检测,并对同一来源的邻近样本簇进行告警
最小化对外暴露的输出信息(避免直接返回精细置信度/logits),必要时对输出做扰动或分档
严格管控早期训练检查点与历史模型版本的访问权限,避免其成为校准信号来源
在内部隐私评估中新增 one-round + 邻居校准的威胁模型,重新评估现有 MI 防护的真实强度
对高敏感训练数据考虑差分隐私或数据去重/去标识化等前置缓解措施
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进,并纳入内部隐私与模型发布风险评估

items.title: When Privacy Becomes a Weapon: Understanding Doxxing and Privacy Vulnerabilities in Mainland China's Social Media Ecosystem
items.summary: Doxxing, the malicious disclosure of personal information, has become a pervasive privacy threat. Yet existing research remains predominantly Western-centric, limiting our understanding of how doxxing unfolds in contexts where mandatory identity systems, platform governance, and cultural logics fundamentally reshape privacy risks and harm trajectories. We address this gap through semi-structured interviews with 18 doxxing survivors in mainland China, synthesizing their experiences into a framework conceptualizing how doxxing operates in this context. Our findings reveal both patterns echoing prior Western findings, such as platform amplification mechanisms that resonate with Western findings, and China-specific dynamics shaped by the interplay of regulatory mandates (compulsory identity linkage) and cultural logics including nationalist discourse, fandom culture, Confucian values, and low privacy literacy. Survivors' experiences further reveal how doxxing reshapes understanding of privacy: from preference to precondition, from momentary disclosure to temporal vulnerability, and from individual control to structural powerlessness. These insights challenge agency-centered privacy frameworks and suggest that effective protection requires constraining systemic vulnerabilities rather than relying solely on user empowerment. We conclude by proposing multifaceted recommendations spanning legal reform, platform design, and social initiatives.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文聚焦“人肉搜索”（doxxing，即恶意公开他人个人信息）这一日益普遍的隐私威胁，指出既有研究高度以西方语境为中心，难以解释在强制实名体系、平台治理机制与本土文化逻辑共同作用下，隐私风险与伤害路径如何被根本性重塑。为填补这一空白，作者对中国大陆 18 名人肉搜索幸存者开展了半结构化访谈，并将其经历综合归纳为一个概念框架，用以刻画人肉搜索在该语境下的运作方式。研究发现可分为两类：一是与既有西方研究相呼应的模式，例如平台推荐与传播机制对信息的放大效应；二是中国特有的动态，源于监管强制身份关联（强制性身份绑定）与文化逻辑之间的交互，包括民族主义话语、饭圈文化、儒家价值观以及较低的隐私素养。这些因素共同改变了人肉搜索的触发条件、参与动机与伤害扩散路径。幸存者的叙述进一步揭示了人肉搜索如何重塑人们对隐私的理解，表现为三重转变：隐私从一种个人偏好转变为社会参与的前提条件；从一次性的信息泄露转变为具有时间延续性的脆弱状态；从个体可控制的对象转变为结构性无力感的来源。基于此，论文对以个体能动性为中心的隐私框架提出挑战，主张有效的隐私保护不应仅依赖用户自我赋权，而必须约束系统性的结构性脆弱。作者最后从法律改革、平台设计与社会倡议三个层面提出多层次建议。该研究属于定性社会科学与 HCI 交叉工作，样本量为 18 人，结论的普适性需结合更大规模与跨地区研究进一步验证。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把隐私风险从“个人疏忽”重新定位为实名制度、平台机制与文化动员叠加产生的结构性风险，对平台治理、受害者响应与隐私威胁建模具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至高实名程度地区的平台内容治理、人肉搜索受害者支持流程设计、实名制政策风险评估，以及隐私威胁建模与信任安全团队的应急响应策略制定。
detection_signals_zh: 平台内出现集中公开他人真实姓名、单位、联系方式等可识别信息的帖子或话题
短时间内围绕同一目标跨平台聚合大量关联个人信息，形成信息拼图
伴随民族主义、饭圈对立或道德审判话术的集体曝光与举报动员
defense_advice_zh: 平台侧建立个人信息聚合与跨帖关联的识别与限流机制，缩短曝光内容的存活窗口
为受害者提供低门槛、快速生效的举报、删除与冻结账号处置通道，并保留证据链
将隐私保护从“用户自我管理”转向约束结构性脆弱，评估实名与身份关联机制带来的二次伤害面
在隐私素养与数字公民教育中纳入人肉搜索的识别、求助与心理支持内容
安全团队在威胁建模时将人肉搜索视为可升级为线下骚扰与人身风险的持续性事件，而非一次性泄露

items.title: Hybrid QKD-PQC Network Emulation through Automated and Scalable Cloud-Native Orchestration
items.summary: The ongoing transition toward quantum-safe networking has motivated the development of hybrid network architectures integrating Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC). However, the experimental evaluation of hybrid QKD-PQC network architectures remains constrained by the high cost and limited accessibility of quantum hardware, as well as by the limited support for hybrid QKD-PQC networks in existing emulation platforms. Quditto is an open-source emulation platform originally designed for QKD networks that enables cost-effective and reproducible experimentation without requiring dedicated physical quantum infrastructure. Building on this foundation, this work presents Quditto as a hybrid QKD-PQC network emulation platform featuring automated and scalable cloud-native orchestration. The proposed platform introduces four principal contributions: a cloud-native orchestrator enabling fully automated infrastructure deployment across cloud and multi-cluster environments; an optimized provisioning workflow enabling large-scale quantum-safe network emulation; native integration of post-quantum nodes enabling unified emulation of hybrid QKD-PQC networks; and a secure key management module providing persistent and access-controlled storage of cryptographic material. Experimental validation demonstrates sublinear orchestration-time scaling with network size and successful end-to-end hybrid QKD-PQC key establishment on a representative spine-leaf deployment, thereby enabling the systematic evaluation of quantum-safe networking mechanisms in large-scale heterogeneous network environments.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文面向"量子安全网络"迁移过程中的实验验证难题展开研究。随着业界向抗量子密码体系过渡，混合网络架构（同时集成量子密钥分发 QKD 与后量子密码 PQC）成为主流演进方向，但此类架构的实验评测长期受制于两大瓶颈：一是真实量子硬件成本高昂、可获得性差；二是现有网络仿真/仿真平台对 QKD 与 PQC 混合组网的支持非常有限，导致研究者难以在接近真实的大规模异构环境中复现与对比不同方案。为此，作者在开源 QKD 网络仿真平台 Quditto 的基础上进行扩展，将其打造为支持混合 QKD-PQC 网络仿真的平台，并引入自动化、可扩展的云原生编排能力，从而在不依赖专用物理量子基础设施的前提下实现低成本、可复现的实验。论文提出四项核心贡献：(1) 云原生编排器，可在公有云与多集群环境下全自动完成基础设施部署；(2) 优化后的资源置备（provisioning）工作流，支撑大规模量子安全网络的仿真；(3) 原生集成的后量子节点，使 QKD 与 PQC 能够在同一平台上统一仿真；(4) 安全密钥管理模块，提供密钥材料的持久化存储与基于访问控制的权限管理。实验验证方面，作者在一个具有代表性的脊叶（spine-leaf）拓扑部署上完成了端到端的混合 QKD-PQC 密钥建立，并测得当网络规模增大时编排时间呈现次线性（sublinear）扩展特性，说明该平台具备向大规模、异构网络环境扩展的能力。总体而言，该工作为系统化评估量子安全组网机制提供了可操作的开源实验基础设施，适合量子通信、后量子迁移规划与网络仿真方向的研究者和工程人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 量子安全迁移的落地验证普遍缺乏可负担、可复现的大规模实验环境。该工作提供开源的云原生混合 QKD-PQC 仿真与密钥管理能力，使安全团队能在不购置量子硬件的前提下评估混合密钥体系与组网设计，对后量子迁移规划和架构选型具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到企业/运营商的后量子密码迁移预研与架构验证、多集群与云环境下的量子安全密钥分发链路仿真、以及安全团队对混合密钥管理体系（密钥生命周期、访问控制、持久化存储）的测试与演练场景。
defense_advice_zh: 在开展后量子密码迁移预研时，可评估引入该开源平台构建内部混合 QKD-PQC 仿真环境，用于验证密钥分发链路与编排流程，而非直接采购昂贵的量子硬件。
重点关注平台中的密钥管理模块：确保密钥材料的持久化存储采用强访问控制与最小权限原则，避免仿真环境中的密钥泄露演变为真实环境的信任根风险。
对编排器与多集群部署接口实施与生产环境同等的安全基线（身份认证、镜像签名、配置审计），防止实验平台成为横向移动的跳板。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进；如内部有后量子迁移或量子安全组网规划，可纳入技术评估与仿真环境选型清单。

items.title: Succinct Arguments for QMA in the Quantum Random Oracle Model
items.summary: Succinct arguments are a fundamental cryptographic primitive for verifying computational claims with small communication. In the classical setting, succinct arguments for NP can be constructed from unstructured hardness alone (e.g., hash functions) by compiling probabilistically checkable proofs (PCPs) or interactive oracle proofs (IOPs) for NP via the commit-and-open paradigm. In contrast, known succinct arguments for QMA rely on ``structured'' cryptographic primitives, or on the quantum PCP conjecture. We construct the first succinct argument for QMA in the quantum random oracle model (QROM) without relying on additional cryptographic assumptions or unproven conjectures. This yields succinct arguments for QMA from unstructured hardness alone, showing that ideal hash functions not only suffice for succinct arguments for NP but also for QMA. Underlying our result is an efficiency-preserving transformation that compiles quantum interactive oracle proofs (QIOPs), a recently introduced interactive generalization of quantum PCPs, into quantum arguments for the same language, via a natural quantum commit-and-open paradigm. Our transformation applies to every QIOP with public-query soundness, a notion that we formalize to capture a natural requirement of the commit-and-open paradigm and is satisfied by a known QIOP for QMA. As a key ingredient in our transformation, we formalize and construct extractable vector commitments for quantum states with local openings in the QROM, which may be of independent interest.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 简洁论证（succinct arguments）是密码学中的基础原语，其目标是以极小的通信量验证计算断言。在经典设定下，针对 NP 的简洁论证可以仅从非结构化困难性（例如哈希函数）出发构造：通过 commit-and-open 范式，把 NP 的概率可检查证明（PCP）或交互式预言机证明（IOP）编译为论证系统。相比之下，已知的针对 QMA 的简洁论证要么依赖某种『结构化』密码原语，要么依赖尚未证明的量子 PCP 猜想，因此其假设基础明显更重。本文的贡献是构造出第一个在量子随机预言机模型（QROM）下的 QMA 简洁论证，且不依赖任何额外的密码学假设或未证明猜想。由此得到仅从非结构化困难性出发的 QMA 简洁论证，说明理想哈希函数不仅足以支撑 NP 的简洁论证，也足以支撑 QMA 的简洁论证。其核心技术是一个效率保持的编译变换：把最近提出的量子交互式预言机证明（QIOP，即量子 PCP 的交互式推广）转换为针对同一语言的量子论证，所用范式是一种自然的量子 commit-and-open。该变换适用于任何满足 public-query soundness 的 QIOP——作者形式化了这一概念，用以刻画 commit-and-open 范式的自然要求，并指出已有针对 QMA 的 QIOP 满足该条件。作为该变换的关键组件，作者还在 QROM 中形式化并构造了支持局部打开的、可提取的量子态向量承诺，这一组件本身可能具有独立价值。整体而言，论文把 QMA 简洁论证的假设门槛降到了与经典 NP 情形相同的非结构化困难性层面，属于量子密码学与可验证计算交叉方向的理论进展。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 这是密码学理论基础层面的进展：说明仅靠理想哈希函数即可为量子可验证计算（QMA）提供简洁论证，可能改变后量子可验证计算与证明系统的假设选型。对防御方而言没有直接攻击面，但会影响长期协议设计假设。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到后量子时代的可验证计算、证明系统与密码协议设计：为不依赖结构化假设的量子简洁论证提供理论替代路径；QROM 下可提取量子态向量承诺等组件可能被后续协议复用。
defense_advice_zh: 作为理论进展纳入密码学与后量子安全的知识跟踪，不涉及可部署的防御规则变更。
关注后续对 QIOP、QROM 可提取承诺等组件的工程化与标准化动向。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Conversable Quantum Fire in the Standard Model
items.summary: Quantum fire consists of quantum states that can be efficiently functionally cloned but cannot be transmitted using one-way classical communication. Whereas all previous quantum-fire constructions with proven untelegraphability are relative to an oracle, ours, based on one-shot signatures, is in the standard model. Our construction achieves two further notions that we introduce: (a) keyless untelegraphability, a strengthening of untelegraphability; and (b) conversability, meaning that a flame, though not telegraphable via one-way classical communication, can be transmitted via classical interaction. Hence one-way and two-way classical communication differ qualitatively in their power to transmit this quantum fire. We use these two novel properties of quantum fire, along with its clonability, to give one of the first cryptographic applications of quantum fire. Keyless untelegraphability forces the distribution of serial numbers of valid flames to have high min-entropy, while conversability and clonability allow the corresponding flame to be cloned and transferred using only classical communication. We present two variants of our conversable quantum-fire construction. The first, based on one-shot signatures (instantiable from subexponential iO, subexponentially secure one-way functions, and LWE), supports polynomially many flames, and super-logarithmic min-entropy of the serial-number distribution. The second, under the stronger assumption of exponentially unforgeable one-shot signatures (instantiable relative to a classical oracle), supports exponentially many flames, and linear min-entropy.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究“量子火”（quantum fire）这一新型量子密码原语：它是一类可被高效功能性克隆、却无法通过单向经典通信传输的量子态。此前所有可证明不可电报（untelegraphability）的量子火构造都依赖于随机预言机（oracle），而本文首次在标准模型下基于 one-shot signature 给出了此类构造，从而去除了对 oracle 的依赖。作者进一步引入两个新的安全概念：(a) 无密钥不可电报性（keyless untelegraphability），是对不可电报性的加强；(b) 可对话性（conversability），即火焰虽然无法经单向经典通信传输，却可以经由经典交互（双向通信）传输。这一性质表明，单向与双向经典通信在传输该量子火的能力上存在定性差异。结合克隆性，作者给出了量子火的早期密码学应用之一：无密钥不可电报性迫使有效火焰序列号的分布具有高最小熵，而可对话性与克隆性则允许仅用经典通信克隆并转移对应火焰。论文给出两个构造变体：第一个基于 one-shot signature（可由次指数级 iO、次指数安全单向函数与 LWE 实例化），支持多项式数量的火焰，以及超对数级最小熵的序列号分布；第二个在更强的假设——指数级不可伪造 one-shot signature（可在经典 oracle 下实例化）——之下，支持指数数量的火焰，并达到线性最小熵。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 量子火与可克隆密码学、复制保护、量子货币等方向紧密相关；本文表明此类原语不一定需要随机预言机，并揭示单向与双向经典通信的能力边界，对后量子与经典假设（iO、LWE、one-shot signature）的安全评估具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 长期影响量子密码基础与可克隆密码学原语的设计思路；短期不直接构成对现有系统的攻击面，但需关注其对 one-shot signature、次指数级 iO、LWE 等强假设的依赖。
defense_advice_zh: 作为理论研究跟进，不产生直接可落地的防御配置变更。
持续关注 one-shot signature 与 iO 假设的进展，评估其对后量子密码迁移路线图的长期影响。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: The Compiler May Read It, the Agent May Not: Keeping Part of a Research Code Away from a Coding Agent
items.summary: The compiler must read modules a physics-based solver cannot build without; the coding agent must not read that intellectual property. The harness does not ship that rule. We classified fifteen read routes against a container, permission rules and a sandbox. None of the three can tell which program is reading.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文（cs.AI / cs.SE）聚焦一个在「AI 编码智能体辅助科研开发」场景中日益尖锐但缺乏系统分析的矛盾：同一份代码仓库里，某些模块是构建物理求解器所必需的（编译器必须读取），但同时又属于不宜暴露给外部编码智能体的知识产权（agent 不该读）。换言之，安全策略需要做到「同一文件、同一路径，按读取主体区别对待」——允许编译器进程读取，禁止智能体读取。作者指出，当前把智能体接入开发环境时常用的三类隔离手段都默认了「谁读都一样」这一前提：(1) 容器隔离，(2) 文件系统权限规则，(3) 沙箱。论文把可能的读取路径系统性地归纳为十五条读取路由（read routes），并逐条对照上述三种机制进行分类验证，检验它们能否在「智能体正在读取」与「编译器正在读取」之间做出区分。核心结论是：这三种机制都无法判断究竟是哪个程序在执行读取——它们能约束读取的范围与身份，却缺乏对「读取者进程语义」的辨别能力，因此不足以承载这类细粒度的知识产权边界。其贡献在于把问题形式化为「读取主体识别」而非传统「访问控制」问题，并通过对十五种读取路径的对照分类，说明现有工程化防线在这一维度上的共同盲区，为后续研究（如基于进程溯源、构建行为建模或工具调用拦截的方案）提供了问题定义与评估基线。适合 AI 智能体安全、开发者平台安全、供应链与知识产权防护方向的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 越来越多团队把编码智能体接入真实研发仓库，其中常含未公开算法或专有求解器代码。本文说明容器、权限规则、沙箱这三类主流防线都无法区分「编译器读取」与「智能体读取」，意味着单靠部署时的隔离配置并不足以保护这类知识产权，需要更细粒度的读取主体识别能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响范围包括：使用 AI 编码助手/自主智能体的科研机构与企业研发部门、内部代码托管与 CI 构建平台、以及需要在同一工作区同时满足「构建必需读取」与「外部模型不可读取」的合规场景。可迁移到需要进程级/主体级文件访问区分的任何开发环境治理实践。
detection_signals_zh: 审计日志中出现同一路径在短时间内被构建工具进程与智能体运行时进程先后打开的现象（可重点比对进程可执行文件路径与父子进程链）
智能体工具调用（文件读取 / 目录列举 / 搜索类工具）命中了标记为「构建专用 / 禁止外泄」的目录或文件模式
沙箱或容器策略中仅配置了路径级读写许可，缺少按调用主体区分的规则，可作为配置缺口线索
构建日志显示预期模块被读取编译，但源代码网关/代理侧未记录到对应的读取主体标识（遥测缺失信号）
defense_advice_zh: 不要把容器、文件权限或沙箱当作「谁在读」的判定依据，需额外引入进程级溯源（如 LSM/eBPF 记录的打开者进程、二进制指纹与父子链）
对智能体运行时实施强制工具白名单，文件读取类工具默认拒绝，按目录显式放行，并将构建所需的高敏模块排除在智能体可挂载视图之外
在高敏仓库上启用完整文件访问审计，保留「打开者进程 + 路径 + 时间」三元组，用于事后区分构建读取与智能体读取
将构建阶段与智能体工作阶段在时间或环境上分离：先构建，再在裁剪后的工作副本中启动智能体，减少同工作区并行读取
开展内部评估：按本文的「读取路径」思路自查自方环境存在多少条可绕过现有策略的读取通道
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：在内部智能体接入评估中加入「读取主体识别」测试项，验证现有隔离措施能否区分构建进程与智能体进程的读取行为。

items.title: Indistinguishability of Sum of Permutations: A Fourier Analytic Route to Classical and Quantum Security
items.summary: We study classical and quantum indistinguishability of sums of independent random permutations and related transformations from permutations to functions. Let $G$ be a finite abelian group of order $N$, and let $π^k_+(x)=π_1(x)+\cdots+π_k(x)$ for $k\geq2$ independent uniform random permutations of $G$. We give a unified Fourier analytic treatment in which the construction is represented by its probability density and a distinguisher by its acceptance function, with the classical and quantum query models imposing different restrictions on the Fourier support of the latter. Classically, we obtain the bound $O_k(q/N^{k-1/2})$ for every $q<N$, and refine it below the birthday threshold to $O_k(q^2/N^k)$. In the quantum model, a simulation argument gives $O_k(N^{-(k-3/2)})$ for $q\leq(N-1)/2$, while Fourier interpolation gives concrete finite bounds up to $q\leq4N/15$ and the query-dependent bounds $O\left(\min\left\{N^{-1/2},q^3/N^2 + 1/N\right\}\right)$ and $O_k\left(\min\left\{q^3/N^k,N^{-(k-3/2)}\right\}\right)$, for $k=2$ and $k \geq 3$, respectively, throughout $1\leq q\leq(N-1)/2$. For $q = 1$, the first bound sharpens to $O(N^{-2})$. Over $G=\mathbb F_2^n$, a one-query Fourier attack matches the order of our one-query bound, while an $N/2$-query parity attack with advantage $1/2$ shows that our bounds reach the constant-advantage query threshold. We further study two variants of sum of permutations over binary vector spaces. First, we allow arbitrary surjective linear postprocessing, which includes truncation, and obtain classical and quantum bounds that retain the output-size dependence. Second, we analyse Dinur's variable-output single-permutation construction, $\mathsf{LXoP}$, for every fixed output width, and derive its classical and quantum security bounds; for one- and two-block outputs, we give concrete quantum security bounds.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究「独立随机置换之和」这类由置换构造函数的变换，在经典与量子查询模型下的不可区分性（即伪随机性）安全界。设 G 为阶为 N 的有限阿贝尔群，π^k_+(x)=π_1(x)+…+π_k(x)，其中 π_i 为 G 上独立均匀随机置换，k≥2。作者提出统一的傅里叶分析框架：把构造本身表示为其概率密度函数，把区分器表示为其接受函数，经典与量子查询模型分别对应接受函数傅里叶支撑的不同限制，从而在同一框架内同时推导两类界。经典模型下得到对任意 q<N 的 O_k(q/N^{k-1/2}) 界；在生日阈值以下进一步收紧为 O_k(q^2/N^k)。量子模型下，通过模拟论证得到 q≤(N-1)/2 时 O_k(N^{-(k-3/2)})；利用傅里叶插值给出 q≤4N/15 的具体有限界，以及在整个 1≤q≤(N-1)/2 范围内的查询相关界：k=2 时为 O(min{N^{-1/2}, q^3/N^2+1/N})，k≥3 时为 O_k(min{q^3/N^k, N^{-(k-3/2)}})；q=1 时前一界可精确到 O(N^{-2})。在 G=F_2^n 上，作者给出一个单查询傅里叶攻击，其量级与单查询上界相符；同时给出一个 N/2 查询的奇偶性攻击，优势达 1/2，说明所得界已经触及常量优势的查询阈值，即界在阶上是最优的。文章还研究二元向量空间上置换之和的两个变体：一是允许任意满射线性后处理（包含截断），得到保留输出长度依赖关系的经典与量子界；二是分析 Dinur 的变长输出单置换构造 LXoP，对每个固定输出宽度给出经典与量子安全界，并针对单块与两块输出给出具体的量子安全界。整体贡献在于提供统一、可复用的傅里叶分析工具，并为 XoP/LXoP 系构造给出更紧、且在关键参数区间可匹配攻击的安全界。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 置换之和（XoP）是大量对称密码构造、可调分组密码与 MAC 方案的安全基石。本文同时给出经典与量子查询模型下的紧界，并证明界在阶上最优，直接决定这些构造在量子对手下的参数选择与安全裕度评估，对密码设计与标准化评估有直接价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到依赖置换之和、截断输出或变长输出（LXoP 型）构造的安全证明与参数选取，用于评估现有方案的量子安全裕度、判断可证明安全界是否已达到最优，以及在标准化评审中作为安全论证的参考基准。
defense_advice_zh: 在采用置换之和（XoP）或 LXoP 型构造时，按本文的经典与量子界重新核算查询复杂度与安全裕度，特别是输出被截断或输出宽度受限的场景。
对涉及该构造的协议，评估量子对手模型下的参数是否需要加大群阶 N 或增加置换数量 k，以保持原有的目标安全强度。
关注其匹配攻击（单查询傅里叶攻击、N/2 查询奇偶性攻击）所揭示的界可达性，避免把仅具常量优势的攻击误判为可忽略风险。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并纳入内部密码方案安全评估的参考依据

items.title: Cyclotomic Cosets: Hidden Subgroup and Quantum Sieving Algorithm for Prime-Power Moduli
items.summary: The Learning With Errors (LWE) problem is a fundamental assumption in post-quantum cryptography. Regev established a quantum reduction from LWE to the Dihedral Coset Problem (DCP). Later, Brakerski et al. introduced the Extrapolated Dihedral Coset Problem (EDCP), proving its equivalence to LWE. However, unlike DCP, EDCP no longer admits a coset structure. This limits the direct application of techniques for hidden subgroup problems. In this work, we introduce the Cyclotomic Coset Problem (CCP), a cyclotomic generalization of DCP that preserves an exact hidden-subgroup structure. Let $ζ_p$ be a primitive $p$-th root of unity, let $π=ζ_p-1$, and write $q=p^t$ and $L=t(p-1)$. We work over $R_q=\mathbb Z_q[ζ_p] \cong \mathbb Z[ζ_p]/(π^L)$, where the isomorphism follows from the total ramification identity $(p)=(π)^{p-1}$. We exploit the resulting $π$-adic ideal chain to construct a quantum sieve that successively reduces phase states modulo $π^{L},π^{L-1},\ldots,π$. For every fixed prime $p$ and modulus $q=p^t$, our algorithm solves the CCP in time and sample complexity $2^{O_p(\log n\log q)}$, using polynomial quantum space. The sieve also applies to uniform EDCP and Gaussian S|LWE>, yielding quasi-polynomial time algorithms for all the above problems when $q=\text{poly}(n)$. This extends the power-of-two EDCP sieve of Bai et al. (CRYPTO 2025) to a cyclotomic setting. However, we emphasize that our result does not, by itself, yield a quasi-polynomial-time algorithm for standard LWE, because the currently known reduction produces only a limited number of approximate CCP states.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究后量子密码核心困难假设 LWE 的量子归约链条。背景上，Regev 曾建立从 LWE 到二面体陪集问题 (DCP) 的量子归约，其后 Brakerski 等人提出外推二面体陪集问题 (EDCP) 并证明其与 LWE 等价。但与 DCP 不同，EDCP 不再具备陪集结构，因此隐藏子群问题 (HSP) 的成熟技术难以直接套用，这成为量子归约分析中的关键瓶颈。作者提出分圆陪集问题 (CCP)，即 DCP 的分圆推广，其核心贡献在于该问题保留了精确的隐藏子群结构。构造方式为：取 ζ_p 为本原 p 次单位根，令 π=ζ_p-1，q=p^t，L=t(p-1)，在环 R_q = Z_q[ζ_p] ≅ Z[ζ_p]/(π^L) 上工作，该同构来自完全分歧恒等式 (p)=(π)^{p-1}。基于由此得到的 π-adic 理想链，作者构造了一个量子筛，逐级将相位态按模 π^L, π^{L-1}, …, π 递降约化。理论结果显示：对任意固定素数 p 与模数 q=p^t，算法以时间与样本复杂度 2^{O_p(log n·log q)} 求解 CCP，且仅使用多项式量级的量子空间。该筛方法同时适用于均匀 EDCP 与高斯 S|LWE> 态，在 q=poly(n) 时给出上述问题的准多项式时间算法，从而把 Bai 等人 (CRYPTO 2025) 针对 2 的幂情形设计的 EDCP 筛推广到分圆设定。作者明确强调：该结果本身并不构成对标准 LWE 的准多项式时间算法，因为目前已知的归约只能产生数量有限的近似 CCP 态，这一限制是后续能否威胁实用 PQC 的关键分水岭。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 后量子密码 (ML-KEM/ML-DSA 所依赖的 LWE 与模格假设) 的安全边界高度依赖量子归约研究。本文说明 EDCP 类问题在分圆设定下可被准多项式量子算法求解，但尚未触及标准 LWE，属重要理论进展而非现实威胁，值得密码与 PQC 团队跟踪。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响后量子密码的安全性假设评估与参数选取的理论依据，并可迁移至隐藏子群问题、量子筛等分析框架。不构成对现有已部署密码系统的实际攻击能力，无现网可利用面。
defense_advice_zh: 将本文纳入 PQC 安全假设的文献跟踪清单，关注其是否被后续工作扩展到标准 LWE 归约
在密码敏捷性规划中，保持对格基/模格方案参数评估结论的定期复核机制
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: An Operator-Norm Approach to Security with Quantum Advice
items.summary: Non-uniform security allows an adversary to receive bounded advice about an oracle before attempting a fresh challenge. This captures the most realistic attacks and has already been studied extensively in prior work. In this work, we introduce an operator-norm approach for non-uniform security in the quantum random oracle and random permutation models. This new approach yields a unified reduction for both search success probability and distinguishing advantage. Previously, the reduction only worked with success probability even in the decision games, yielding a worse bound. Our framework enables tight bounds for Yao's box, both with and without salting, and improved bounds for pseudorandom generators. We also prove an optimal generic salting theorem for decision games. By defining a property of a game, which separates the contributions of the existing queries in the offline stage and subsequent online queries, we obtain stronger bounds for specific salted constructions. These include salted permutation inversion, tight up to logarithmic factors, and salted random-function inversion, tight up to logarithmic factors and the gap already present in classical function inversion.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究非一致性（non-uniform）安全性：攻击者可在面对全新挑战之前获得关于预言机的有界建议（advice）信息，这一模型刻画了先离线预处理、再在线发起攻击的最现实攻击模式，此前在量子随机预言机模型（QROM）与随机置换模型中已有大量研究。本文提出一种基于算子范数（operator-norm）的新分析框架来处理量子建议下的非一致性安全。其核心创新在于：用统一的归约同时刻画搜索型博弈的成功概率与判定型（decision）博弈的区分优势；而此前的归约方法即使在判定博弈中也只能处理成功概率，因而得到的界更松。借助这一框架，作者为 Yao's box（带盐与不带盐两种情形）给出了紧界，并改进了伪随机生成器（PRG）的安全性界；同时证明了判定博弈下最优的通用加盐（salting）定理，即加盐能在多大程度上降低预处理优势的一个通用上界。方法层面，作者定义了博弈的一种属性，用以分离离线阶段已有查询与随后在线查询各自的贡献，从而对特定加盐构造给出更强的界，包括带盐置换反演（tight up to 对数因子）与带盐随机函数反演（tight up to 对数因子，且与经典函数反演中已存在的差距一致）。整体而言，这是一项偏理论的密码学成果，为量子环境下的非一致性安全提供了更紧、更统一的证明工具，适合从事可证明安全、量子密码与密码方案安全参数评估的研究者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 非一致性安全是评估预处理型攻击的标准模型。该工作以算子范数统一了搜索型与判定型博弈的归约，为 Yao's box、PRG 及带盐反演给出更紧的界，直接影响 QROM/随机置换模型下方案安全参数选取与证明可信度。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到量子随机预言机/随机置换模型下方案的安全参数评估：涉及基于 Yao's box 的密钥派生或比特承诺、PRG 的紧安全界、以及抗预处理攻击的加盐设计（置换反演、随机函数反演）。为审查现有证明中判定型博弈界过松的问题提供理论修正依据。
defense_advice_zh: 在评估依赖 QROM/随机置换模型的可证明安全方案时，注意原有归约在判定型博弈中仅处理成功概率、界偏松的问题，改用统一的搜索+判定归约重新核算安全参数。
对采用加盐（salting）抵御离线预处理的构造，参考本文的通用加盐定理与针对具体构造的紧界，重新评估盐长与查询预算的取值是否仍满足目标安全级别。
关注带盐置换反演、带盐随机函数反演的界与经典函数反演固有差距的关系，避免在参数选取时忽略该差距而高估安全性。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Classical Verification of Quantum Computation with Quasilinear Resources, from Compiled Nonlocal Games
items.summary: Computational self-testing gives a classical verifier command over the quantum register of a single computationally bounded prover. We use this framework to construct the first argument system for BQP with quasilinear total resource requirements in the circuit model. Our argument system is based on the learning with errors (LWE) assumption and requires total resources of $O(\mathrm{poly}(λ, \log g)\cdot g)$ for delegating a circuit with $g$ gates, where $λ$ is the LWE security parameter. This is achieved by constructing a new computational self-test for certifying the prover's quantum state and using it to dequantize the efficient verification protocol of Broadbent (ToC 2018). Specifically, this self-test enables the verifiable, random remote state preparation of tensor product states of the single-qubit Clifford observables $σ_X, σ_Y, σ_Z, (σ_Y-σ_X)/\sqrt{2}$ and $(σ_Y+σ_X)/\sqrt{2}$, with constant robustness: the verification error is independent of the number of prepared qubits. This approach was first proposed by Coladangelo et al. (ToC 2024) in the multi-prover setting. We replicate their result in the single-prover setting by applying the compiler proposed by Kalai et al. (STOC 2023)---which turns any nonlocal game into a single-prover argument system---to a modified version of their self-test.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究的是「量子计算的经典验证」这一核心问题：如何让一个只能进行经典计算的验证者，去核实一台不受信任的量子证明者是否正确地执行了量子电路。作者 Holler 与 Natarajan 基于「计算自测试」(computational self-testing) 框架——即经典验证者能够对单个、计算能力受限的证明者的量子寄存器施加控制——构造出首个在电路模型下总资源需求为准线性的 BQP 论证系统 (argument system)。其安全基础是 LWE (Learning With Errors) 假设，总资源开销为 O(poly(λ, log g)·g)，其中 g 是所委托电路的门数，λ 是 LWE 安全参数；这意味着验证开销对电路规模近似线性、对安全参数为多项式级，是该方向上首次达到准线性总资源。技术上，作者构造了一个新的计算自测试，用于对证明者的量子态进行认证，并借此将 Broadbent (ToC 2018) 的高效验证协议「去量子化」，即将原本需要量子验证者的部分转化为纯经典可执行的验证。该自测试能够以可验证且随机的方式，远程制备单量子比特 Clifford 可观测量 σ_X、σ_Y、σ_Z、(σ_Y−σ_X)/√2 与 (σ_Y+σ_X)/√2 的张量积态，并具有常数鲁棒性——验证误差与所制备量子比特的数量无关，这是实现准线性资源的关键。方法论上，多证明者场景下的类似结果此前由 Coladangelo 等人 (ToC 2024) 提出；本文利用 Kalai 等人 (STOC 2023) 提出的编译器（可将任意非局域博弈 nonlocal game 转化为单证明者论证系统），将其应用于经过修改的自测试，从而在单证明者设置下复现了该结果。论文属于量子密码学与复杂性理论交叉方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 量子外包计算的可验证性是后量子时代密码基础设施的关键课题。该工作首次在单证明者、准线性资源下实现 BQP 委托验证，且仅依赖 LWE 假设，若未来落地，将直接影响量子云服务的可信委托与审计模型设计。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响量子云计算中的「可验证委托计算」(verifiable delegated quantum computation) 场景，以及基于 LWE 的密码协议设计。短期为理论进展，尚无可直接部署的实现；对经典安全工程无直接攻击面影响。
defense_advice_zh: 关注 LWE 参数选择与准线性资源结论所隐含的安全边界，评估其对现有后量子密码选型的长期影响
若所在机构使用或规划量子云外包计算服务，将该类可验证委托协议纳入技术预研与信任模型讨论
跟踪 Kalai 等人编译器与 Broadbent 协议的后续实现与工程化进展，评估单证明者假设在真实云环境中的适用性
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: A Function-level Dataset of Vulnerable and Fixed Source Code in JavaScript and TypeScript
items.summary: JavaScript and TypeScript are widely used in modern web development, making their security critical; however, automated vulnerability detection is often constrained by the availability of high-quality training data. Here we present JsVul, a dataset curated from seven major sources. Unlike generic multi-language datasets that may retain noise -- such as minified code and cosmetic edits -- JsVul utilizes a language-specific pipeline. We collected pre-fix and post-fix versions of files around security fixes and, by filtering irrelevant artifacts and applying automated syntax normalization, isolated security-related changes. We ensured data integrity through multi-stage deduplication and heuristic-based labeling. Provided in a time-ordered JSONL format, JsVul supports robust model training in the JavaScript and TypeScript ecosystem and demonstrates the importance of language-aware preprocessing in building vulnerability datasets.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对 JavaScript 与 TypeScript 生态中自动化漏洞检测长期受限于高质量训练数据不足的问题，构建并公开发布了函数级漏洞数据集 JsVul。与常见的多语言通用数据集不同，JsVul 采用面向 JS/TS 的语言特定处理流水线：作者从七个主要来源采集数据，围绕安全修复提交收集修复前与修复后的代码版本，并通过过滤与安全无关的产物（如压缩/混淆代码、仅涉及格式或注释的装饰性改动）以及施加自动化语法规范化，把真正与安全相关的代码变更隔离出来。为保证数据完整性，流水线还包含多阶段去重与基于启发式规则的标注；数据集以按时间排序的 JSONL 格式提供，便于做时序切分实验，降低训练/测试集泄漏风险。论文的核心贡献有三点：一是提供了一个规模化的、语言感知的 JS/TS 函数级“漏洞—修复”配对数据集，可直接用于监督学习式的漏洞检测模型训练；二是论证了在构建漏洞数据集时语言特定预处理对降低噪声、提升标签质量的重要性；三是为后续漏洞检测模型与代码大模型的训练和评测提供可比较的数据基础。适合漏洞检测研究者、代码大模型团队、SAST/SCA 工具开发者以及需要在真实 JS/TS 代码上评估模型的安全工程团队阅读。需要注意的是，论文摘要表明标签由启发式方法生成，实际使用前应评估其标注准确率。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 数据质量往往是 JS/TS 漏洞检测模型效果的上限。JsVul 用语言感知流水线剔除压缩代码与装饰性提交，提供修复前后配对的函数级样本，直接影响安全团队训练与评测代码漏洞检测模型、LLM 代码审查能力的可信度。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用于 JS/TS 漏洞检测模型的训练与基准评测、SAST/SCA 规则有效性验证以及 LLM 代码安全审查能力评估；其语言特定预处理、多阶段去重与按时间切分的方法论可迁移到其他语言的漏洞数据集构建。标签为启发式生成，落地前需抽样人工复核。
defense_advice_zh: 在采用 JsVul 训练或微调漏洞检测模型前，抽样人工复核启发式标签的准确性，剔除误标样本
按数据集自带的时间顺序做训练/验证/测试切分，避免时间穿越导致评测指标虚高
将模型输出仅作为代码审查的辅助信号，与 SAST 结果及人工评审形成多源交叉验证
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：获取数据集评估标签质量，并在内部 JS/TS 代码库上验证其训练模型的检测效果

items.title: Safer Content or Firmer Refusals? A Hybrid Perturbation Defense for Alignment under Harmful Fine-tuning
items.summary: Fine-tuning-as-a-service lets users adapt a safety-aligned language model to their own data, but it also creates a harmful fine-tuning attack surface: a small amount of harmful data mixed into an otherwise benign fine-tuning set can degrade the model's alignment. Two recent alignment-stage defenses address this problem at different levels of the model. Vaccine improves the robustness of hidden embeddings to the representation shifts induced by harmful fine-tuning, whereas Booster simulates harmful weight updates and attenuates their effect during alignment. We investigate whether these mechanisms are complementary and propose VaccineBooster, a single alignment procedure that combines embedding perturbation and weight-level gradient attenuation within each training step. On Llama-2-7B aligned with BeaverTails and then attacked through poisoned fine-tuning, VaccineBooster achieves the lowest OpenAI moderation score among the compared defenses, 0.315, while a Booster-Only variant retains the highest post-attack refusal rate, 50%. Together with ablations over the embedding-perturbation and gradient-attenuation strengths, these results indicate a trade-off: embedding perturbation primarily reduces flagged harmful content, whereas gradient attenuation primarily preserves explicit refusal behavior. Because our evaluation uses ten prompts and a single unseeded run per configuration, we report this trade-off as an observed pattern rather than a statistically resolved effect. These results provide practical guidance for prioritizing content safety or refusal retention when aligned models are exposed to untrusted fine-tuning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究"微调即服务"(Fine-tuning-as-a-service)场景下的有害微调(harmful fine-tuning)攻击面: 用户在对齐后的语言模型上用自有数据做微调时, 只需在大量良性样本中混入少量有害数据, 就足以削弱模型原有的安全对齐, 使其更易输出有害内容。作者关注对齐阶段的两类现有防御: Vaccine 通过在隐藏层嵌入表示上施加扰动, 提升嵌入对有害微调所引发表示漂移的鲁棒性; Booster 则模拟有害微调产生的权重更新, 并在对齐训练过程中衰减其影响。论文提出 VaccineBooster, 在同一个对齐训练步骤内同时结合嵌入扰动与权重层梯度衰减, 以检验两种机制是否互补。实验在 Llama-2-7B 上进行: 先用 BeaverTails 完成安全对齐, 再通过投毒微调实施攻击。结果显示 VaccineBooster 在参与对比的防御中取得最低的 OpenAI 内容审核分数 0.315, 而仅使用 Booster 的变体保留了最高的攻击后拒答率 50%。针对嵌入扰动强度与梯度衰减强度的消融实验表明二者存在权衡: 嵌入扰动主要用于减少被标记的有害内容, 梯度衰减主要用于保住显式的拒答行为。作者也明确指出, 实验仅使用 10 条提示、每种配置只运行一次且未设随机种子, 因此将该权衡作为观察到的现象而非统计上确证的结论报告。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 微调即服务是大模型落地的常见形态, 少量投毒样本即可击穿对齐, 属于供应链与租户隔离层面的现实风险。文中"降有害内容 vs 保拒答行为"的权衡结论, 可直接用于设计对齐阶段防御与上线评估指标。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于提供微调 API 的平台方、企业内部微调与模型发布流程, 以及模型安全评估环节; 也可迁移到对齐训练策略的选型与组合(嵌入扰动类与梯度衰减类防御的取舍)。
detection_signals_zh: 微调数据集中有害样本占比异常, 或出现与声明用途不符的数据混入
微调前后模型对有害请求的拒答率显著下降
微调后模型输出在内容审核(如 OpenAI moderation 类评分)中的有害分数上升
极少量有害样本即可导致对齐指标突变, 提示数据缺乏过滤或租户间隔离不足
微调作业缺少数据来源审计、权重版本与训练数据的可追溯记录
defense_advice_zh: 在微调管线入口做有害数据检测与过滤, 并对数据集来源与用途做审计
微调后强制执行回归评估: 拒答率、内容审核分数、红队提示集通过率与基线对比后再放行
在对齐阶段评估组合式防御(嵌入扰动 + 梯度衰减), 并按业务优先级决定更侧重内容安全还是拒答保留
对租户微调实施资源与权限隔离, 保留训练数据与权重版本的可追溯记录
扩大评估样本量与随机种子数量, 避免依据单次小样本实验做出上线决策
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Understanding Private Evolution as Learning-Augmented Clustering
items.summary: Private Evolution (PE) is a differentially private algorithm for synthetic data generation. While it can be viewed as a Wasserstein learning algorithm, it performs much better in practice than worst-case Wasserstein analyses would predict. We recast PE as generative model-augmented Wasserstein learning. We show theoretically that when we take into account the use of a generative model that is able to capture something about the true distribution, then we can obtain much better performance bounds. For example, if the generator gives samples in the same low-dimensional space as the distribution, then sample complexity depends on intrinsic, not ambient, dimension. We also show that standard variants of PE can fail to converge on simple well-clustered instances, and propose a new geometry-aware version of PE with provable convergence on such instances. Experimentally, we show that our new algorithm is competitive with standard baselines and can improve recall.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究差分隐私合成数据生成算法 Private Evolution（PE）的理论性质与改进方案。PE 是一种在差分隐私约束下生成合成数据的迭代式算法，其工作方式可以形式化为一种 Wasserstein（最优传输）学习过程：算法反复从生成器采样候选数据、在隐私保护下依据与真实数据的距离进行筛选与演化。作者指出一个长期存在的理论与实践的落差——按最坏情况下的 Wasserstein 分析，PE 所需的样本复杂度应当很高，但它在实际任务中表现远好于该理论上界。为解释这一现象，作者将 PE 重新建模为“生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 学习”（generative model-augmented Wasserstein learning），即把生成器本身视为一个携带了真实分布先验信息的组件，而不是完全无信息的假设类。在这一框架下，作者证明：当生成器能够捕捉真实分布的部分结构时，可以得到显著更优的性能界；例如若生成器在分布所处的同一低维子空间中采样，则样本复杂度只依赖于分布的内在维度（intrinsic dimension），而与环境的周围维度（ambient dimension）无关，这解释了高维数据上 PE 的实际有效性。作者同时揭示了一个负面结果：PE 的标准变体在若干简单且聚类结构良好的实例上可能无法收敛，说明现有算法在几何结构利用上存在缺陷。针对该问题，论文提出一种新的“几何感知”（geometry-aware）版本的 PE，并给出在上述良聚类实例上可证明收敛的理论保证。实验部分显示，该新算法与标准基线方法相比具有竞争力，并且在召回率（recall）指标上有所提升。整体而言，论文从理论刻画、反例构造到新算法与实验验证构成完整闭环，属于差分隐私合成数据与生成式建模交叉方向的工作，适合隐私机器学习、差分隐私合成数据、最优传输与聚类理论方向的研究者和工程实践者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 差分隐私合成数据正被用于敏感数据共享与模型训练，PE 是其中的代表性方法。本文解释了其实际效果优于理论预测的原因，并指出标准实现可能在良聚类数据上不收敛，为评估与选型提供了新的理论依据和改进算法。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响采用差分隐私合成数据发布流程的场景，如医疗、金融等敏感数据的对外共享与内部建模；几何感知改进可迁移到任何依赖迭代采样-筛选式生成的高维隐私合成数据流水线，用于提升召回率与收敛可靠性。
defense_advice_zh: 若内部使用 PE 或类似迭代式差分隐私合成数据流程，应针对具有明显聚类结构的数据集单独做收敛性验证，而不仅依赖默认的隐私预算与迭代次数配置。
在合成数据上线前，除隐私预算核算外，应同时评估效用指标（如召回率、下游模型性能）与迭代过程的稳定性，避免仅凭最坏情况理论界做容量规划。
关注并跟进该类几何感知算法变体的开源实现，评估替换标准 PE 的可行性与成本。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Succinct Arguments for QMA from Collapsing Hash Functions
items.summary: We prove the existence of succinct arguments for QMA, assuming only the existence of collapsing hash functions. This is the first scheme that relies only on unstructured ``Minicrypt'' assumptions, which are not known to imply public-key encryption. Our main technical contribution is a quantum-succinct \emph{claw-state generation} protocol that allows us to bootstrap a small number of quantum correlations into an arbitrarily large number of claw-state correlations, using classical communication only. This improves upon the work of [Zhang, STOC 2021], having better round complexity, a proof in the standard model, and being overall much simpler. This yields a quantum-succinct blind delegation of quantum computation protocol from one-way functions, which we plug into the communication-compression compiler of [Bartusek, Liu, and Malavolta, EUROCRYPT 2026] to obtain succinct arguments for QMA.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究量子计算时代可验证计算的理论基础问题：能否在尽可能弱的密码学假设下，为 QMA（量子 Merlin-Arthur，即量子版 NP 的验证类）构造简洁论证（succinct arguments）。作者证明：只要存在 collapsing hash functions（坍缩哈希函数），就存在 QMA 的简洁论证。这是首个仅依赖非结构化“Minicrypt”类假设的方案——此前相关构造通常需要更强假设（如公钥加密、后量子安全的多项式承诺等），而已知 Minicrypt 假设（例如单向函数）并不能推出公钥加密，因此该结果显著降低了信任假设门槛。核心技术创新是一个量子简洁的“claw-state generation”（爪态生成）协议：它仅使用经典通信，就能把少量量子关联自举（bootstrap）为任意大数量的 claw-state 关联，使验证者可用极少的量子能力完成大量相关量子态的生成与验证。该协议相较 Zhang（STOC 2021）的方案有三点改进：轮复杂度更低、在标准模型下可证明安全、整体构造更简洁。借助该协议，作者从单向函数出发得到量子计算的量子简洁盲委托（blind delegation）协议，再将其接入 Bartusek、Liu 与 Malavolta（EUROCRYPT 2026）的通信压缩编译器，最终得到 QMA 的简洁论证。论文属于量子密码学与复杂性理论交叉方向，适合从事可验证量子计算、量子委托、简洁论证、后量子假设研究的理论与密码学研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 结果表明 QMA 简洁论证与量子委托可建立在 Minicrypt 级假设上，降低了对强公钥原语的依赖，促使安全从业者重新评估量子时代协议的信任假设与迁移路径。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响量子委托计算、可验证量子计算、通信压缩编译器及后量子密码假设选择；属中长期理论影响，暂不直接对应现实攻击面，但可能改变未来协议设计所依赖的最小假设集。
defense_advice_zh: 跟踪该方向进展，评估未来量子委托/可验证量子计算协议对假设强度与实现复杂度的要求变化
在内部密码学评审中记录“Minicrypt 级假设即可支撑 QMA 简洁论证”这一结论，供长期迁移路线参考

items.title: GAZEleak: Passcode Inference Against Eye-tracking XR Devices Through External Observation
items.summary: Mixed-reality headsets such as Apple Vision Pro replace the touch screen with gaze-as-pointer interaction: the wearer looks at a target and confirms with an air pinch. Because the display is inside the headset and the eye tracker is walled off from third-party software, such input is widely assumed to be unobservable to bystanders---a built-in defense against the shoulder-surfing that plagues phones and laptops. We present GAZEleak, a side-channel attack that recovers gaze-driven input from external video of head motion alone, under a strictly local, physical-observer threat model: the adversary only films the wearer from across the room and installs no software on the device. The attack exploits the centrally coupled eye-head motor program: gaze shifts recruit small, target-dependent head reorientations that project into sub-degree pose changes recoverable from commodity video. GAZEleak implements a measurement-based, sparse-optical-flow inference pipeline for users' 6-digit device passcodes. On a preliminary front-view dataset from three author-subjects who were aware of the attack hypothesis, GAZEleak places the true code within the top ten guesses for 56% (10 of 18) of test codes under a cross-person protocol with no labeled victim data, and for every code of the most exposed subject. The performance is subject-dependent: no passcode from the least exposed subject reaches the top ten, although its median guessed passcode rank is 12,786 rather than 500,000 expected from an uninformative ordering. These results provide preliminary evidence that gaze-coupled head motion can expose passcode information under controlled conditions, while motivating broader evaluation across users, behaviors, and capture settings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究混合现实头显（如 Apple Vision Pro）新型交互方式带来的隐私风险。这类设备用「注视即指针」取代触摸屏：用户注视目标、再以空中捏合确认。由于显示屏位于头显内部、眼动追踪数据也被封闭在系统内不对第三方软件开放，业界普遍认为这种输入方式对旁观者不可观测，从而天然抵御了困扰手机与笔记本的肩窥（shoulder-surfing）问题。作者提出 GAZEleak，一种侧信道攻击，证明该假设不成立：攻击者只需站在房间另一端用普通摄像机拍摄佩戴者，无需在设备上安装任何软件，威胁模型被严格限定为本地物理观察者。其技术依据是眼—头运动程序的中央耦合特性：每一次注视转移都会伴随幅度很小、且与目标位置相关的头部重定向，这些重定向会投影成亚度级的头部姿态变化，可被消费级视频恢复出来。GAZEleak 据此实现了一套基于测量标定、使用稀疏光流的推理流水线，用于推断用户 6 位设备口令。评估基于三位知情作者受试者的正面视角初步数据集：在跨人协议、完全不含受害者标注数据的条件下，18 个测试口令中有 10 个（56%）的真值进入前十候选，暴露度最高的受试者的全部口令均进入前十。性能高度依赖个体差异：暴露度最低的受试者没有任何口令进入前十，但其猜测中位排名为 12786，仍远优于无信息排序下 500000 的期望值。作者结论是，该结果只是在受控条件下提供了「注视耦合头动可泄露口令信息」的初步证据，仍需跨更多用户、行为和拍摄设置开展更广泛评估。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它直接挑战了 XR 设备「屏内显示 + 封闭眼动追踪即可防肩窥」的默认安全假设，说明纯外部视频、零设备植入也能构成口令侧信道，公共场合佩戴头显输入敏感凭证的风险需要重新评估。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用注视+手势确认交互的 XR/MR 头显及其口令、PIN、支付确认等场景；思路可迁移到其他「微小生理耦合运动泄露输入」的侧信道研究（如键盘、触屏、可穿戴设备），也适用于高铁、机舱、会议室等半公共空间的隐私评估。
detection_signals_zh: 公共或半公共空间中，有人长时间以手机/相机稳定对准佩戴 XR 头显者的正面或侧面
佩戴者输入 PIN/口令期间附近出现持续录像行为，无正常拍摄理由
同一观察者反复出现在受保护区域的同一位置、对同一目标进行录制
内部区域出现朝向头显佩戴者固定机位或三脚架装置
佩戴者输入期间出现异常的光流/姿态分析类视频后处理痕迹（主要靠物理巡检而非网络侧发现）
defense_advice_zh: 在公共场合使用 XR 头显输入敏感口令前，先评估周围是否存在可拍摄自己正面的位置或人员
对高敏感身份验证改用不依赖屏幕上数字键盘的方式，如硬件安全密钥、外部认证器或生物特征
厂商侧建议研究在头部姿态中注入随机化扰动、要求更大或非规律性确认动作、缩短截获窗口等缓解措施
将肩窥威胁模型从手机/笔记本扩展到 XR 设备，纳入内部隐私风险与红队评估清单
办公与差旅场景中尽量减少在开放空间佩戴头显进行凭证输入，必要时使用遮挡物或独立私密空间

items.title: Analyzing Solana's Blocks and Transactions
items.summary: Solana is one of the most popular blockchains, and is arguably the most widely used blockchain for smart contracts, also known as dApps. Understanding the types of smart contracts that are being executed by Solana and their interplay is therefore highly beneficial both for designers of modern blockchains and developers of smart contracts. To that end, in this paper we analyze a million recent Solana blocks. We report statistics about the size of blocks (number of transactions per block), execution time units for individual transactions and fees, and invoked Solana programs. Further, based on the declared readset and writeset of each transaction, as mandated by Solana, we analyze the conflicts and corresponding conflict graphs arising within each block. These latter statistics are important to understand the potential for parallelism in the network, which is one of the main claimed benefits of Solana. The data and code are available in open source.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文对 Solana 区块链进行了一次大规模实证测量研究。Solana 是目前最流行的公链之一，也被广泛认为是承载智能合约（dApp）最多的区块链，因此弄清链上实际执行的智能合约类型及其相互调用/关联方式，对现代区块链的设计者与智能合约开发者都极具价值。作者采集并分析了一百万个近期 Solana 区块，围绕多个维度给出统计结果：每个区块包含的交易数量（即区块规模）、单笔交易消耗的计算单元与执行时间、交易手续费，以及被调用的 Solana 程序（program）分布情况。更具分析深度的是，论文利用 Solana 强制要求每笔交易声明的读集（readset）与写集（writeset），统计区块内部出现的读写冲突，并构建和刻画相应的冲突图。由于读/写集冲突直接决定哪些交易可以并行执行，这些统计数据为评估 Solana 所宣称的核心优势之一——高并行度——提供了可量化依据：冲突越多、冲突图越稠密，矿工/验证者可用于并行调度的空间就越小。作者同时开源了所用数据与代码，使结果可复现，也便于后续研究者扩展时间窗口、对比不同版本或与其他公链做横向比较。整体而言，这是一篇典型的公链测量类论文，贡献在于刻画真实负载特征、量化并行潜力，并为区块链调度器、费用机制及智能合约开发实践提供数据支撑。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 安全与运维团队可借此理解 Solana 真实负载与读写冲突结构，为异常交易识别、账户热点争用、费用/计算单元异常以及吞吐与并行调度退化等监测提供基线参照。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至公链节点运维、链上异常检测、MEV 与交易争用分析、以及区块链并行执行引擎的性能与安全评估等场景。
detection_signals_zh: 区块内读写集冲突率或冲突图密度异常升高，可能反映争用、抢跑或垃圾交易聚集
单交易计算单元/执行时间分布出现偏离基线的长尾
特定程序调用次数在短时间内异常集中，可能对应刷量或合约被滥用
区块交易数与手续费分布突变，可能对应网络拥塞或人为施压
defense_advice_zh: 将论文给出的区块规模、费用、计算单元、程序调用分布作为监控基线，配置阈值告警
关注账户级读写集热点，识别被高频争用的账户以提前评估性能与安全风险
对并行度下降的区块做回溯分析，区分正常负载与潜在的资源耗尽型行为
复用其开源数据与代码，结合自有节点数据做持续性的链上行为建模
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：可复现其统计方法并作为内部链上监测基线参考

items.title: A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester Car Driving School Management System 1.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /classes/Master.php?f=save_enrollment...
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester Car Driving School Management System 1.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /classes/Master.php?f=save_enrollment. The manipulation results in sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-102913 是 NVD 收录的一则 SQL 注入漏洞, 影响 SourceCodester Car Driving School Management System 1.0。根据公开元数据描述, 问题出在文件 /classes/Master.php 中 f=save_enrollment 所对应的功能处理逻辑上, 由于该处未对用户可控输入做充分的参数化处理或转义, 攻击者可通过构造特制请求改变后端执行的 SQL 语句结构, 从而实现注入。厂商与受影响产品版本在元数据中仅给出上述内容, 具体受影响函数被标注为 "unknown function", 因此尚未明确到具体代码行或参数名。该漏洞的 CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.3, 向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L, 表明攻击可远程发起、无需认证、无需用户交互, 利用门槛较低, 但对机密性、完整性与可用性的影响均被评为低等级。NVD 描述同时指出, 该漏洞的利用方式已被公开披露, 意味着任何能够访问该应用的攻击者都可以参考公开信息尝试利用, 这显著降低了实际攻击的技术门槛。需要强调的是, 输入数据中已入 KEV 与已在野利用字段均为 False, 因此不应将其判定为已被在野利用或已确认武器化。此类针对小型 PHP 应用的 SQL 注入常被自动化扫描器批量识别, 进而被用于批量数据抓取、登录凭据泄露、数据库内容篡改乃至进一步横向移动。由于该产品属于教学/演示性质的练车学校管理系统, 实际部署中常出现在互联网暴露的测试或小型生产环境中, 且更新维护频率较低, 若未及时修补, 风险敞口持续时间可能较长。防御方应优先确认资产是否暴露在公网, 并对相关接口的输入进行审计与加固。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 远程未授权即可触发的 SQL 注入, 利用门槛低且利用方式已公开, 互联网暴露的实例极易被扫描器批量命中; 虽未确认在野利用, 但数据库读取与篡改风险实在。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功的注入可导致后端数据库中的敏感信息被未授权读取, 数据被篡改或删除, 并可能作为进一步攻击的跳板; CVSS 7.3, 定级为高危。

items.title: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Online Leave Management System 1.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /admin/?page=reports. The manipulatio...
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Online Leave Management System 1.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /admin/?page=reports. The manipulation of the argument date_start/date_end leads to sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-102912 是 SourceCodester Online Leave Management System 1.0 中被披露的一个 SQL 注入漏洞。该问题影响文件 /admin/?page=reports 中未明确说明的处理逻辑：当向 date_start 与 date_end 这两个参数传入被构造的输入时，应用未对参数做充分的转义或参数化处理，导致攻击者可以将恶意 SQL 片段拼入后端数据库查询语句并被执行，从而读取、篡改甚至破坏数据库中的内容。该漏洞可在远程触发，但按 CVSS 3.1 向量 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L) 评估，触发前需要具备管理员级别的凭据（PR:H），因此主要风险场景是已获得后台权限的账户（或凭据泄露、弱口令）进一步滥用，以及内部人员越权访问数据。总评为 4.7 分，属于中等严重程度；对机密性、完整性与可用性的影响均为低。漏洞描述同时指出，相关利用代码已公开，存在被他人直接借用滥用的风险。当前该 CVE 未列入 CISA KEV 目录，来源字段也未标记已在野利用，且暂无 EPSS 评分数据，因此不能认定已被实际攻击者利用。受影响的具体产品版本、厂商与部署范围在元数据中未提供。对该类基于 PHP 的在线请假管理系统而言，通常部署在组织内网或对外暴露的管理后台中，若后台可被互联网访问，风险会显著上升。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 公开的利用代码已存在，具备后台权限或通过弱口令/凭据泄露取得权限者即可远程触发，可能导致员工与请假数据泄露或被篡改。目前未列入 KEV、无在野利用确认，但对暴露在互联网的管理后台应优先处置。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用后可绕过应用层查询逻辑直接操作后端数据库，读取请假记录、员工信息等敏感数据，或篡改、删除数据，影响数据的机密性、完整性与可用性。由于需要管理员权限，直接未授权入侵的门槛较高，但仍是后台账户被滥用或内部越权的重要跳板。

items.title: The Frontend Post Submission Manager Lite – Frontend Posting WordPress Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via post_content Parame...
items.summary: The Frontend Post Submission Manager Lite – Frontend Posting WordPress Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via post_content Parameter (data-label DOM Sink) in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the site operator to have enabled guest post submission via the [fpsm] shortcode, which registers a publicly accessible AJAX handler gated only by a nonce emitted on every page containing the shortcode.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-96649 是一个影响 WordPress 插件 “Frontend Post Submission Manager Lite – Frontend Posting” 的存储型 DOM 跨站脚本 (XSS) 漏洞，存在于所有 1.3.4 及之前版本。该漏洞位于 post_content 参数处理流程中，具体触发点为 data-label DOM 接收器 (DOM Sink)。由于插件对用户输入缺乏充分的清理 (sanitization)，并且对输出缺乏正确的转义 (escaping)，未经身份验证的攻击者可以向页面中注入任意 Web 脚本。当其他用户访问被注入的页面时，这些脚本会在其浏览器中执行，从而构成典型的存储型 XSS 攻击。漏洞利用需要站点运营者通过 [fpsm] 短代码启用访客投稿功能，该短代码会注册一个公开可访问的 AJAX 处理程序，而该处理程序仅由一个在每个包含短代码的页面上都会输出的 nonce 进行保护。攻击者可以获取该 nonce 并提交恶意内容，因此利用门槛较低。CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.2，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N，表明远程、低复杂度、无需认证即可利用，且对机密性和完整性造成低影响，但范围可变 (Scope Changed)。当前 EPSS 无数据，未列入 KEV 目录，也没有在野利用的明确信息。受影响产品为使用该插件的 WordPress 站点，尤其是在启用访客投稿功能的情况下。该漏洞的威胁在于攻击者无需登录即可向站点注入持久化脚本，可能影响所有访问受感染页面的用户。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: CVSS 7.2 的高危存储型 XSS，无需认证即可利用，影响启用访客投稿的 WordPress 站点。可导致会话劫持、页面篡改、钓鱼与恶意重定向，且利用链依赖公开 nonce，风险实际且紧急。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可让未经身份验证的攻击者在受影响的 WordPress 站点中持久化注入任意 JavaScript。当其他用户（包括管理员）访问被注入页面时，脚本会在其浏览器上下文中执行，可能导致会话 Cookie 窃取、权限提升、敏感信息泄露、页面内容篡改或进一步的水坑攻击。由于漏洞位于访客投稿流程，攻击面面向互联网，影响范围可能覆盖所有站点访问者。

items.title: Pexip Infinity before 38.2, plus 39.0, 39.1 and 40.0, is affected by improper input validation in the media implementation that allows a remote attacker to trigger memory corrup...
items.summary: Pexip Infinity before 38.2, plus 39.0, 39.1 and 40.0, is affected by improper input validation in the media implementation that allows a remote attacker to trigger memory corruption or a software abort resulting in a denial of service. A crafted media stream may result in a controlled abort during processing, and has the potential to achieve memory corruption.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Pexip Infinity 是企业级视频会议与实时通信（RTC）平台，广泛用于政府、医疗与金融等行业的远程协作场景。根据 NVD 元数据，该产品在媒体处理实现（media implementation）中存在输入校验不当（improper input validation）问题，影响版本包括 38.2 之前的所有版本，以及 39.0、39.1 和 40.0。攻击者无需认证、也无需用户交互，即可通过网络向目标服务发送特制的媒体流（crafted media stream）；当该畸形数据被解析处理时，可能触发受控的程序中止（controlled abort），直接造成服务不可用；描述同时指出该缺陷具备进一步造成内存破坏（memory corruption）的潜力。CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.7（AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:H/A:H），显示攻击向量为网络、复杂度较高，但对机密性有轻度影响、对完整性和可用性均为高影响，因此既可能破坏媒体处理进程的稳定性导致拒绝服务，也可能在极端情况下影响数据的完整性。当前输入数据中未提供 EPSS 分值、受影响产品细目、厂商信息，也未标记 KEV 列入或在野利用，故本摘要仅基于元数据，无法确认是否存在公开利用代码或实际攻击活动。对使用该平台的机构而言，媒体面通常直接对外暴露，属于高价值入口，建议尽快核查版本并规划升级。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 视频会议平台的媒体处理面通常需对外网暴露，未认证攻击者可直接投递畸形媒体流触发服务中止，影响会议与通信可用性，并存在内存破坏的进一步风险，修复优先级较高。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致媒体处理进程受控中止，造成会议/通信服务拒绝服务；元数据还提示存在内存破坏可能性，理论上可能影响服务完整性与少量敏感信息，但未标记在野利用。

items.summary: Pexip Infinity before 38.2, plus 39.0, 39.1, and 40.0, is affected by improper input validation in the media implementation that allows a remote attacker to trigger a software abort resulting in a denial of service

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-103108 是一枚影响 Pexip Infinity 视频会议/协作平台的拒绝服务类漏洞。根据 NVD 元数据，Pexip Infinity 在 38.2 之前的版本，以及 39.0、39.1、40.0 三个具体版本均受此问题影响。漏洞根因是产品媒体处理实现（media implementation）中对输入数据的校验不充分（improper input validation），当远端主机向受影响的媒体服务发送特制数据时，可能导致软件进程异常中止（software abort），进而造成服务不可用。CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.5，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H，即攻击可通过网络远程发起，无需任何身份认证与用户交互，攻击复杂度低，作用范围不变；机密性与完整性不受影响，但可用性被评为高影响，符合典型远程拒绝服务特征。目前该 CVE 未被列入 CISA KEV 目录，来源字段也未标注已在野利用或已武器化，因此应视为潜在风险而非已确认的活跃攻击活动。受影响的具体产品版本矩阵、部署方式（本地化部署还是托管服务）以及媒体端口暴露情况，需结合厂商公告与资产清单进一步核实。对使用 Pexip Infinity 提供会议、网关或媒体中继能力的组织而言，一旦该服务被中断，可能直接导致音视频会议接入失败、呼叫中断与业务连续性受损，因此属于需要尽快处置的高危可用性问题。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 远程未认证攻击者即可触发媒体服务异常中止，造成会议与音视频中继业务中断；CVSS 7.5、可用性高影响，且相关系统常直接暴露于互联网，修复优先级较高。当前无在野利用证据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功触发后受影响媒体进程可能崩溃或中止，导致会议接入、媒体转发等业务不可用，形成拒绝服务；不涉及数据泄露或篡改。未列入 KEV，亦无在野利用标注。

items.title: Pexip Infinity before 38.2, plus 39.0, 39.1 and 40.0, is affected by improper access control on a product-internal API which allows an attacker with local access to a node withi...
items.summary: Pexip Infinity before 38.2, plus 39.0, 39.1 and 40.0, is affected by improper access control on a product-internal API which allows an attacker with local access to a node within a Pexip Infinity installation to execute arbitrary code as an unprivileged user on another Pexip Infinity node.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-103105 是 Pexip Infinity 视频会议平台中的一个访问控制缺陷。根据描述，该产品内部使用的一个 API 接口存在权限校验不当（improper access control）问题，影响范围包括 38.2 之前的版本，以及 39.0、39.1 和 40.0 版本。攻击者只要能够对 Pexip Infinity 部署中的某一台节点拥有本地访问权限，即可利用该内部 API 绕过应有的权限约束，进而在同一部署内的另一台 Pexip Infinity 节点上以非特权用户身份执行任意代码。这一路径本质上是“内部横向移动 + 越权代码执行”，利用门槛的关键不在远程，而在于先拿到任一节点的本地立足点。CVSS 3.1 评分为 8.8，向量为 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H：攻击向量为相邻网络（AV:A）、无需任何权限（PR:N）、无需用户交互（UI:N），而机密性、完整性与可用性影响均为高。综合来看，这是高危级别的越权与代码执行组合漏洞，可能导致攻击者从一个被攻陷的边缘节点横向扩展到核心节点，读取会议与信令数据、篡改配置或造成服务中断。需要注意的是，当前输入数据中未将本漏洞列入 KEV，也没有标注在野利用证据，因此暂不能认定其已被实际利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 内部 API 越权加上跨节点任意代码执行，意味着一旦任一节点被本地拿下，整个 Pexip 部署可能被横向穿透；CVSS 8.8 且无需权限与交互，对自建会议基础设施的隔离假设构成直接挑战。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 已获得任一节点本地访问的攻击者可在其他节点上以非特权用户执行任意代码，造成跨节点横向移动、会议与配置数据泄露、配置篡改及服务中断，机密性/完整性/可用性均为高影响。

items.title: Pexip Infinity before 40.1 is affected by improper input validation in the signaling implementation that allows a malicious attacker to trigger a software abort resulting in a d...
items.summary: Pexip Infinity before 40.1 is affected by improper input validation in the signaling implementation that allows a malicious attacker to trigger a software abort resulting in a denial of service.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 根据 NVD 收录的元数据，Pexip Infinity 40.1 之前的版本存在一处输入校验不当（improper input validation）缺陷，问题位于其信令（signaling）实现中。Pexip Infinity 是用于企业视频会议与远程医疗、政务视频会商等场景的虚拟化会议平台，其信令组件负责处理 SIP、H.323 等呼叫建立与控制消息，并与外部终端、网关、边界代理直接交互。由于该组件在解析来自网络的信令输入时未对畸形或异常构造的数据做充分校验，攻击者可以发送特制消息触发软件内部异常终止（software abort），使相关服务进程崩溃或重启，从而造成拒绝服务。按照 CVSS 3.1 向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H 评估，该漏洞可经网络远程利用、无需任何认证或用户交互、利用复杂度低，唯一受影响的安全属性是可用性（高影响），因此基础评分为 7.5，属于高危级别。漏洞不涉及数据泄露或篡改，作用范围局限于单个组件。厂商已在 40.1 版本中修复该问题，说明这是可通过版本升级消除的缺陷。当前元数据未提供 EPSS 评分，未列入 CISA KEV，来源字段也未标记在野利用，因此没有证据表明该漏洞已被实际利用或武器化。对于使用受影响版本的机构，尤其是将信令端口暴露在互联网或跨信任边界部署的会议基础设施，应视为优先处置项：尽快升级至 40.1 或更高版本，并在升级前通过防火墙、SBC 或 ACL 限制对信令与管理接口的访问来源，同时监控服务异常重启与崩溃日志，以判断是否存在探测或滥用行为。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞无需认证、可远程触发，仅靠一条畸形信令消息即可令会议服务进程崩溃，直接中断正在进行的音视频会议；视频会议常承载应急指挥、远程诊疗等关键业务，可用性中断代价高。修复版本已发布，应优先升级并收敛暴露面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致 Pexip Infinity 信令服务异常中止、呼叫建立失败与会议中断，形成拒绝服务；不影响机密性与完整性，不涉及数据泄露或权限提升。

items.summary: Handlebars.java before 4.5.5 allows directory traversal. In handlebars-springmvc 4.5.3 and 4.5.4, the path-containment fix for CVE-2026-63490 validates template locations as raw percent-encoded strings, whereas the template file is opened through a URL handler that percent-decodes the path. In a Spring MVC application with a file: template prefix and a request-derived view name, a percent-encoded traversal such as %2e%2e/ bypasses both the view-resolver check and the loader-side containment and reads files outside the configured template base directory.

items.title: Uncontrolled recursion in the Gosub browser engine (gosub-engine) through 0.1.0 and main before commit 46868b3 allows a remote attacker to cause a Denial of Service (stack exhau...
items.summary: Uncontrolled recursion in the Gosub browser engine (gosub-engine) through 0.1.0 and main before commit 46868b3 allows a remote attacker to cause a Denial of Service (stack exhaustion and application crash) via an SVG document containing an excessive number of deeply nested elements. Because the engine does not limit the nesting depth of processed SVG nodes, rendering such a document overflows the thread stack and terminates the application. The malicious SVG can be embedded through the SRC attribute of an IMG element, and thus exploitation only requires the victim to visit an attacker-controlled web page.

items.title: Zetetic SQLCipher before 4.15.0 allows SQL injection. The sqlcipher_export convenience function can be used to copy the contents of one attached database into another. It is mos...
items.summary: Zetetic SQLCipher before 4.15.0 allows SQL injection. The sqlcipher_export convenience function can be used to copy the contents of one attached database into another. It is most often used to convert between plaintext and encrypted databases. It needs to do dynamic schema manipulation, and thus the function temporarily clears defensive restrictions during operation. A vulnerability in the handling of the source database name parameter made it possible for a caller to supply a crafted source name, which could execute statements that defensive mode would otherwise block. This could allow direct modifications to the sqlite_schema table and database corruption. SQLCipher 4.15.0 now strictly validates the source database name and prevents the bypass.

The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.summary: The device's update mechanism includes conditions that allow unauthorized software packages to be accepted as authentic. During the boot process, the stock done function disables signature verification in the OPKG configuration before restoring optional packages from a writable, unsigned feed. Separately, the publicly distributed SDK contains the production private key whose corresponding public key is trusted by both stable and beta firmware builds. Either issue undermines package authenticity, and together they allow an attacker to provide packages that appear valid to the system. Even if signature enforcement is restored, the exposed production key enables an attacker to generate signatures that the device will continue to trust. An attacker who can supply a malicious package may be able to execute arbitrary code with root privileges during installation.

A management interface subsequently returns this stored value in a JSON response, and the web interface responsible for displaying update information inserts that value directly into the page as HTML. This behavior allows attacker‑controlled metadata to be interpreted as script content. An attacker able to influence update metadata could exploit these conditions to execute arbitrary code within the administrative context of the device.

items.summary: Unverified ownership in Barman snapshot backup deletion allows a principal who can write the backup catalog to cause Barman to delete unrelated cloud snapshots. When a snapshot backup is deleted, either explicitly or by retention policy enforcement, Barman reads the snapshot identifiers from the backup.info file and passes them to the cloud provider's delete API using Barman's own credentials, without verifying that the snapshots belong to that backup. An attacker who can overwrite backup.info but lacks snapshot delete permissions can substitute the identifiers of other snapshots, causing Barman to delete any snapshot its cloud identity can reach on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. Exploitation requires a deployment where the principal that writes the backup catalog is separate from the identity Barman uses to delete snapshots. Barman versions from 3.4.0 (Google Cloud), 3.6.0 (Azure), and 3.7.0 (AWS) up to and including 3.20.0 are affected. The issue is fixed in Barman 3.20.1.

items.summary: virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual python environments. Prior to 21.7.11, PyEnvCfg.write() writes prompt values verbatim to the line-oriented pyvenv.cfg format while PyEnvCfg._read_values() parses the file with str.splitlines() and accepts the last value for duplicate keys. An attacker who influences --prompt, VIRTUALENV_PROMPT, or configuration input can insert a recognized line boundary and additional keys, including home, causing consumers to use an attacker-selected base interpreter or corrupted environment metadata. The security impact requires prompt input from outside the operator's trust boundary; directly supplied prompt content primarily corrupts the operator's own environment. This issue is fixed in version 21.7.11.

items.summary: virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual python environments. Prior to 21.7.12, download_wheel() accepts pip and setuptools seed wheels fetched for periodic updates or the --download option without checking their bytes against an authoritative digest equivalent to the embedded wheels' BUNDLE_SHA256 verification. A compromised index, stale mirror, or intercepted TLS connection can substitute a different wheel under the requested distribution, version, and filename, after which virtualenv caches and seeds the attacker-controlled wheel into subsequently created environments. The verification applies to the default PyPI path and is intentionally skipped when PIP_INDEX_URL, PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL, or PIP_INDEX configures a custom index that may legitimately publish rebuilt wheels. This issue is fixed in version 21.7.12.

items.summary: JupyterLab is an extensible environment for interactive and reproducible computing, based on the Jupyter Notebook Architecture. From JupyterLab 4.0.0 until 4.5.11 and 4.6.4, the PyPI Extension Manager uninstall request reaches ExtensionHandler.post, which validates extension names for installation but passes uninstall names to PyPIExtensionManager.uninstall and python -m pip uninstall without rejecting option-like values. The security impact requires that the PyPI Extension Manager is enabled, the account can call the extension API, and kernels and terminals are disabled or delegated to remote hosts; otherwise the user can already read files and make outbound requests directly. An authenticated user with extension API access can supply a pip requirements option to make the server read a local file or fetch an internal URL, and reflected parse errors can return the first unparsable line or response content. A pip log option can also create or corrupt a chosen path with pip-generated log text, but the requester cannot select an arbitrary disclosed line or arbitrary file content, and the injection does not add code execution or availability impact beyond ordinary package removal. This issue is fixed in JupyterLab 4.5.11 and 4.6.4.

items.summary: JupyterLab is an extensible environment for interactive and reproducible computing, based on the Jupyter Notebook Architecture. From JupyterLab 3.0.0 until 4.5.11 and 4.6.4, and in JupyterLite Core 0.8.3 and earlier, the Plural-Forms header in a selected third-party language pack can append JavaScript after a valid plural rule because prefix-only regular-expression validation accepts a matching prefix without requiring the entire header to match. JupyterLab passes the accepted expression to new Function, so loading the catalogue and translating a plural string executes the appended code in the authenticated JupyterLab origin. Where Jupyter Server kernels, terminals, and APIs are exposed, the code can use authenticated server APIs to read or modify files and run code. Impact is much more limited in JupyterLite because it typically lacks most exposed Jupyter Server surfaces. The default English locale is unaffected because it does not load a translation catalogue. This issue is fixed in JupyterLab 4.5.11 and 4.6.4 and JupyterLite Core 0.8.4.

items.summary: simple-git, an interface for running git commands in any node.js application, enables applications to execute Git operations from JavaScript. Prior to 2.0.1 of the argv-parser package, parseEnv omits VISUAL from GitEnvKeys, so prepareEnv drops the value before vulnerabilityCheck can classify it as allowUnsafeEditor. A consuming application that forwards attacker-influenced environment values can therefore allow Git to invoke an attacker-selected editor during operations such as commit amendment or interactive rebase when no higher-priority editor setting overrides VISUAL and Git's terminal prerequisites are met. The executable runs with the privileges of the Node.js process. This issue is fixed in argv-parser 2.0.1.

This issue is fixed in version 0.62.6.

items.summary: Russh is a Rust SSH client and server library. Prior to 0.63.1, a connection configured to permit mac=none can negotiate it with a MAC-requiring CTR or CBC block cipher because the selection logic validates needs_mac() only when MAC selection fails. A remote peer can then send a packet with a decrypted length of zero, causing russh/src/cipher/mod.rs to shrink the previously read block before indexing buffer.buffer[16..], which panics and terminates the connection task. This issue is fixed in version 0.63.1.

An unprivileged, memory-protected ThreadX module can have the kernel read and write memory at addresses of its choosing, in privileged mode, and can use that to clear the MPU enable bit and remove its own isolation boundary.



The Module Manager decided whether a privileged service could dereference an object address a module named by asking only whether that address fell outside the module. The manager's object pool is outside every module, so the test was satisfied by an address shifted into the interior of one of the module's own privileged allocations, which denotes no object at all. The bytes such an address presents as a control block are bytes the module put there through ordinary create and set services, so the control block ID at the front of them could be made to read as any type the module chose, and the `_txe_` layer's ID test then agreed. The reported chain uses that to reach a privileged `memset` across an attacker-chosen range.

A TFTP server that answers with a short ERROR packet makes the client read up to 64 bytes past the



received datagram.



Each receive path checks only that the datagram is at least four bytes long (nxd_tftp_client.c:1229,



1521, 1984). When the opcode is NX_TFTP_CODE_ERROR the message string is copied with a loop whose



only limits are the destination buffer and a NUL byte:



```c



/* addons/tftp/nxd_tftp_client.c:1769 */



for (i = 0; (i < (sizeof(tftp_client_ptr -> nx_tftp_client_error_string) - 1)) && (*buffer_ptr); i++)



```

terminating NUL, which a server controls completely, walks the loop off the end of the packet until



it happens to meet a zero byte or fills the 64 byte destination.

```
ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow



READ of size 1 at 0x60d0000000c8 thread T4

    #0 _nxd_tftp_client_file_read  addons/tftp/nxd_tftp_client.c:1769

```

packet pool memory ends up in whatever the device does with the error text.

items.summary:
A DHCP server, or anyone on the LAN who answers a DISCOVER first, can make the client read about a



kilobyte past the end of the received message.



The option walk keeps a pointer and an offset in step, and the only bound check uses the offset:



```c



/* addons/dhcp/nxd_dhcp_client.c:7538, 7572 */



while (i < length - 1)



{

    ...
    size = *(++data);      /* data moves 1: type -> length byte */
    data += size + 1;      /* data moves size + 1 more          */
    i += size + 1;         /* i moves only size + 1             */


}



```



A TLV option occupies size + 2 bytes. `data` is advanced by size + 2 in total, `i` by size + 1, so



the offset falls one byte behind the real read position for every option the walk skips. After



enough skipped options the check `i < length - 1` still holds while `data` is already past the end



of the message, and the subsequent read of the type and length bytes comes from whatever follows.



A single OFFER carrying a long run of skippable options is enough:



```



ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow



READ of size 1 at 0x61b000000794 thread T5

    #0 _nx_dhcp_search_buffer     addons/dhcp/nxd_dhcp_client.c:7541
    #1 _nx_dhcp_get_option_value  addons/dhcp/nxd_dhcp_client.c:7082


0x61b000000794 is located 164 bytes to the right of 1648-byte region



```



A well formed OFFER through the same path is handled normally, the client records the offer and



moves to REQUESTING, so the difference is the option layout rather than the harness.



The read runs in the DHCP client thread while the client is still unconfigured, so it happens on



every boot in reach of a hostile DHCP responder. The values read are used to configure the



interface, which is how the disclosed bytes become observable.



Advance `i` by size + 2, or derive the bound from `data` rather than keeping a second counter.

items.title:
An unauthenticated client can drain the RTSP server's packet pool with a couple of dozen requests



that carry a Session header the parser cannot convert.



The Session branch...
items.summary:
An unauthenticated client can drain the RTSP server's packet pool with a couple of dozen requests



that carry a Session header the parser cannot convert.



The Session branch returns the raw NetX error code instead of an RTSP status code:



```c



/* addons/rtsp/nx_rtsp_server.c:2754 */



status = _nx_utility_string_to_uint(field_value_ptr, field_value_length, &session_id);



if (status)



{

    return(status);      /* NX_INVALID_PARAMETERS / NX_SIZE_ERROR / NX_OVERFLOW */


}



```



Every other branch of the same function maps its failure to an RTSP status first. The CSeq branch



eighteen lines earlier does exactly that (line 2736 returns NX_RTSP_STATUS_CODE_BAD_REQUEST). The



raw code then reaches `_nx_rtsp_server_error_response_send` (nx_rtsp_server.c:1234), which does not



recognise it, takes a path that returns without releasing the response packet it already allocated,



and the block never goes back to the pool.



Six requests with an empty Session header against a 22 packet pool:



```



valid requests:      after request 6: pool available = 21,  AFTER = 22 / 22



malformed requests:  after request 6: pool available = 16,  AFTER = 17 / 22



```



One block per request, not returned when the client disconnects. Twenty six requests take the pool



to zero and the server starts failing allocations, after which it serves nobody. If the pool is



shared with the rest of the application, as it is in the shipped sample, the rest of the stack



stops with it.



Convert the `_nx_utility_string_to_uint` failure in the Session branch into



NX_RTSP_STATUS_CODE_BAD_REQUEST the way the CSeq branch does, and release the response packet on



every exit path of `_nx_rtsp_server_error_response_send`.
